meaning: 鋇 (化學符號)；(古埃及) 靈魂
sentences: In chemistry, Ba stands for barium. 在化學中，這個符號代表鋇。
Ancient Egyptians believed the ba could leave the body. 古埃及人相信人的靈魂可以離開身體。

We could hear the sheep baa in the distance. 我們可以聽到遠處羊群的叫聲。

meaning: 咩咩叫 (baa 的變體或持續式)
sentences: The sheep were baahling all through the night. 羊群整晚都在咩咩叫。

meaning: 巴力 (古代腓尼基及迦南人的神)
sentences: Baal was a major deity in ancient Near Eastern religions. 巴力是古代近東宗教中的主要神靈。
The worship of Baal is mentioned several times in historical texts. 歷史文獻中多次提到對巴力的崇拜。
The prophets warned against following after any baal. 先知警告不要追隨任何假神。
He used the term to describe a modern societal baal. 他用這個詞來描述現代社會的一個偶像。
Baalath was one of the cities fortified by King Solomon. 巴拉是所羅門王加固的城市之一。
Archaeologists searched for the site of ancient Baalath. 考古學家尋找古代巴拉遺址。
The prophet spoke against Baalish influences in the city. 先知反對城裡的巴力崇拜影響。
He avoided any ritual that seemed Baalish in nature. 他避開任何本質上看起來像巴力崇拜的儀式。
Baalism was a widespread religious practice in the ancient Levant. 巴力崇拜在古代黎凡特地區是一種廣泛的宗教實踐。
The spread of Baalism was a major concern for the Israelites. 巴力崇拜的傳播是以色列人的主要擔憂。
A Baalist was anyone who worshipped the deity Baal. 巴力崇拜者是指任何崇拜神靈巴力的人。
The king was accused of being a secret Baalist. 國王被指控是一名秘密的巴力崇拜者。
Historical records identify several Baalite temples. 歷史記錄確認了幾座巴力崇拜者的寺廟。
The confrontation between the prophet and the Baalites is famous. 先知與巴力崇拜者之間的對峙非常有名。

The old texts describe various Baalitical traditions. 古代文獻描述了各種巴力崇拜的傳統。

sentences: The foreign queen attempted to Baalize the kingdom. 外國王后試圖使王國轉向巴力崇拜。

meaning: 神名大師 (猶太教中指能顯神蹟者)
sentences: The Baalshem was revered for his deep spiritual knowledge. 神名大師因其深厚的精神知識而受到尊敬。

sentences: The temple gate was carved with a baar. 寺廟門口雕著外牆裝飾。

meaning: 一種用朗姆酒風味糖漿浸泡過的海綿蛋糕。
sentences: The bakery served baba soaked in a light rum syrup. 麵包店供應浸過淡蘭姆糖漿的巴巴蛋糕。

meaning: 一種辣椒 (Tabasco 的變體或特定品種)
sentences: The chef grew babasco in a clay pot. 廚師在陶盆裡種那種塔巴斯科變種辣椒。

meaning: 巴比特 (金屬)；平庸的布爾喬亞
sentences: The term 'Babbitt' comes from a famous novel by Sinclair Lewis. 這個詞源自辛克萊·劉易斯的名著《巴比特》。

sentences: The babbitter lined the bearing with a soft metal alloy. 這名工人用軟質合金替軸承加襯。

He found the constant stream of babblative comments annoying. 他覺得那源源不斷的廢話評論很煩人。
The baby began to babble happily in her crib. 嬰兒開始在嬰兒床裡開心地牙牙學語。
I can't understand a word of this nonsensical babble. 我一句也聽不懂這毫無意義的胡扯。

His speech was little more than confusing babblement. 他的講話無非是令人困惑的胡言亂語。
Don't listen to him; he is just a known babbler. 不要聽他的；他只是一個出名的愛說廢話的人。
We spotted a jungle babbler during our birdwatching trip. 我們在觀鳥旅行中發現了一隻叢林聒噪鳥。
The babblesome neighbor always catches me when I'm in a hurry. 那個愛嘮叨的鄰居總是在我趕時間時抓住我。

meaning: 喋喋不休的；潺潺作響的
sentences: We sat by a babbling brook in the forest. 我們坐在森林裡潺潺作響的小溪旁。
Her babbling stopped when she realized no one was listening. 當她意識到沒人在聽時，她的喋喋不休停止了。

She spoke babblingly to the stranger on the bus. 她在公車上對著陌生人喋喋不休地說著話。

sentences: The patient made some babblish sounds before falling asleep. 病人在入睡前發出了一些牙牙學語般的聲音。

Look at that sweet little babby in the pram. 看嬰兒車裡那個可愛的小嬰兒。

sentences: The biblical story of the Tower of Babel explains the origin of languages. 聖經中巴別塔的故事解釋了語言的起源。

Her notes looked Babelish after the rain. 雨後，她的筆記看起來一片混亂。

meaning: 巴貝斯蟲屬 (一種血液寄生蟲)

meaning: 巴貝夫主義 (一種早期共產主義學說)
sentences: Babouvism is named after the French revolutionary François-Noël Babeuf. 巴貝夫主義以法國革命家弗朗索瓦-諾埃爾·巴貝夫的名字命名。
The historian discussed the principles of Babouvism in his lecture. 歷史學家在講座中討論了巴貝夫主義的原則。
The Babouvists sought to overthrow the Directory in France. 巴貝夫主義者試圖推翻法國的督政府。
As a Babouvist, he advocated for the complete equality of all citizens. 作為一名巴貝夫主義者，他提倡所有公民完全平等。
Babroot plants are native to the Cape region of South Africa. 狒狒花原產於南非的好望角地區。
The vibrant purple babroot stood out in the meadow. 鮮艷的紫色狒狒花在草地上脫穎而出。

meaning: 芭布絲 (女子名，Barbara 或 Elizabeth 的暱稱)
sentences: A friend brought up Babs on the bus. 朋友在公車上提起了芭布絲。
She wrote Babs on a small card. 她把芭布絲寫在一張小卡上。

meaning: 先生；辦事員 (印度用語)；巴布 (人名)
sentences: The babu at the post office was very helpful. 郵局的辦事員非常樂於助人。
He was addressed as 'Babu' by his younger colleagues. 他的年輕同事稱呼他為「巴布先生」。

meaning: 巴布亞人 (剛果的一個族群)
sentences: The Babua people have a rich tradition of oral storytelling. 巴布亞人有著豐富的口頭敘事傳統。
He spent years living among the Babua to study their culture. 他在巴布亞人中生活了多年以研究他們的文化。

meaning: 官僚作風；辦事員階層 (同 baboodom)
sentences: The citizen complained about the endless red tape of local babudom. 市民抱怨當地官僚作風無休止的繁文縟節。
Babudom played a crucial role in maintaining colonial records. 辦事員階層在維護殖民記錄方面發揮了至關重要的作用。
The babuina palm is valued for its oily fruits. 巴布伊納棕櫚樹因其含油的果實而受到重視。
The villagers harvested the seeds of the babuina. 村民們收穫了巴布伊納棕櫚的種子。

meaning: 印度式英語；辦事員習氣 (同 babooism)
sentences: The report was criticized for its unnecessary babuism. 該報告因不必要的官僚式英語而受到批評。
He tried to eliminate babuism from his formal writing. 他試圖在正式寫作中消除辦事員習氣。
Babul trees are known for their ability to thrive in dry conditions. 阿拉伯膠樹以其在乾旱條件下茁壯成長的能力而聞名。
The bark of the babul tree is used for tanning. 阿拉伯膠樹的樹皮用於鞣革。

meaning: 巴布馬人 (剛果的一個族群)
sentences: The Babuma people inhabit the banks of the Congo River. 巴布馬人居住在剛果河岸邊。
They are skilled in fishing and river navigation. 他們精通捕魚和河流航行。

meaning: 巴邦蓋拉人 (加蓬的一個族群)
sentences: The Babungera are one of the many ethnic groups in the region. 巴邦蓋拉人是該地區眾多族群之一。
Cultural exchange with the Babungera was a focus of the study. 與巴邦蓋拉人的文化交流是研究的一個重點。
The babushka sat on the bench, feeding the birds. 那個俄羅斯老婦人坐在長椅上餵鳥。
She tied a colorful babushka around her head to keep warm. 她在頭上繫了一條鮮艷的頭巾以保暖。
The baby is sleeping peacefully in the crib. 寶寶正在嬰兒床裡安靜地睡覺。
She is expecting a baby in the spring. 她預計在春天生寶寶。
The nursery was a little paradise of babydom. 育兒室是一個小小的嬰兒天堂。
Memories of babydom are often lost to adults. 嬰兒期的記憶對成年人來說往往會消失。

meaning: 使幼兒化的；使變得幼稚的
sentences: The website had a babyfied design that was unappealing to adults. 該網站的設計過於幼兒化，對成年人沒有吸引力。
He didn't like the babyfied tone of the presentation. 他不喜歡演講中那種幼稚的語氣。
Photos from his babyhood filled several albums. 他嬰兒時期的照片裝滿了幾個相冊。
Babyhood is a critical period for brain development. 嬰兒期是是大腦發育的關鍵時期。
She spent hours playing with the furniture in her babyhouse. 她花了幾個小時玩她玩具屋裡的家具。
The antique babyhouse was passed down through the family. 這座古董玩具屋在家族中代代相傳。
It was a babyish argument that they should have avoided. 那是一個他們本應避免的幼稚爭論。
His babyish handwriting was difficult to read. 他那孩子氣的筆跡很難辨認。
The grown man acted babyishly when he lost the game. 那個成年男子在輸掉比賽後表現得很幼稚。
She smiled babyishly at her favorite toy. 她對著自己最喜歡的玩具露出孩子氣的微笑。
There was a certain babyishness in his plea for attention. 他尋求關注的請求中帶有一種幼稚。
The babyishness of the characters was intended to be funny. 角色們的幼稚是為了製造幽默感。
The use of babyism in their secret language was cute. 他們秘密語言中使用幼兒語很可愛。
He was criticized for the excessive babyism in his writing style. 他因寫作風格中過度的幼兒化而受到批評。
The puppy had a babylike face that melted everyone's heart. 那隻小狗有一張像嬰兒一樣的臉，融化了每個人的心。
She had soft, babylike skin. 她有著柔軟、像嬰兒般的皮膚。

meaning: 巴比倫；奢華而混亂的城市
sentences: Babylon was a major city in ancient Mesopotamia. 巴比倫是古代美索不達米亞的一個主要城市。
Modern New York is sometimes compared to a modern-day Babylon. 現代紐約有時被比作現代的巴比倫。
The Babylonian Empire was known for its advanced astronomy. 巴比倫帝國以其先進的天文學而聞名。
He is a scholar of Babylonian history and culture. 他是一位巴比倫歷史和文化的學者。

meaning: 巴比倫的；混亂的；奢華的
sentences: The building's architecture had a certain Babylonic grandeur. 這座建築的建築風格帶有一種巴比倫式的宏偉。
The Babylonic confusion of languages in the city was overwhelming. 城市中那種巴比倫式的語言混亂令人難以承受。

meaning: 巴比倫的；混亂的；奢侈的
sentences: His Babylonish garments were made of the finest silk. 他那巴比倫式的衣服是由最好的絲綢製成的。
The room was filled with a Babylonish array of strange objects. 房間裡堆滿了琳瑯滿目、古怪的巴比倫式物品。

meaning: 巴比倫習俗；混亂的言論
sentences: The historian discussed the influence of Babylonism on other cultures. 歷史學家討論了巴比倫習俗對其他文化的影響。
His writing was criticized for its incomprehensible Babylonism. 他的寫作因其難以理解的混亂言論而受到批評。

meaning: 巴比倫人；居住在奢華都市的人
sentences: The Babylonites were famous for their hanging gardens. 巴比倫人以其空中花園而聞名。
He felt like a true Babylonite living in the heart of the city. 住在市中心，他覺得自己像一個真正的都市人。

meaning: 使像巴比倫；使奢華混亂
sentences: The rapid urbanization began to Babylonize the once-quiet town. 快速的城市化開始使這個曾經寧靜的小鎮變得奢華而混亂。
He feared that modern trends would Babylonize local traditions. 他擔心現代趨勢會使當地傳統變得奢華而混亂。

meaning: 嬰兒崇拜；過度溺愛嬰兒
sentences: The parents' babyolatry was evident in the way they catered to every whim. 父母對嬰兒的崇拜體現在他們滿足嬰兒每一個心血來潮的方式上。
The book critiques the modern culture of babyolatry. 這本書批判了現代的嬰兒崇拜文化。

meaning: 嬰兒地位；嬰兒時期 (同 babeship)
sentences: During her babyship, she was the center of attention. 在她的嬰兒時期，她是關注的中心。
We must respect his babyship's nap schedule. 我們必須尊重這位小嬰兒的午睡時間表。
The bac carried travelers across the narrow river. 渡船載著旅客穿過狹窄的河流。
Large bacs were used to transport wine from the vineyard. 大桶被用來從葡萄園運輸葡萄酒。
A bacaba tree grew beside the creek. 溪邊長著一棵南美棕櫚。
We rested under a bacaba at noon. 中午時我們在一棵南美棕櫚下休息。
The old bacach sat by the church door. 老乞丐坐在教堂門口。
In the story, the bacach turns out to be a king in disguise. 在故事中，那個乞丐原來是國王偽裝的。

meaning: 鹹鱈魚；鱈魚料理 (西班牙語)
sentences: Bacalao is a popular ingredient in Mediterranean cuisine. 鹹鱈魚是地中海料理中受歡迎的食材。
She prepared a delicious stew with bacalao and potatoes. 她用鹹鱈魚和馬鈴薯準備了一道美味的燉菜。

meaning: 一种用于制作绳索的纤维植物
sentences: Bacao grows tall in wet fields. 這種用來製繩的纖維植物常在潮濕田地裡長得很高。
Farmers use bacao to make rope. 農民用這種纖維植物來製繩。

meaning: 一種南非聒噪鳥 (同 bokmakierie)
sentences: At dawn, a bacbakiri sang from the thorn tree. 清晨，一隻南非聒噪鳥在荊棘樹上鳴叫。
The guide pointed out a bacbakiri in the scrub. 導覽員指著灌木叢裡的南非聒噪鳥。
A bacca is a fleshy fruit produced from a single ovary. 漿果是由單個子房產生的肉質果實。
The botanist classified the sample as a bacca. 植物學家將該樣本分類為漿果。
The shrub has small, baccaceous fruits that birds enjoy. 這種灌木結有鳥類喜歡的小漿果狀果實。
Many baccaceous plants are used in landscaping. 許多產漿果的植物被用於景觀美化。
The baccae of this plant are poisonous if ingested. 如果攝入，這種植物的漿果是有毒的。
The clusters of colorful baccae looked beautiful in the autumn sun. 秋日陽光下，成串鮮艷的漿果看起來非常漂亮。
He completed his baccalaurean studies last year. 他去年完成了學士學業。
The baccalaurean ceremony was held in the university hall. 學士學位典禮在大學禮堂舉行。

meaning: 學士學位；畢業典禮布道
sentences: She received her baccalaureate degree in English literature. 她獲得了英語文學學士學位。
The baccalaureate service featured an inspiring guest speaker. 畢業典禮布道請來了一位鼓舞人心的演講嘉賓。

meaning: 百家樂 (一種紙牌遊戲，同 baccarat)
sentences: He enjoys playing baccara at the casino. 他喜歡在賭場玩百家樂。
The rules of baccara are relatively simple to learn. 百家樂的規則相對容易學習。

meaning: 百家樂 (一種紙牌遊戲)；百家樂水晶
sentences: Baccarat is often associated with high-stakes gambling. 百家樂通常與高額賭博聯繫在一起。
The table was decorated with exquisite baccarat crystal vases. 桌上裝飾著精美的百家樂水晶花瓶。
The baccate nature of the fruit was noted by the researcher. 研究人員注意到了該果實的漿果狀性質。
This species is distinguished by its small baccate seeds. 該物種以其微小的漿果狀種子為特徵。
The baccated appearance of the berries made them easily identifiable. 這些漿果的漿果狀外觀使其易於識別。
The scientist described the baccated structure of the tissue. 科學家描述了組織的漿果狀結構。

meaning: 酒神女信徒；《酒神的女信徒》(歐里庇得斯的劇作)
sentences: In Euripides' Bacchae, the chorus grows wild. 在歐里庇得斯的《酒神女信徒》裡，合唱隊越來越狂野。
The actor studied the Bacchae before rehearsal. 演員在排練前研究那部劇作。
The party turned into a wild bacchanal that lasted until dawn. 聚會演變成了一場持續到黎明的狂歡。
He was described as a bacchanal figure who loved late nights. 他被描述為一個熱愛深夜的狂歡者。
The ancient Romans celebrated the Bacchanalia in honor of Bacchus. 古羅馬人舉行酒神節以紀念巴克斯。
The modern equivalent of the Bacchanalia would be a very rowdy festival. 現代相當於酒神節的活動將是一個非常喧鬧的節日。
They were criticized for their bacchanalian behavior at the wedding. 他們因在婚禮上的狂歡行為而受到批評。
The movie depicted a bacchanalian scene in a Roman villa. 電影描繪了羅馬別墅中的狂歡場景。
The philosophy of bacchanalianism emphasizes sensory pleasure. 狂歡主義哲學強調感官愉悅。
His life was a long history of bacchanalianism and excess. 他的生活是一段漫長的狂歡與過度的歷史。
The guests danced bacchanalianly throughout the night. 賓客們整晚都在狂歡地跳舞。
He toasted his friends bacchanalianly at the feast. 他在宴會上狂歡地向朋友們舉杯致意。
The decline of the empire was often attributed to widespread bacchanalism. 帝國的衰落通常歸因於廣泛的狂歡行為。
Social critics warned against the dangers of modern bacchanalism. 社會評論家警告現代狂歡行為的危險。

meaning: 使狂歡化；使變成酒神節般的
sentences: The bacchanalization of the festival changed its traditional meaning. 節日的狂歡化改變了其傳統意義。
He argued against the bacchanalization of public celebrations. 他反對公共慶祝活動的狂歡化。
The group attempted to bacchanalize the annual retreat. 該小組試圖使年度靜修會變成一場狂歡。
Constant partying can bacchanalize one's perspective on life. 不斷的聚會會使一個人的生活觀變得狂歡化。
The bacchant danced wildly during the ritual. 酒神信徒在儀式中狂野地跳舞。
She felt like a bacchant in the middle of the crowded dance floor. 在擁擠的舞池中央，她覺得自己像個狂歡者。

meaning: 酒神女信徒；狂飲的女人
sentences: The statue represented a bacchante holding a cluster of grapes. 這座雕像表現了一個拿著一串葡萄的酒神女信徒。
In mythology, a bacchante followed the god Bacchus. 在神話中，酒神女信徒跟隨神靈巴克斯。
The bacchantes were often depicted with ivy in their hair. 酒神女信徒通常被描繪成頭髮上戴著常春藤。
The sounds of the bacchantes' revelry echoed through the hills. 酒神女信徒狂歡的聲音在山間迴盪。
The music had a bacchantic rhythm that compelled people to dance. 音樂有一種迫使人們跳舞的酒神節節奏。
A bacchantic atmosphere pervaded the late-night party. 深夜聚會瀰漫著一種狂歡的氣氛。
The garden carried the scent of bacchar after rain. 雨後，花園裡飄著一種芳香植物的氣味。
She clipped a sprig of bacchar for the vase. 她剪下一小枝芳香植物插進花瓶。
Baccharis is a large genus of shrubs in the daisy family. 巴卡利斯屬是菊科中一個巨大的灌木屬。
The scientist collected samples of Baccharis from the coastal area. 科學家從沿海地區收集了巴卡利斯屬的樣本。
The room felt baccharoid after the rain. 雨後房間裡的感覺很像巴卡利斯的。
Her answer was short and baccharoid. 她的回答簡短而像巴卡利斯的。

meaning: 紀念巴克斯的神廟或場所
sentences: Archaeologists uncovered the remains of an ancient baccheion. 考古學家挖掘出了一座古代巴克斯神廟的遺跡。
The baccheion was used for private religious gatherings. 這個巴克斯神廟被用於私人宗教聚會。

meaning: 酒神節的；(詩律) 酒神格的
sentences: A bacchiac foot in poetry consists of one short and two long syllables. 詩歌中的酒神格由一個短音節和兩個長音節組成。
The scholar analyzed the bacchiac meter of the ancient poem. 學者分析了這首古詩的酒神格韻律。
The bacchian party lasted until dawn. 那場酒神式狂歡一直持續到天亮。
His bacchian poem felt wild and bright. 他那首酒神式的詩既狂放又明亮。
The Bacchic mysteries were secret religious rites. 酒神秘密祭典是秘密的宗教儀式。
He let out a Bacchic laugh as he poured the wine. 他倒酒時發出一聲酒神般的狂笑。
The room was in a state of bacchic disorder after the party. 聚會後，房間處於一種狂歡後的混亂狀態。
A bacchic spirit of fun and excess took over the group. 一種狂歡、享樂與過度的精神佔領了這個團體。
The Bacchical festivities lasted for several days. 酒神節的慶祝活動持續了好幾天。
She wore a wreath of ivy for the Bacchical themed event. 她為酒神主題活動戴上了常春藤花環。

meaning: 《巴克斯的女信徒》(普勞圖斯的劇作)；酒神女信徒 (複數)
sentences: Plautus's comedy 'Bacchides' is a famous work of Latin literature. 普勞圖斯的喜劇《巴克斯的女信徒》是拉丁文學的著名作品。
The Bacchides are central characters in the mythological tale. 酒神女信徒是神話故事中的核心人物。
The use of bacchii in the verse created a unique rhythm. 在詩句中使用酒神格創造了一種獨特的節奏。
He studied the frequency of bacchii in classical drama. 他研究了古典戲劇中酒神格出現的頻率。

meaning: 酒神格 (一短音後接二長音)
sentences: The poet skillfully employed the bacchius in his latest work. 詩人在他最新的作品中熟練地運用了酒神格。
Identifying a bacchius requires careful scanning of the poem. 識別酒神格需要對詩歌進行仔細的格律分析。
Bacchus is the Roman god of wine and revelry. 巴克斯是羅馬的神話中的酒與狂歡之神。
Many paintings depict Bacchus surrounded by followers. 許多繪畫描繪了被信徒簇擁的巴克斯。

meaning: 像巴克斯的；愛喝酒且狂歡的
sentences: The jovial host was quite Bacchuslike in his hospitality. 那位快活的主人待客非常像巴克斯，慷慨且熱情。
He adopted a Bacchuslike persona for the carnival. 他為嘉年華扮成了一個像巴克斯的人物。
Bacciferous plants are a vital food source for many bird species. 結漿果的植物是許多鳥類的重要食物來源。
She identified several bacciferous shrubs along the trail. 她在小徑旁識別出幾種結漿果的灌木。
The bacciform seeds were scattered across the forest floor. 漿果狀的種子散佈在森林地面上。
The botanist described the fruit's bacciform structure. 植物學家描述了該果實的漿果狀結構。
Many tropical birds are baccivorous. 許多熱帶鳥類是食漿果的。
The baccivorous mammals play a role in seed dispersal. 食漿果的哺乳動物在種子傳播中發揮作用。

meaning: 過著單身漢的生活； （主要是男人）沒有女人的生活，自己做飯，做家事等。
sentences: To bach means to live as a bachelor; (chiefly of a man) to live without women, and do one's own cooking, housekeeping etc. 這個動詞指像單身漢那樣獨自生活，自己做飯和做家事。
People may bach in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會依情境，過著這種單身漢式的生活。

meaning: 巴哈拉赫 (德國城市名；伯特·巴哈拉赫，作曲家)
sentences: Bacharach is a picturesque town on the Rhine river. 巴哈拉赫是萊茵河畔一個如畫的小鎮。
Burt Bacharach was a legendary composer of popular music. 伯特·巴哈拉赫是一位傳奇的流行音樂作曲家。
The bache was filled with lush greenery. 溪谷裡長滿了茂盛的植被。
They followed the path that led down into the bache. 他們沿著通往溪谷的小路走下去。

meaning: 學士 (bachelor 的舊拼法或變體)
sentences: The title of bachel was used in ancient universities. 學士頭銜在古代大學中被使用。
Historical documents refer to the requirements for becoming a bachel. 歷史文獻提到了成為學士的要求。
He is a successful businessman and a very eligible bachelor. 他是一位成功的商人，也是一位非常理想的單身漢。

sentences: The Bachichi people are known for their traditional crafts. 巴奇奇人以其傳統手工藝而聞名。

Bacillarieae includes several important genera of diatoms. 矽藻族包括幾個重要的矽藻屬。
The distribution of Bacillarieae varies with water temperature. 矽藻族的分佈隨水溫而變化。
Bacillariophyta is the phylum that contains all diatoms. 矽藻門是包含所有矽藻的門。
Most members of Bacillariophyta are unicellular organisms. 矽藻門的大多數成員是單細胞生物。
Bacillary dysentery is caused by certain bacteria. 桿菌性痢疾是由某些細菌引起的。
The bacillary structure was clearly visible in the sample. 樣本中桿狀結構清晰可見。

The soil sample contained several types of bacilli. 土壤樣本中含有幾種桿菌。
Many bacilli are beneficial to the environment. 許多桿菌對環境是有益的。
He conducted research on bacillian morphology. 他進行了關於桿菌形態的研究。
The bacillian nature of the infection was confirmed. 感染的桿菌性質得到了證實。

The bacillicidic activity of the compound was measured. 測量了該化合物的殺桿菌活性。

meaning: 桿菌引起的；產生桿菌的
sentences: The patient suffered from a bacillogenic disease. 患者患有一種桿菌引起的疾病。

meaning: 巴西斯 (古希臘預言家名)
sentences: Bacis was a name given to several legendary seers in ancient Greece. 巴西斯是古希臘幾位傳奇預言家的名字。

sentences: The warehouse had a lot of backage that needed sorting. 倉庫裡有很多需要整理的後備儲存物。

sentences: The loud backfiring of the truck woke the neighbors. 卡車響亮的回火聲吵醒了鄰居。

Badarian pottery is known for its high quality. 巴達里陶器以其高品質著稱。
He carried a badarrah of sticks. 他搬著一捆木棍。
She tied the flowers into a badarrah. 她把花紮成一束。

meaning: 貝都因人（阿拉伯遊牧民族）
sentences: The Badawi have a rich oral tradition. 貝都因人有著豐富的口述傳統。
They met a group of Badawi in the desert. 他們在沙漠中遇到了一群貝都因人。
Baddeleyite is a primary source of zirconium. 斜鋯石是鋯的主要來源。
The crystal structure of baddeleyite was analyzed. 分析了斜鋯石的晶體結構。
Badderlocks is an edible seaweed. 羽狀翼藻是一種可食用的海藻。
They gathered badderlocks from the rocky shore. 他們從岩石海岸採集羽狀翼藻。
He has a baddish cold. 他得了場頗為嚴重的感冒。
The news was baddish but not catastrophic. 消息不太好，但還不算災難性的。
He behaved baddishly at the event. 他在活動中表現得頗為糟糕。
The situation was baddishly handled. 情況處理得不太理想。
The baddishness of the weather ruined our plans. 天氣不太好，毀了我們的計畫。
He apologized for the baddishness of his conduct. 他為自己行為不端而道歉。
The fisherman caught a large baddock. 漁夫捕獲了一條巨大的綠青鱈。
Baddock is commonly used in fish and chips. 綠青鱈常用於製作炸魚薯條。

meaning: 命令，吩咐，告別（bid的過去式）
sentences: He bade them a fond farewell. 他深情地向他們告別。
She bade him stay for dinner. 她吩咐他留下來吃晚飯。
Badenite was found in the old mine. 在舊礦井中發現了鉍鐵砷礦。
The properties of badenite were studied by geologists. 地質學家研究了鉍鐵砷礦的特性。
The police officer showed his badge before entering the building. 警官在進入大樓前出示了他的徽章。
She was proud to wear her new school badge on her uniform. 她為能穿上帶有新校徽的制服而感到自豪。
The car had a badgeless grille. 這輛車的格柵上沒有徽章。
He wore a badgeless uniform. 他穿著一件沒有徽章的制服。

meaning: 戴徽章的人，受救濟者（舊時領救濟金者需戴徽章）
sentences: The badgeman stood at the corner of the street. 戴徽章的人站在街角。
Historically, a badgeman was a recipient of charity. 從歷史上看，戴徽章的人是救濟金的領取者。
He kept badgering her about her bad habits. 他一直糾纏她，追問她的壞習慣。
To badger means to pester; to annoy persistently; to press. 這個字的意思是糾纏、持續惹惱，或逼問。
A badgerbrush is often used for shaving. 獾毛刷常用於刮鬍子。
He cleaned his shoes with a badgerbrush. 他用獾毛刷清潔鞋子。
He is a constant badgerer who never gives up. 他是一個不斷糾纏、永不放棄的人。
The reporter acted as a persistent badgerer. 記者表現得像個不依不饒的煩擾者。
She asked him badgeringly about the project. 她糾纏不休地向他詢問關於專案的事。
He spoke badgeringly to the clerk. 他對店員說話時顯得咄咄逼人。
He had a badgerlike determination to succeed. 他有一種像獾一樣堅忍不拔的成功決心。
The animal had a badgerlike appearance. 這種動物長得像獾。

meaning: 獾一般的，（引申）老年人特徵的
sentences: He had a badgerly grey beard. 他蓄著像獾毛一樣灰白的鬍鬚。
His badgerly habits were well-known to his friends. 朋友們都清楚他那像老獾一樣的習性。
Badgerweed grows abundantly in the valley. 紫草在山谷中大量生長。
The flowers of the badgerweed are bright yellow. 紫草的花朵是鮮黃色的。
Badiaga is used in homeopathic remedies. 淡水海綿用於順勢療法。
The chemist extracted substances from badiaga. 化學家從淡水海綿中提取了物質。
Badian is used to add flavor to soups. 八角用於為湯品增添風味。
The smell of badian filled the kitchen. 廚房裡充滿了八角的香味。
The mason used badigeon to hide the cracks. 石匠使用填縫劑來遮掩裂縫。
Apply badigeon carefully to the stone surface. 將填補料小心地塗抹在石頭表面。
They engaged in friendly badinage during dinner. 他們在晚餐時進行了友好的打趣。
He was known for his witty badinage. 他以幽默的戲謔著稱。
The horse had a beautiful badious coat. 這匹馬有一身漂亮的栗色毛髮。
He wore badious leather boots. 他穿著栗紅色的皮靴。
The area was a barren badland with no vegetation. 該地區是一片荒蕪、寸草不生的荒地。
They crossed the rugged badland on horseback. 他們騎馬穿越了崎嶇的荒地。
The Dakotas are famous for their badlands. 達科他州以其惡地地貌聞名。
Erosion created the striking landscape of the badlands. 侵蝕作用造就了惡地壯麗的景觀。
He was badly injured in the car accident and taken to hospital. 他在車禍中受重傷，被送往醫院。
The project was badly managed and failed to meet its goals. 該專案管理不善，未能實現其目標。
We enjoy playing badminton in the park every weekend. 我們喜歡週末在公園打羽毛球。
He is a very skilled badminton player on the school team. 他是校隊中一位技術精湛的羽毛球員。
The badness of the situation became clear. 情況的嚴重性變得清晰起來。
He apologized for the badness of his behavior. 他為自己的惡劣行為道歉。

meaning: 巴登山（亞瑟王傳說中的戰場所在地）
sentences: The Battle of Badon is a legendary victory. 巴登山之戰是一場傳奇性的勝利。
Historians debate the actual location of Badon. 歷史學家對巴登山的實際位置爭論不休。

meaning: 巴杜黑娜（日耳曼神話中的戰爭女神）
sentences: Baduhenna was worshipped by ancient Germanic tribes. 巴杜黑娜受到古代日耳曼部落的崇拜。
The forest was sacred to the goddess Baduhenna. 這片森林對女神巴杜黑娜來說是神聖的。
I'm going to the movies with my bae. 我要和我的心上人去看電影。
Bae, you look amazing today! 親愛的，你今天看起來太棒了！

meaning: 貝德克爾旅行指南，旅行指南
sentences: He consulted his Baedeker before exploring the city. 他在探索這座城市前查閱了他的旅行指南。
A Baedeker provides detailed maps and information. 旅行指南提供了詳細的地圖和資訊。

meaning: 貝德克爾指南式的，詳盡的
sentences: The report had a Baedekerian level of detail. 報告的詳細程度堪比旅行指南。
She gave a Baedekerian explanation of the site. 她對該遺址進行了極其詳盡的說明。
Baeria is a genus of flowering plants in the daisy family. 金球菊屬是菊科中的一屬開花植物。
The bright flowers of Baeria carpet the fields. 金球菊亮麗的花朵覆蓋了田野。
The baetuli were considered sacred in ancient times. 聖石在古代被認為是神聖的。
Archaeologists discovered ancient baetuli in the temple. 考古學家在神廟中發現了古代聖石。
The baetulus was believed to contain a divine presence. 聖石被認為蘊含著神性。
The priest stood before the baetulus. 祭司站在聖石前。
A baetyl is a sacred stone of meteoric origin. 聖石是一種源自隕石的神聖石頭。
Ancient cultures worshipped the baetyl as a god. 古代文化將聖石視為神靈崇拜。
The baetylic tradition was widespread in the region. 聖石傳統在該地區非常普遍。
They performed baetylic rituals at the site. 他們在該遺址舉行了聖石儀式。
The baetylus was placed in the center of the shrine. 聖石被安置在神龕中央。
Legends say the baetylus fell from the sky. 傳說聖石是從天上掉下來的。
The knight wore a sturdy baetzner. 騎士穿著一件堅固的短上衣。
The museum displays a well-preserved baetzner. 博物館展出了一件保存完好的中世紀短上衣。
The market sold bafaro in thick steaks. 市場把南美大型食用魚切成厚片賣。
We ate bafaro with lime and salt. 我們用萊姆和鹽吃那種南美大型食用魚。
He decided to baff the ball onto the green. 他決定將球輕擊上果嶺。
A baff shot requires a specific type of club. 擊地球需要一種特定的球桿。
The merchant sold fine baffeta from India. 商人販售來自印度的優質棉布。
She made a dress out of blue baffeta. 她用藍色棉布做了一件連衣裙。
The puzzle continues to baffle scientists. 這個謎題繼續讓科學家們感到困惑。
A baffle was installed to reduce the noise. 安裝了擋板以減少噪音。
He stared at the map in complete bafflement. 他完全困惑地盯著地圖。
The mystery was a source of great bafflement. 這個謎團讓人感到非常迷惑。
This riddle is a real baffler. 這個謎語真是讓人摸不著頭腦。
The engineer designed a new baffler for the engine. 工程師為發動機設計了一個新型隔板。
It was a baffling crime with no clues. 這是一宗沒有線索、令人費解的案件。
He found the instructions quite baffling. 他覺得這些說明相當令人困惑。

meaning: 令人困惑地，莫名其妙地
sentences: The situation changed bafflingly overnight. 情況在一夜之間莫名其妙地發生了變化。
He acted bafflingly during the interview. 他在面試中的表現令人費解。
The bafflingness of the situation frustrated everyone. 情況的費解讓每個人都感到挫敗。
She commented on the bafflingness of the book's ending. 她評論了這本書結局的令人費解之處。
He used his baffy to hit the ball over the hill. 他用擊地球桿把球打過山坡。
A baffy is an old-fashioned golf club. 擊地球桿是一種老式的高爾夫球桿。
Baft was commonly used for making sacks. 粗棉布常用於製作袋子。
The cloth was made of high-quality baft. 這塊布是由高品質的粗棉布製成的。
The merchant displayed various colors of bafta. 商人展示了各種顏色的粗棉布。
Bafta is a durable material for clothing. 粗棉布是製作服裝的耐用材料。

meaning: 巴菲奧特人（西非的一個族群）
sentences: The Bafyot people live in modern-day Cameroon. 巴菲奧特人生活在現代的喀麥隆。
He studied the culture and traditions of the Bafyot. 他研究了巴菲奧特人的文化和傳統。
She carried a heavy bag full of groceries. 她提著一個裝滿雜貨的重袋子。
Don't forget to take your school bag with you. 別忘了帶上你的書包。

meaning: 【植物】大葉野桐（某些地區的稱呼）
sentences: The baga tree is known for its large leaves. 這種大葉野桐以葉片巨大聞名。
Baga wood is used in local construction. 這種木材常用於當地建築。

meaning: 巴干達人（烏干達最大的族群）
sentences: The Baganda have a strong cultural identity. 巴干達人具有強烈的文化認同感。
He visited a Baganda village in Uganda. 他訪問了烏干達的一個巴干達村莊。
The bagani was respected for his bravery. 勇士因其勇敢而受到尊敬。
Legends tell of the great bagani of the past. 傳說講述了過去偉大的勇士。
Bagasse can be used as a fuel source. 甘蔗渣可以被用作燃料來源。
The factory processes sugar cane and produces bagasse. 工廠加工甘蔗並生產甘蔗渣。

meaning: （北美原住民）長曲棍球（早期形式）
sentences: Bagataway was a traditional game played by Native Americans. 長曲棍球是北美原住民玩的一種傳統遊戲。
The rules of bagataway were very different from modern lacrosse. 長曲棍球早期的規則與現代長曲棍球大不相同。
The cost of the repair was a mere bagatelle. 維修費用只是小事一樁。
The pianist played a charming bagatelle. 鋼琴家彈奏了一首迷人的短曲。

meaning: （舊時用語）義大利的一種小面額貨幣
sentences: A bagatine was worth very little. 這種小面額硬幣價值極低。
The collector showed me an ancient bagatine. 收藏家給我看了一枚古代的小硬幣。
They found a jar of old bagattini. 他們發現了一罐舊的小硬幣。
Bagattini were used in Venice for centuries. 這種小硬幣在威尼斯使用了好幾個世紀。
He kept a single bagattino as a souvenir. 他保留了一枚小硬幣作為紀念。
The value of a bagattino was negligible. 一枚小硬幣的價值微乎其微。

meaning: 巴高達運動者（羅馬帝國晚期起義農民）
sentences: The Bagaudae rebelled against heavy taxation. 巴高達運動者反抗沉重的稅收。
The Bagaudae caused significant instability in Gaul. 巴高達運動在加利亞造成了嚴重的動盪。

meaning: 巴格達（伊拉克首都，舊稱）
sentences: Bagdad is a city with a rich history. 巴格達是一座擁有豐富歷史的城市。
He traveled to Bagdad for research. 他前往巴格達進行研究。

meaning: 巴格迪人（印度和孟加拉的一個族群）
sentences: The Bagdi community is traditionally involved in fishing. 巴格迪社群傳統上從事漁業。
He wrote a report on the Bagdi population. 他寫了一份關於巴格迪人口的報告。
The shop prepared bagel before the lunch crowd arrived. 午餐人潮到來前，店家先準備好貝果。
The menu paired bagel with a light drink. 菜單把貝果搭配清爽飲品。
He brought home a bagful of groceries. 他帶回家滿滿一袋雜貨。
She collected a bagful of shells on the beach. 她在海灘上收集了滿滿一袋貝殼。
She tagged her baggage before boarding. 她登機前先把行李掛上標籤。
The porter stacked our baggage by the taxi. 行李員把我們的行李堆到計程車旁。
The baggageman helped the passengers with their suitcases. 行李管理員幫乘客搬運提箱。
He worked as a baggageman at the train station. 他在火車站擔任行李管理員。
The baggagemaster tagged each suitcase by hand. 行李主管親手給每個行李箱掛上標籤。
Passengers asked the baggagemaster where to claim their bags. 乘客問行李主管要去哪裡領行李。

meaning: 行李運送者，攜帶行李的人
sentences: The baggager followed the group with all the gear. 運送行李的人跟著大隊，帶著所有的裝備。
He hired a baggager for the expedition. 他為這次探險僱用了一名行李搬運工。

meaning: 阿拉伯式帆船，一種流行於阿拉伯海的傳統木製雙桅帆船，常用於貿易。
sentences: The traditional baggala sailed across the Arabian Sea for centuries. 這種傳統的阿拉伯式帆船在阿拉伯海上航行了數個世紀。
Merchants used the baggala to transport spices and textiles. 商人們使用阿拉伯式帆船來運輸香料和紡織品。

meaning: 一種捕魚用的網，通常指固定在水中的袋狀網。
sentences: The fisherman set a bagganet to catch the migrating salmon. 漁夫設置了一個袋狀漁網來捕捉遷徙中的鮭魚。
Checking the bagganet every morning is part of his routine. 每天早上檢查袋狀漁網是他日常生活的一部分。

meaning: 巴加拉人，非洲蘇丹和查德地區的游牧民族，以飼養牛群著稱。
sentences: The Baggara moved their cattle at dawn. 巴加拉人天亮時趕著牛群遷移。
A Baggara camp stood near the river. 河邊立著一處巴加拉人的營地。

meaning: 袋裝的；捕獲的；精疲力竭的（俚語）。
sentences: We bought several bags of bagged salad for the party. 我們為聚會買了幾袋裝好的沙拉。
The hunter bagged a large deer during the hunting season. 獵人在狩獵季節捕獲了一隻大鹿。

meaning: 裝袋工，在超市或工廠負責將物品裝入袋子的人或機器。
sentences: The bagger at the supermarket was very quick and efficient. 超市的裝袋工動作非常迅速且有效率。
An automated bagger can speed up the packaging process. 自動化裝袋機可以加速包裝過程。
Put the leftovers in a plastic baggie before refrigerating them. 在冷藏之前，把剩菜裝進一個小塑膠袋裡。
He prefers wearing baggie jeans for maximum comfort. 他更喜歡穿寬鬆的牛仔褲以獲得最大的舒適感。
The oversized sweater hung baggily on her thin frame. 那件寬大的毛衣鬆垮地掛在她瘦弱的身軀上。
His trousers fit baggily around the ankles. 他的長褲在腳踝處顯得鬆鬆垮垮。
The bagginess of the suit made him look unprofessional. 西裝的寬鬆感讓他看起來很不專業。
He complained about the bagginess of his old trousers. 他抱怨他那件舊長褲太鬆垮了。

meaning: 袋子的布料或其他材質。
sentences: The bagging tore after one hard pull. 那種袋料被用力一拉就裂開了。
We bought the bagging in a roll for the market stall. 我們買了一整卷袋布給市集攤位用。

meaning: 產卵後的魚；（蘇格蘭語）矮小或畸形的人或動物。
sentences: The fisherman released the baggit back into the river. 漁夫將那條產過卵的魚放回了河裡。
In local folklore, a baggit was often seen as a sign of bad luck. 在當地民俗中，矮小畸形的動物常被視為厄運的徵兆。

meaning: 寫作等的：過度勞累；鬆弛;填充太多。
sentences: a baggy book 一本鬆鬆垮垮的書
Something described as baggy is of writing, etc.: overwrought; flabby; having too much padding. 被描述為寬鬆的東西是指書寫等：過度勞累；鬆弛;填充太多。

meaning: 巴格里語，印度中部巴格爾坎德地區使用的一種語言。
sentences: Bagheli is primarily spoken in the state of Madhya Pradesh. 巴格里語主要在中央邦使用。
He is conducting research on the dialects of Bagheli. 他正在對巴格里語的方言進行研究。

meaning: 袋濾室，一種工業用的大型過濾裝置，用於清除廢氣中的顆粒物。
sentences: The factory installed a new baghouse to reduce air pollution. 工廠安裝了新的袋濾室以減少大氣污染。
Maintaining the filters in the baghouse is crucial for its efficiency. 維護袋濾室內的過濾器對其效率至關重要。

meaning: 陛下，馬來西亞和印尼對皇室成員的尊稱。
sentences: The people showed great respect whenever Baginda visited the village. 每當陛下訪問村莊時，人們都表現出極大的尊重。
Baginda signed the royal decree early this morning. 陛下今天清晨簽署了皇室法令。

meaning: 巴吉爾米，查德的一個地區、民族及該民族所說的語言。
sentences: The Bagirmi people have a rich history in the Lake Chad region. 巴吉爾米人在查德湖地區擁有豐富的歷史。
She is learning to speak Bagirmi to better understand their culture. 她正在學習說巴吉爾米語，以便更好地了解他們的文化。

meaning: 一種植物，其葉子常用於包裝或作為覆蓋物。
sentences: They used bagleaves to wrap the food before steaming it. 他們在蒸食物之前用植物大葉子將其包好。
The traditional roof was thatched with dried bagleaves. 傳統屋頂是用乾燥的植物大葉子鋪成的。
The spider created a baglike web to protect its eggs. 蜘蛛織了一個袋狀的網來保護它的卵。
Certain types of fungi have a baglike structure. 某些種類的真菌具有袋狀結構。

meaning: 袋子製造商；製作袋子的人。
sentences: The bagmaker stitched a tough canvas pouch before lunch. 那位製袋人午餐前縫好一個結實的帆布袋。
My grandfather was a bagmaker in the market district. 我祖父曾是市場區的製袋工人。

meaning: 袋子製造，製作各種袋子的工藝或過程。
sentences: He decided to take a course in bagmaking to start his own business. 他決定參加袋子製造課程，以便開始自己的事業。
Modern technology has simplified the process of bagmaking. 現代技術簡化了袋子製造的過程。

meaning: 收款員；（黑道或政界中）負責收受和分發賄賂或非法資金的人。
sentences: The bagman was caught by the police during the exchange. 收款員在交易過程中被警方抓獲。
In political scandals, the bagman often remains anonymous. 在政治醜聞中，負責分錢的人通常保持匿名。

meaning: 澡堂；妓院；（土耳其、北非等的）監獄。
sentences: The historical bagnio was a popular social gathering place. 這座歷史悠久的澡堂曾是受歡迎的社交聚會場所。
References to the city's bagnio can be found in old literature. 在古文學中可以找到關於這座城市澡堂的參考資料。

meaning: 一種植物的名稱（通常為地方性俗名）。
sentences: The children found a bagnut while playing in the forest. 孩子們在森林裡玩耍時發現了一顆植物果實。
Local legends say the bagnut has medicinal properties. 當地傳說這種植物果實具有藥用價值。

meaning: （菲律賓語）新的；在某些地區指一種發酵的魚醬（bagoong）。
sentences: He bought a bago car to celebrate his promotion. 他買了一輛新車來慶祝晉升。
Bago is a key ingredient in many traditional dishes. 魚醬是許多傳統菜餚中的關鍵成分。

meaning: 巴戈博人，菲律賓民答那峨島的一個原住民族群。
sentences: The Bagobo people are famous for their colorful woven fabrics. 巴戈博人以其色彩鮮豔的織物聞名。
Ancestral customs are still practiced by the Bagobo today. 巴戈博人至今仍保留著祖傳的習俗。
The soldiers fixed their bagonets to their rifles. 士兵們將刺刀固定在步槍上。
The antique bagonet was displayed in the military museum. 那把古董刺刀陳列在軍事博物館中。

meaning: 風笛，一種傳統的蘇格蘭簧片氣鳴樂器。
sentences: The sound of the bagpipe echoed through the highlands. 風笛的聲音在高地迴盪。
He spent years learning how to play the bagpipe. 他花了多年時間學習如何演奏風笛。
The bagpiper led the parade through the streets. 風笛手帶領遊行隊伍穿過街道。
A professional bagpiper was hired for the wedding ceremony. 婚禮上聘請了一位專業的風笛手。
She loves the traditional music played on the bagpipes. 她喜歡用風笛演奏的傳統音樂。
The bagpipes are synonymous with Scottish culture. 風笛是蘇格蘭文化的代名詞。

meaning: 袋狀植物，通常指具有袋狀器官的食蟲植物。
sentences: The bagplant traps insects to supplement its nutrients. 袋狀植物捕捉昆蟲以補充其養分。
Students studied the unique structure of the bagplant. 學生們研究了袋狀植物的獨特結構。

meaning: 黑簾石，一種含鈰的褐簾石變種礦物。
sentences: Bagrationite is often found in metamorphic rocks. 黑簾石常發現於變質岩中。
The geologist analyzed the composition of the bagrationite sample. 地質學家分析了黑簾石樣本的成分。

meaning: （西班牙語）鯰魚，通常指海鯰或淡水鯰魚。
sentences: They caught a large bagre while fishing in the river. 他們在河裡釣魚時抓到了一條大鯰魚。
Bagre is a common ingredient in South American soups. 鯰魚是南美湯品中常見的食材。

meaning: 一種特定的帆船縮帆方式或區域。
sentences: The captain ordered the crew to apply the bagreef as the wind picked up. 隨著風力增強，船長命令船員進行縮帆。
Properly setting the bagreef is essential for safety during a storm. 在風暴期間，正確設置縮帆對安全至關重要。

meaning: 行李寄存室；行李處理間。
sentences: The bagroom was crowded after the flight landed. 航班降落後，行李處理間很擁擠。
He left his suitcase in the bagroom. 他把行李箱放進行李寄存室。
The French baguette is known for its crispy crust. 法式長棍麵包以其酥脆的外殼而聞名。
He bought a fresh baguette to make sandwiches for lunch. 他買了一個新鮮的長棍麵包做午餐三明治。

meaning: 袋裝假髮，18世紀流行的一種假髮，其後部的真髮或假髮裝在一個小黑絲袋中。
sentences: The gentleman wore a silk bagwig to the formal ball. 那位紳士戴著絲製袋裝假髮參加正式舞會。
Bagwigs were a distinctive part of high-society fashion in the 1700s. 袋裝假髮是18世紀上流社會時尚的特色部分。
A bagwigged servant stood at the entrance of the mansion. 一位戴著袋裝假髮的僕人站在府邸入口處。
The portrait depicted a bagwigged magistrate from the past. 這幅肖像畫描繪了過去一位戴著袋裝假髮的法官。

meaning: 避債蛾幼蟲；蓑蛾幼蟲，其幼蟲會利用絲和植物碎屑建造袋狀的保護殼。
sentences: The bagworm hung from the branch of the cedar tree. 蓑蛾幼蟲掛在雪松樹的樹枝上。
Bagworms can cause significant damage to evergreen shrubs. 蓑蛾幼蟲會對常綠灌木造成重大損害。

meaning: （紋章學）一種虛構的野獸，類似羚羊但有山羊的角和馬的尾巴。
sentences: The noble family's coat of arms featured a gold bagwyn. 那個貴族家庭的紋章上有一隻金色的袋羚獸。
Historians researched the origins of the bagwyn symbol in heraldry. 歷史學家研究了紋章學中袋羚獸符號的起源。

meaning: 呸；哼，表示輕蔑、厭煩或不相信的感嘆詞。
sentences: "Bah! Humbug!" cried Scrooge in the famous story. “呸！騙人的！”史高治在著名的故事中叫道。
She said "Bah" when he told her another unbelievable excuse. 當他告訴她另一個令人難以置信的藉口時，她哼了一聲。

meaning: 巴哈伊教徒；巴哈伊教的。
sentences: He has been a devoted Bahai for most of his life. 他大半輩子都是一名虔誠的巴哈伊教徒。
The Bahai community is hosting an interfaith event this weekend. 巴哈伊社群將在本週末舉辦一場跨信仰活動。

meaning: 巴哈伊教，一種強調全人類團結一致的普世宗教。
sentences: Bahaism originated in Persia in the 19th century. 巴哈伊教起源於19世紀的波斯。
One of the key tenets of Bahaism is the oneness of religion. 巴哈伊教的核心教義之一是宗教大同。
As a Bahaist, she believes in the equality of men and women. 作為一名巴哈伊教徒，她相信男女平等。
The Bahaist delegation attended the international peace conference. 巴哈伊教徒代表團參加了國際和平會議。
We talked about Baham at lunch. 午餐時，我們談到了飛馬座θ星的傳統名稱。
A note beside the door mentioned Baham. 門邊的便條提到了飛馬座θ星的傳統名稱。

meaning: 巴哈馬（通常指巴哈馬群島中的一個）。
sentences: The cruise ship made a stop at a beautiful island in the Bahama chain. 郵輪在巴哈馬群島中的一座美麗島嶼停靠。
Tourism is a major industry throughout the Bahama region. 旅遊業是整個巴哈馬地區的主要產業。
She is proud of her Bahamian heritage and culture. 她為自己的巴哈馬遺產和文化感到自豪。
The Bahamian economy relies heavily on tourism and banking. 巴哈馬經濟嚴重依賴旅遊業和銀行業。

meaning: （馬來語/印尼語）材料；原料；資料。
sentences: We need to buy more bahan for the construction project. 我們需要為建築項目購買更多的材料。
The teacher prepared the bahan for the upcoming lesson. 老師為即將到來的課程準備了資料。

meaning: 巴哈爾，中東和東南亞地區使用的一種傳統重量單位。
sentences: The spice merchant measured the pepper in bahars. 香料商人用巴哈爾來計量胡椒的重量。
One bahar varied in weight depending on the location and the goods. 一個巴哈爾的重量取決於地點和貨物而有所不同。

meaning: 巴哈歐拉，巴哈伊教的創始人。
sentences: Bahaullah spent many years in exile and imprisonment. 巴哈歐拉在流放和囚禁中度過了多年。
The writings of Bahaullah form the core of the Bahai faith. 巴哈歐拉的著作構成了巴哈伊信仰的核心。

meaning: （印度）大人；將軍，對顯貴或軍事官員的尊稱。
sentences: The local bahawder was respected for his bravery in battle. 當地的大人因其在戰鬥中的英勇而受到尊敬。
Petitions were presented to the bahawder for his consideration. 請願書被提交給那位大人審閱。
A traditional "bahay kubo" is made of bamboo and nipa. 傳統的“巴海庫博”房屋是用竹子和尼帕葉建成的。
They are building a new bahay in the countryside. 他們正在鄉下建造一棟新房子。

meaning: 油欖仁，一種產於印度的喬木，其果實常用於阿育吠陀醫學。
sentences: The fruit of the bahera tree is a key component of Triphala. 油欖仁樹的果實是三果寶（Triphala）的關鍵成分。
Bahera is known for its various health benefits in traditional medicine. 在傳統醫學中，油欖仁以其多種健康益處而聞名。

meaning: 巴希亞石，一種主要由變質斜方輝石組成的岩石。
sentences: Bahiaite specimens were collected from the Bahia region of Brazil. 巴希亞石標本採集自巴西的巴希亞地區。
The petrologist studied the mineral structure of the bahiaite. 岩石學家研究了巴希亞石的礦物結構。

meaning: 巴希馬人，非洲大湖地區的一個牧民群體。
sentences: The Bahima people traditionally keep long-horned cattle. 巴希馬人傳統上飼養長角牛。
Cultural traditions of the Bahima are closely tied to their herds. 巴希馬人的文化傳統與他們的牛群緊密相連。

meaning: （印度）送水人，傳統上使用皮袋（mashak）運送水的人。
sentences: The bahisti was a common sight in the streets of old Delhi. 送水人是舊德里街道上常見的景象。
He carried a heavy skin of water, fulfilling his role as a bahisti. 他背著沉重的水袋，履行著送水人的職責。

meaning: 巴曼尼，指印度南部的巴曼尼蘇丹國及其相關事物。
sentences: The Bahmani Kingdom was a significant power in the Deccan. 巴曼尼蘇丹國是德干地區的重要勢力。
Islamic architecture flourished during the Bahmani period. 伊斯蘭建築在巴曼尼時期蓬勃發展。

meaning: 巴曼尼王朝的；巴曼尼王朝的成員。
sentences: The Bahmanid dynasty ruled for over two centuries. 巴曼尼王朝統治了兩個多世紀。
He studied the history of the Bahmanid sultans. 他研究了巴曼尼蘇丹的歷史。

meaning: （心理學/生理學）易化作用；路徑形成，指神經衝動在重複刺激後更容易通過的路徑。
sentences: The concept of bahnung explains how habits are formed in the brain. 易化作用的概念解釋了習慣是如何在大腦中形成的。
Bahnung is crucial for the process of learning and memory. 易化作用對於學習和記憶過程至關重要。
The singer had a deep baho voice that moved the audience. 歌手擁有深沉的低音，感動了觀眾。
He played the baho guitar in the traditional ensemble. 他在傳統樂團中演奏低音吉他。

meaning: （印尼語/爪哇語）肩部；也指一種傳統的土地測量單位。
sentences: The farmer inherited several bahoe of fertile land. 農夫繼承了幾巴荷（土地單位）的肥沃土地。
In some regions, the bahoe is still used for local agricultural transactions. 在某些地區，巴荷仍用於當地的農業交易。
The new bahoo was welcomed into the family with a grand ceremony. 新媳婦在隆重的儀式中被迎進家門。
The elder members of the family gave advice to the young bahoo. 家中的長輩給年輕媳婦提供建議。

meaning: 泰銖，泰國的法定貨幣單位。
sentences: The exchange rate for the baht has remained stable this month. 泰銖的匯率本月保持穩定。
He paid five hundred baht for the silk scarf. 他花了五百泰銖買了這條絲巾。

meaning: 巴胡馬人，非洲中部大湖地區的遊牧民族。
sentences: The Bahuma people are known for their expertise in cattle herding. 巴胡馬人以其放牛的專業知識而聞名。
Social status among the Bahuma is often measured by the size of one's herd. 在巴胡馬人中，社會地位通常由牛群的大小來衡量。

meaning: （阿拉伯語）海洋；在阿拉伯詩歌中指一種詩韻或律動。
sentences: Classical Arabic poetry uses several distinct bahurs. 古典阿拉伯詩歌使用幾種不同的律動。
The poet mastered the complex rules of the bahur. 詩人掌握了律動的複雜規則。

meaning: （法語）大型櫃子；櫥櫃；寶箱，通常指帶有圓頂蓋的古式櫃子。
sentences: The antique bahut was passed down through generations. 這個古董櫃子代代相傳。
She stored her precious linens in the carved bahut. 她將珍貴的亞麻布存放在雕刻精美的櫃子裡。

meaning: 胡圖族，非洲中部大湖地區的一個民族群體（Hutu的變體）。
sentences: The Bahutu people primarily engage in agriculture. 胡圖族人主要從事農業。
Oral traditions are an important part of Bahutu culture. 口述傳統是胡圖文化的重要組成部分。

meaning: （語言學）所有複合詞，一種特殊的複合詞，其意思是指具有某種屬性的人或物（如 "redhead"）。
sentences: In Sanskrit grammar, a bahuvrihi is a type of compound word. 在梵語語法中，所有複合詞是一種複合詞類型。
The English word "blockhead" can be considered a bahuvrihi. 英語單詞 “blockhead” 可以被視為一種所有複合詞。

meaning: 白雅尼主義，16世紀神學家白雅斯所提出的神學主張，後被教會譴責。
sentences: Baianism focused on questions of grace and original sin. 白雅尼主義集中在恩典和原罪的問題上。
The controversy surrounding Baianism lasted for decades. 圍繞白雅尼主義的爭議持續了數十年。

meaning: （阿留申群島）皮艇，通常由海豹皮製成，具有一到三個座艙。
sentences: The Aleut hunters paddled their baidarka through the cold waters. 阿留申獵人划著皮艇穿過寒冷的水域。
A traditional baidarka is light and highly maneuverable. 傳統皮艇輕便且機動性強。

meaning: 拜迪亞，印度孟加拉地區的一個傳統醫師種姓。
sentences: Members of the Baidya community were historically known as healers. 拜迪亞社群的成員在歷史上被稱為醫治者。
He belongs to the esteemed Baidya caste. 他屬於受人尊敬的拜迪亞種姓。

meaning: 拜拉屬，一種已滅絕的銀杏類植物，生存於三疊紀至白堊紀。
sentences: Fossil leaves of Baiera are characterized by their deeply lobed shape. 拜拉屬的化石葉片以其深裂的形狀為特徵。
Baiera was a widespread genus during the Mesozoic era. 拜拉屬是中生代分佈廣泛的一個屬。
The soldier fixed a baiginet to the rifle. 士兵把刺刀裝到步槍上。
A rusty baiginet hung on the fort wall. 城堡牆上掛著一把生鏽的刺刀。

meaning: 油炸餅；法式甜甜圈（通常拼作 beignet）。
sentences: We enjoyed warm baignets dusted with powdered sugar. 我們享用了撒上粉糖的溫熱油炸餅。
New Orleans is famous for its delicious baignets. 紐奧良以其美味的油炸餅而聞名。

meaning: 貝加爾石，透輝石的一種變種，發現於貝加爾湖地區。
sentences: The rock sample was identified as baikalite. 那塊岩石樣本被辨認為貝加爾石，一種透輝石變種。
Baikalite from the lake region drew the collector's eye. 來自貝加爾湖地區的貝加爾石吸引了收藏家。

meaning: 一種固體石油瀝青（地蠟的變體）。
sentences: The geologist scraped baikerinite from the seam. 地質學家從礦脈裡刮下固體石油瀝青。
Workers sealed the jar with baikerinite. 工人用那種固體石油瀝青封住了罐子。

meaning: 一種在貝加爾湖附近發現的地蠟或類似蠟的礦物。
sentences: Baikerite is used as a natural source of industrial wax. 這種礦物可作為工業蠟的天然來源。
The deposits of baikerite are found in specific geological layers. 這種礦床出現在特定地質層中。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語）木樁；繫牛用的樁子；小木盆。
sentences: He drove a baikie into the ground to tether the cow. 他在地上釘了一根木樁來繫牛。
She used a wooden baikie to carry water from the well. 她用一個木盆從井裡打水。

meaning: 保證金，通常是一筆錢，用於換取被捕者的釋放，作為該人出庭受審的保證。
sentences: He was granted bail for £20000. 他以 20,000 英鎊獲准保釋。
The bail arrived early to prepare for the day's work. 這位保證金，通常是一筆錢，用於換取被捕者的釋放，作為該人出庭受審的保證提早到場，準備一天的工作。

meaning: 可准予保釋的；可用於保釋的。
sentences: The offense was deemed bailable by the presiding judge. 主審法官裁定該罪行可以准予保釋。
He was released on a bailable bond pending his trial. 他在審判前以保釋金獲釋。

meaning: 保管費；寄放費；保釋費用。
sentences: The warehouse owner charged a small fee for bailage. 倉庫主人收取了一小筆保管費。
The bailage was paid to ensure the safe storage of the goods. 支付了保管費以確保貨物的安全存放。

meaning: 受託人，受託保管他人財產的人。
sentences: As the bailee, he is responsible for the safety of the items. 作為受託人，他負責這些物品的安全。
The legal rights of the bailee are clearly defined in the contract. 受託人的法律權利在合同中有明確定義。

meaning: （船用的）舀水具；負責保釋的人。
sentences: Use the plastic bailer to remove the water from the bottom of the boat. 使用塑膠舀水具將船底的水舀乾淨。
The bailer arrived at the police station with the required documents. 負責保釋的人帶著所需文件抵達了警局。
The prisoner was brought before the bailey at dawn. 囚犯在黎明時被帶到法院前。
Old records used bailey for a court or prison. 舊紀錄用這個詞指法院或監獄。
The bailie addressed the local council during the meeting. 市政官在會議期間向地方議會發表講話。
In the past, a bailie had significant administrative powers. 過去，市政官擁有顯著的行政權力。

meaning: 市政官的管轄區或官職（bailiwick 的變體）。
sentences: The boundaries of the bailiery were redrawn last year. 市政官管轄區的邊界去年重新劃定。
He served his term in the bailiery with great dedication. 他在管轄區內盡心盡力地履行職責。
His bailieship lasted for three consecutive terms. 他的市政官任期持續了連續三屆。
The duties of the bailieship included maintaining public order. 市政官的職責包括維護公共秩序。

meaning: 執達員；（地主的）管家；法警。
sentences: The bailiff arrived to serve the legal notice. 執達員抵達並送交法律通知。
The landlord appointed a bailiff to manage the estate. 地主委派了一名管家來管理莊園。

meaning: 執達員或管家的職位及管轄範圍。
sentences: He spent his entire career in the bailiffry. 他整個職業生涯都在執達員職位上度過。
The historical records mention the expansion of the bailiffry. 歷史記錄提到了執達員管轄範圍的擴大。

meaning: 執達員的官職、地位或任期。
sentences: The king granted him the bailiffship of the northern county. 國王授予他北部縣的執達員官職。
Accepting the bailiffship came with many responsibilities. 接受執達員官職伴隨著許多責任。

meaning: （執達員等的）管轄區；職權範圍；（個人的）專長或感興趣的領域。
sentences: Public relations is not really my bailiwick. 公共關係並非我的專長領域。
The sheriff's bailiwick extended over the entire valley. 警長的管轄範圍擴及整個山谷。

meaning: （法語）管轄區；職位（通常指中世紀法國的管轄區）。
sentences: The local court had jurisdiction over the entire bailliage. 當地法院對整個管轄區擁有管轄權。
Historical documents describe the tax system within the bailliage. 歷史文件描述了管轄區內的稅收制度。

meaning: （舞蹈）跳躍步法，一種在跳躍時一條腿彎曲並在著地前伸展的步法。
sentences: The dancer performed a graceful baillone across the stage. 舞者在舞臺上表演了一個優雅的跳躍步法。
Mastering the baillone requires strength and precision. 掌握這種跳躍步法需要力量和精準度。

meaning: 肉豆蔻屬（植物學名），一種熱帶常綠喬木，產出有價值的木材和種子油。
sentences: The Baillonella tree was tall and glossy. 那種熱帶常綠喬木又高又亮。
Wood from Baillonella is prized locally. 這種熱帶常綠喬木的木材在當地很受重視。

meaning: （法律）寄託，將財物交付他人保管但不轉移所有權的契約。
sentences: A standard bailment agreement protects both parties. 一份標準的寄託協議保護雙方的利益。
The legal case centered on a breach of bailment. 法律案件的核心是違反寄託契約。

meaning: 寄託人，將財產交給他人保管的人。
sentences: The bailor must ensure the goods are in good condition. 寄託人必須確保貨物狀況良好。
The bailor has the right to reclaim the property after the agreed time. 寄託人有權在約定時間後收回財產。

meaning: （法律）保釋狀，記載保釋人及保釋條件的法律文件。
sentences: The clerk prepared the bailpiece for the judge's signature. 書記官準備了保釋狀供法官簽署。
The details of the bond were specified in the bailpiece. 債券的細節在保釋狀中有所說明。

meaning: 保釋人，為他人提供保釋金的人。
sentences: He acted as a bailsman for his childhood friend. 他擔任他童年好友的保釋人。
The bailsman is legally obligated to ensure the defendant appears in court. 保釋人有法律義務確保被告出庭。

meaning: 一種特定的木材或植物部分的名稱（地方性俗名）。
sentences: They gathered bailwood from the forest to repair the fence. 他們從森林中收集木材來修理柵欄。
The density of bailwood makes it suitable for tool handles. 這種木材的密度使其適合製作工具手柄。
His bain reply ended the debate. 他簡短直接的回覆結束了爭論。
The cottage stood bain to the road. 那間小屋離道路很近。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語）多骨的；瘦骨嶙峋的（bony 的變體）。
sentences: The old man had long, bainie fingers. 那位老人有著長長且瘦骨嶙峋的手指。
The cow looked thin and bainie after the long winter. 漫長的冬天過後，這頭牛看起來又瘦又見骨。

meaning: 拜寧人，巴布亞紐幾內亞新不列顛島的一個原住民族群。
sentences: The map marked Baining in blue. 地圖上用藍色標出了拜寧人，巴布亞紐幾內亞新不列顛島的一個原住民族群。
My friend brought up Baining during the ride. 朋友在路上提起了拜寧人，巴布亞紐幾內亞新不列顛島的一個原住民族群。

meaning: 拜奧克，教宗國曾使用的銅幣單位（通常拼作 baiocco）。
sentences: He found an ancient baioc while metal detecting in Italy. 他在義大利進行金屬探測時發現了一枚古老的拜奧克硬幣。
The museum displayed a collection of baioc coins from the 18th century. 博物館展示了18世紀的一系列拜奧克硬幣。
The merchant counted several silver baiocchi on the table. 商人在桌上數了幾枚銀製的拜奧克硬幣。
Historical records show the value of baiocchi fluctuated over time. 歷史記錄顯示，拜奧克硬幣的價值隨時間而波動。

meaning: 拜奧克，以前在義大利部分地區（如教宗國）流通的小面額硬幣。
sentences: A single baiocco was worth very little in those days. 在那段日子裡，一枚拜奧克硬幣的價值微乎其微。
The design on the baiocco featured the papal coat of arms. 拜奧克硬幣上的圖案以教宗紋章為特色。

meaning: 印度教的一種苦行僧或托缽僧。
sentences: The bairagi sat quietly by the river, lost in meditation. 那位苦行僧安靜地坐在河邊，沉浸在冥想中。
Villagers often gave food and alms to the wandering bairagi. 村民們經常給流浪的苦行僧提供食物和施捨。

meaning: 開齋節或宰牲節，伊斯蘭教的兩個重要節日之一。
sentences: The whole family gathered to celebrate the festival of Bairam. 全家人聚在一起慶祝開齋節。
Traditional sweets are prepared and shared during Bairam. 在節日期間，人們會準備並分享傳統甜點。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語或北英格蘭語）小孩；幼兒。
sentences: The mother carried her sleeping bairn into the house. 母親把睡著的小孩抱進屋裡。
He is a fine young bairn with a bright future. 他是一個優秀的小孩，有著光明的未來。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語）小小孩；寶貝，對小孩的愛稱。
sentences: The grandmother sang a lullaby to her little bairnie. 奶奶給她的小寶貝唱了一首搖籃曲。
She rocked the bairnie in the wooden cradle. 她在木製搖籃裡搖著小孩。
His bairnish behavior during the meeting was quite embarrassing. 他在會議期間的孩子氣行為相當令人尷尬。
She dismissed the comment as a bairnish remark. 她將那番言論斥為幼稚的評論。
The bairnishness of his pranks began to tire his friends. 他惡作劇的孩子氣開始讓他的朋友們感到疲倦。
Despite his age, there was a certain bairnishness about him. 儘管他年事已高，但他身上仍有一種孩子氣。

meaning: 像孩子般的特質；孩子氣。
sentences: Her bairnliness was refreshing in such a serious environment. 在如此嚴肅的環境中，她的孩子氣令人耳目一新。
The painting captured the simple bairnliness of the rural children. 這幅畫捕捉到了農村孩子純樸的孩子氣。
He spoke in a bairnly tone to avoid responsibility. 他用孩子般的口氣說話以規避責任。
The bairnly innocence of the child touched everyone's heart. 孩子那孩子般的純真觸動了每個人的心。
The whole bairnteam gathered for the family reunion. 全家人（所有子孫）都聚在一起參加家庭團聚。
The estate was divided among the surviving bairnteam. 遺產在倖存的子孫之間進行了分配。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語）生育期；也指同一母親所生的一群孩子。
sentences: She had a large bairntime, raising seven children in total. 她生了一大群孩子，一共養育了七個小孩。
The story was passed down through the generations of her bairntime. 這個故事在她那一脈的子孫中流傳了下來。
The fields were covered in white bairnwort during the spring. 春天時，田野裡長滿了白色的雛菊。
Children used to make chains from the freshly picked bairnwort. 孩子們過去常把剛採摘的雛菊編成項鍊。

meaning: 拜斯，菲律賓內格羅斯島的一個城市。
sentences: Bais is well-known for its whale and dolphin watching tours. 拜斯市以其賞鯨和海豚之旅而聞名。
The sugar industry plays a vital role in the economy of Bais. 糖業在拜斯市的經濟中扮演著至關重要的角色。

meaning: （印度曆）二月，大約在西曆四月至五月間。
sentences: Baisakh usually falls in April or May. 拜薩赫月通常落在四月或五月。
They plan the harvest fair for Baisakh. 他們把收穫市集安排在拜薩赫月。
He was known in the village as a tough baister who never backed down. 他在村里以強悍的猛擊者著稱，從不退縮。
The old man told stories of a famous baister from the past. 老人講述了過去一位著名猛擊者的故事。
The fisherman used a small worm as bait to catch the fish. 漁夫用一條小蟲做餌來捕魚。
You shouldn't take the bait; he's just trying to provoke you. 你不應該上當（吞下誘餌）；他只是想挑釁妳。

meaning: 誘惑者；（用狗）折磨（公牛等）的人；騷擾者。
sentences: The crowd cheered as the baiter entered the arena. 當鬥牛者（以狗鬥牛者）進入競技場時，人群歡呼雀躍。
Online baiters often try to provoke emotional reactions. 網絡挑釁者經常試圖激發情緒反應。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語）兩者；兩個都（both 的變體）。
sentences: Baith of the sisters decided to attend the dance. 姐妹倆都決定去參加舞會。
It was a difficult decision for baith of them. 對他們兩個人來說，這都是一個困難的決定。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語）牧草茂盛的；適合放牧的。
sentences: The hillside was baittle and perfect for the sheep. 山坡上牧草茂盛，非常適合養羊。
Farmers looked for baittle land to settle their herds. 農民們尋找牧草茂盛的土地來安置他們的畜群。

meaning: （考古學）靈石；神石，指古代崇拜的具有神聖性質的隕石或石頭。
sentences: The ancient temple housed a sacred baitylos. 古老的神廟裡供奉著一塊神聖的靈石。
Researchers studied the cultural significance of the baitylos stones. 研究人員研究了靈石的文化重要性。

meaning: 粗呢，一種通常為綠色的粗羊毛織物，常用於覆蓋撞球桌或卡牌桌。
sentences: The billiard table was covered in high-quality green baize. 撞球桌上覆蓋著高品質的綠色粗呢。
She used a piece of baize to line the jewelry box. 她用一塊粗呢布襯在首飾盒裡。

meaning: （地理）山麓沖積平原，由多個沖積扇合併形成的傾斜平原。
sentences: The desert bajada stretched for miles along the base of the mountains. 沙漠的山麓沖積平原沿著山腳延伸了數英里。
Vegetation on the bajada is adapted to the arid environment. 沖積平原上的植被適應了乾旱的環境。

meaning: 巴貝多人的（俗稱）；巴巴多斯人。
sentences: He is a proud Bajan who loves his island home. 他是一個為自己的島嶼家園感到自豪的巴貝多人。
The Bajan dialect is unique and full of character. 巴貝多方言非常獨特且充滿特色。

meaning: 巴亞多，義大利利古里亞大區因佩里亞省的一個市鎮。
sentences: Bajardo is a picturesque village perched on a hilltop. 巴亞多是一座座落在山頂上的風景如畫的村莊。
Many tourists visit Bajardo for its stunning mountain views. 許多遊客因其迷人的山景而訪問巴亞多。

meaning: （印度）游牧民，通常指從事貿易或表演的流浪群體。
sentences: The bajarigar community moved from village to village to sell their goods. 游牧民社群從一個村莊搬到另一個村莊出售他們的貨物。
Ancient records describe the customs of the bajarigar people. 古代記錄描述了游牧民族的習俗。

meaning: 巴瑤族，東南亞的一個游牧民族，因常年在海上生活而被稱為“海上吉普賽人”。
sentences: The Bajau people are renowned for their extraordinary free-diving abilities. 巴瑤人因其卓越的自由潛水能力而聞名。
Traditional Bajau houses are built on stilts over the water. 傳統的巴瑤房屋是建在水上的高腳屋。

meaning: （地質學）巴柔階，中侏羅世的一個地層階段。
sentences: The Bajocian stage is known for its diverse ammonite fossils. 巴柔階以其多樣的菊石化石而聞名。
Rocks from the Bajocian period were analyzed by the geological team. 地質團隊分析了來自巴柔階時期的岩石。

meaning: 珍珠粟，一種在印度和非洲廣泛種植的穀物。
sentences: Bajra is a staple food in many dry regions of India. 珍珠粟是印度許多乾旱地區的主食。
The farmer harvested a large crop of bajra this season. 農民本季收穫了大量的珍珠粟。

meaning: 珍珠粟（bajra 的變體拼寫）。
sentences: Bajree flour is used to make traditional flatbreads. 珍珠粟粉被用來製作傳統的扁麵包。
He prefers the taste of bajree over other types of millet. 他更喜歡珍珠粟的味道，勝過其他類型的粟類。

meaning: 珍珠粟（bajra 的變體拼寫，常用於印度某些地區）。
sentences: Bajri is highly nutritious and drought-resistant. 珍珠粟營養豐富且抗旱。
The local market sells various products made from bajri. 當地市場出售各種由珍珠粟製成的產品。

meaning: （植物）一種熱帶喬木的名稱（地方性俗名）。
sentences: The bark of the bajury tree is used in traditional medicine. 這種樹的樹皮被用於傳統醫學。
Explorers documented the unique characteristics of the bajury plant. 探險家記錄了這種植物的獨特特徵。

meaning: （日語）笨蛋；傻瓜（在日語中極為常用）。
sentences: The character yelled "baka!" at his friend in the anime. 動漫中的角色對他的朋友大喊“笨蛋！”。
He felt like a baka after making such a simple mistake. 在犯了這麼簡單的錯誤後，他覺得自己像個傻瓜。

meaning: 巴凱里人，巴西馬托格羅索州的一個原住民民族。
sentences: The Bakairi people have maintained their traditional language and customs. 巴凱里人保留了他們的傳統語言和習俗。
She is studying the history and culture of the Bakairi tribes. 她正在研究巴凱里部落的歷史和文化。
The gate was made of strong bakal to provide security. 大門是用堅固的鐵製成的，以提供安全性。
He works in a factory that processes bakal and steel. 他在一家加工鐵和鋼的工廠工作。

meaning: 巴卡萊人，非洲加彭地區的一個族群。
sentences: The Bakalai people live in the dense forests of Gabon. 巴卡萊人居住在加彭茂密的森林中。
Anthropologists recorded the oral traditions of the Bakalai community. 人類學家記錄了巴卡萊社群的口述傳統。

meaning: 巴卡萊人（Bakalai 的變體拼寫）。
sentences: Ancient maps mark the territory of the Bakalei tribes. 古地圖標注了巴卡萊部落的領土。
The Bakalei were known for their hunting skills. 巴卡萊人以其狩獵技能聞名。

meaning: 巴卡坦人，婆羅洲的一個少數族群。
sentences: The Bakatan are one of the indigenous groups in Sarawak. 巴卡坦人是砂拉越的原住民群體之一。
Traditional Bakatan music uses unique bamboo instruments. 傳統巴卡坦音樂使用獨特的竹製樂器。
My mother is learning how to bake fresh bread and cakes. 我媽媽正在學習如何烘焙新鮮的麵包和蛋糕。
The smell of baking cookies filled the entire house. 烤餅乾的香味充盈了整個屋子。

meaning: 揉麵板；烘焙板，用於揉捏麵糰的木板。
sentences: She spread some flour on the bakeboard before kneading the dough. 她在揉麵糰之前在揉麵板上撒了一些麵粉。
An old wooden bakeboard was found in the farmhouse kitchen. 在農舍廚房裡發現了一個舊的木製揉麵板。

meaning: 由於吸毒（無論是真實的還是據稱的）而導致腦部最終受損。
sentences: Don't bother talking to that guy — he's baked from all the coke he used to do. 別費心和那傢伙說話了——他是用他以前喝的所有可樂烤出來的。
The report describes the result as baked. 該報告將結果描述為“烘焙”。

meaning: 麵包房；烘焙所，專門用於烘焙麵包和糕點的地方。
sentences: The delicious aroma of fresh bread wafted from the bakehouse. 新鮮麵包的誘人香氣從麵包房飄了出來。
Historically, many villages shared a communal bakehouse. 在歷史上，許多村莊共用一個公共麵包房。

meaning: 貝克萊特（酚醛樹脂），一種早期發明的合成塑膠，常用於電器絕緣體和裝飾品。
sentences: The antique radio was housed in a dark brown Bakelite case. 那台古董收音機裝在深褐色的貝克萊特外殼裡。
Bakelite was revolutionary because of its heat-resistant properties. 貝克萊特因其耐熱特性而具有革命性。

meaning: 酚醛樹脂（Bakelite 的通用稱呼）。
sentences: He collected old telephones made of bakelite. 他收集由酚醛樹脂製成的舊電話。
Check if the handle of the old pan is made of bakelite. 檢查一下那口舊平底鍋的手柄是否由酚醛樹脂製成。

meaning: 用酚醛樹脂處理；（使）變成酚醛樹脂狀。
sentences: The process was designed to bakelize the surface for extra durability. 該工藝旨在使表面酚醛樹脂化以增加耐用性。
Scientists investigated ways to bakelize different types of materials. 科學家們研究了使不同類型材料酚醛樹脂化的方法。

meaning: 烘烤過的（bake 的古舊過去分詞形式）。
sentences: The loaf was baken on a hot stone. 那條麵包是在熱石上烘烤過的。
The old note said the pie had been baken overnight. 那張舊紙條寫著派是整夜烘烤過的。

meaning: 烤爐；烘箱，專門用於烘焙的爐子。
sentences: The large bakeoven could fit several dozen loaves of bread. 這個大烤爐可以裝下幾打麵包。
They built a brick bakeoven in the backyard for making pizza. 他們在後院建了一個磚砌烤爐來做披薩。
Grease the bakepan before pouring in the cake batter. 在倒入蛋糕糊之前，先在烤盤上抹油。
She used a rectangular bakepan to make the brownies. 她用一個長方形烤盤來做布朗尼。

meaning: 烘焙和銷售麵包、蛋糕和類似物品的人。
sentences: The baker pulled fresh bread from the oven before sunrise. 天亮前，麵包師從烤箱取出新鮮麵包。
A careful baker weighs the flour before mixing the dough. 細心的麵包師會先秤好麵粉，再開始揉麵。

meaning: 麵包師的職業、身分或領域。
sentences: He has spent his entire life in the world of bakerdom. 他一生都沉浸在麵包師的職業生涯中。
Entering bakerdom requires early mornings and hard work. 進入麵包師這一行需要早起和辛勤工作。
The bakeress was famous for her specialty sourdough bread. 那位女麵包師以她特製的酸種麵包聞名。
She took over the family business and became a master bakeress. 她接管了家族生意，成為了一名大師級的女麵包師。

meaning: 矽硼鈣石，一種稀有的硼酸鹽礦物。
sentences: Bakerite crystals are usually white or translucent. 矽硼鈣石晶體通常是白色或半透明的。
The mineral was first identified in the mines of California. 這種礦物最初是在加州的礦山中被發現的。
The cook prepared bakerless for the evening meal. 廚師為晚餐準備了沒有麵包師的。
The menu paired bakerless with a light drink. 菜單把沒有麵包師的搭配清爽飲品。

meaning: 麵包師風格的；適合麵包師的。
sentences: The store was filled with bakerly tools and equipment. 店裡擺滿了麵包師用的工具和設備。
He showed off his bakerly skills by making a complex pastry. 他通過製作一款複雜的點心展示了他的麵包師技能。

meaning: 麵包師的職位、身分或技能。
sentences: He completed his apprenticeship and attained full bakership. 他完成了學徒期並獲得了正式的麵包師資格。
Modern bakership involves both traditional techniques and new technology. 現代麵包師技能涉及傳統技術和新技術。
I'm going to the local bakery to buy some fresh croissants. 我要去當地的麵包店買一些新鮮的可頌。
The bakery on the corner is famous for its delicious apple pies. 轉角那家麵包店以其美味的蘋果派聞名。

meaning: 麵包店；烘焙店（Bakery 的另一種說法）。
sentences: The bakeshop on the corner sells the best croissants in town. 轉角那家麵包店賣全鎮最好的牛角麵包。
She decided to open a small bakeshop in her neighborhood. 她決定在自家附近開一家小麵包店。

meaning: 烘焙石；烙餅石，用於烘烤薄餅或麵包的平整石塊或鐵板。
sentences: The traditional Welsh cakes were cooked on a hot bakestone. 傳統的威爾斯蛋糕是在熱烘焙石上烤製的。
Using a bakestone helps distribute heat evenly. 使用烘焙石有助於熱量均勻分佈。

meaning: 巴赫蒂亞里人，伊朗西南部的一個游牧民族；也指他們編織的地毯。
sentences: The Bakhtiari people migrate annually between summer and winter pastures. 巴赫蒂亞里人每年在夏季和冬季牧場之間遷徙。
She purchased a beautiful hand-woven Bakhtiari rug. 她買了一塊漂亮的手工編織巴赫蒂亞里地毯。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語）木樁；繫牛樁（baikie 的變體拼寫）。
sentences: Make sure the bakie is firmly planted in the ground. 確保木樁牢固地釘在地上。
He used a rope to tie the animal to the bakie. 他用繩子把動物繫在木樁上。
The kitchen smelled like baking bread. 廚房裡飄著烘烤麵包的香味。
Sunday baking is how he relaxes. 星期天烘烤是他放鬆的方式。
The sun beat down bakingly on the desert sands. 太陽像烘烤般地照射在沙漠的沙地上。
The kitchen was bakingly hot after a full day of cooking. 經過一整天的烹飪後，廚房熱得像烤爐一樣。

meaning: （印度）一种产于印度的乔木，其木材常用于建筑。
sentences: Carpenters used bakli for the beams. 木匠拿那種印度喬木的木材做樑。
A tall bakli shaded the courtyard. 一棵高大的印度喬木遮著院子。

meaning: 剛果族，非洲中部剛果河下游地區的一個民族。
sentences: The Bakongo people have a rich tradition of wood carving. 剛果族人擁有豐富的木雕傳統。
She researched the history and social organization of the Bakongo. 她研究了剛果族的歷史和社會組織。

meaning: 巴克沙伊什，波斯西北部的一個地區，以出產具有幾何圖案的編織地毯聞名。
sentences: Antique Bakshaish rugs are highly sought after by collectors. 古董巴克沙伊什地毯深受收藏家追捧。
The Bakshaish design is characterized by its bold, large-scale patterns. 巴克沙伊什設計的特點是其大膽的大型圖案。

meaning: 小費；賞錢；賄賂（常用於西南亞和北非）。
sentences: The porter expected a small baksheesh for carrying the bags. 搬運工期待為搬運行李獲得一點小費。
It was common practice to offer baksheesh to get things done quickly. 為了快點把事情辦好，給點賞錢是常見的做法。

meaning: 伯克盾，瑪雅曆法中長計曆的一個大週期，約等於 394 年。
sentences: The end of the 13th baktun occurred in December 2012. 第13個伯克盾的結束發生在2012年12月。
A baktun consists of 20 katuns. 一個伯克盾包含20個卡盾。

meaning: 巴庫，亞塞拜然的首都，位於裏海邊，是重要的石油中心。
sentences: Baku is known for its modern architecture and historic Old City. 巴庫以其現代建築和歷史悠久的舊城區而聞名。
The oil industry has significantly shaped the development of Baku. 石油工業顯著塑造了巴庫的發展。

meaning: 獏，日本神話中一種能吃掉噩夢的奇幻生物。
sentences: The field guide listed baku beside related species. 圖鑑把獏列在近緣物種旁。
The specimen label helped researchers identify baku. 標本標籤幫助研究人員辨認獏。

meaning: 巴庫巴人，非洲剛果民主共和國的一個民族群體，以其複雜的藝術和編織聞名。
sentences: Bakuba cloth is famous for its intricate geometric designs. 巴庫巴布料以其複雜的幾何圖案而聞名。
The Bakuba kingdom was highly organized with a sophisticated political structure. 巴庫巴王國組織嚴密，擁有複雜的政治結構。

meaning: 牛心梨，一種產於印度和東南亞的喬木，花朵芳香，常用於祭祀。
sentences: The fragrance of the bakula flowers filled the temple courtyard. 牛心梨花的香氣瀰漫在神廟的院子裡。
Women traditionally wear garlands made of bakula blossoms in their hair. 婦女傳統上在頭髮上戴著由牛心梨花製成的花環。

meaning: 巴昆達人，非洲剛果地區的一個族群。
sentences: The Bakunda people live primarily in the central regions of Congo. 巴昆達人主要居住在剛果的中部地區。
Traditional Bakunda dances are performed during agricultural festivals. 傳統的巴昆達舞蹈在農業節日期間表演。

meaning: 巴枯寧主義，由米哈伊爾·巴枯寧提出的無政府主義社會學說。
sentences: Bakuninism emphasizes the abolition of the state and all forms of hierarchy. 巴枯寧主義強調廢除國家和所有形式的層級制度。
He studied the ideological differences between Marxism and Bakuninism. 他研究了馬克思主義和巴枯寧主義之間的意識形態差異。

meaning: 巴枯寧主義者；支持巴枯寧主義的。
sentences: As a committed Bakuninist, he participated in several radical movements. 作為一名堅定的巴枯寧主義者，他參加了幾次激進運動。
Bakuninist ideas were influential in the early labor movement. 巴枯寧主義思想在早期工人運動中具有影響力。

meaning: 一種產於南美洲的喬木，其果實可食用且具有藥用價值。
sentences: The market sold bakupari fruit by the basket. 市場按籃賣那種南美喬木的果實。
He chewed a ripe bakupari on the walk home. 他回家路上嚼著一顆成熟的南美果實。

meaning: 巴庫圖人，非洲剛果盆地的一個族群。
sentences: The Bakutu people are skilled at navigating the river networks of the region. 巴庫圖人擅長在該地區的河流網絡中航行。
Anthropologists documented the unique burial rites of the Bakutu. 人類學家記錄了巴庫圖人獨特的葬禮儀式。

meaning: 巴克維里人，非洲喀麥隆地區的一個民族群體。
sentences: The Bakwiri people live on the slopes of Mount Cameroon. 巴克維里人居住在喀麥隆山的斜坡上。
Farming and fishing are the traditional livelihoods of the Bakwiri. 耕種和捕魚是巴克維里人的傳統生計。

meaning: 巴力，古代西亞地區崇拜的一個神祇名稱（Baal 的變體）。
sentences: In ancient Canaanite mythology, Bal was a major deity. 在古代迦南神話中，巴力是一位主要神祇。
Scholars have compared the different representations of Bal across various cultures. 學者們比較了巴力在不同文化中的不同表現形式。

meaning: （康瓦耳語）礦山（常用於康瓦耳的地名中）。
sentences: The historical site was once a thriving tin bal. 該歷史遺址曾是一個繁榮的錫礦山。
Many locals worked in the bal during the peak of the mining industry. 在採礦業高峰期，許多當地人在礦山工作。

meaning: 巴拉，威爾斯蓋內斯郡的一個城鎮，位於巴拉湖畔。
sentences: Bala is a popular destination for water sports and outdoor activities. 巴拉是水上運動和戶外活動的熱門目的地。
The town of Bala hosted the national cultural festival. 巴拉鎮舉辦了全國文化節。

meaning: 巴蘭，聖經中一位被雇來咒詛以色列人但最終被迫祝福他們的人。
sentences: The story of Balaam and his donkey is one of the most famous in the Old Testament. 巴蘭和他的驢子的故事是舊約中最著名的故事之一。
Balaam's prophecies were recorded in ancient religious texts. 巴蘭的預言被記載在古代宗教文本中。

meaning: 巴蘭的追隨者；像巴蘭一樣為利誘所動的人。
sentences: He was criticized as a Balaamite who prioritized money over integrity. 他被批評為一個將金錢置於誠信之上的巴蘭式人物。
The religious sect was often referred to as Balaamites by their opponents. 該教派常被反對者稱為巴蘭追隨者。

meaning: 巴蘭式的；虛假預言的；為利所動的。
sentences: The critic dismissed the speech as Balaamitical rhetoric. 評論家將那番演講斥為巴蘭式的虛假修辭。
His actions were seen as Balaamitical by his peers. 他的行為被同僚視為為利所動。

meaning: （馬來西亞/印尼）蝦膏，一種由發酵蝦或魚製成的鹹調味品。
sentences: Add a spoonful of balachong to the curry for extra flavor. 在咖哩中加入一勺蝦膏以增加風味。
The pungent aroma of balachong is a staple of Southeast Asian kitchens. 蝦膏那種辛辣的香氣是東南亞廚房的主角。

meaning: 巴拉克拉法帽，一種幾乎覆蓋整個頭部和臉部（僅露出眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴）的針織帽。
sentences: The skiers wore balaclavas to protect their faces from the freezing wind. 滑雪者戴著巴拉克拉法帽以保護臉部免受寒風侵襲。
A black balaclava was used by the robber to hide his identity. 搶劫犯戴著一頂黑色的巴拉克拉法帽來掩蓋身分。

meaning: 街頭舞者；雜技演員；女演員（尤其指在公共場所表演者）。
sentences: The baladine captivated the market crowd with her agile movements. 街頭舞者以其敏捷的動作吸引了市場的人群。
She traveled with a troupe of baladines across the country. 她隨同一個街頭舞者劇團走遍全國。

meaning: 露脊鯨屬（學名），鬚鯨科的一個屬，包括北極露脊鯨等。
sentences: The genus Balaena includes some of the largest creatures on Earth. 露脊鯨屬包括地球上一些最大的生物。
Biologists studied the migratory patterns of the species in the Balaena genus. 生物學家研究了露脊鯨屬物種的遷徙模式。

meaning: （鳥類學）鯨頭鸛亞目，鯨頭鸛所屬的一個分類群。
sentences: The member of Balaenicipites is famous for its large, shoe-shaped bill. 鯨頭鸛亞目的成員以其巨大的鞋狀鳥喙聞名。
Classification within Balaenicipites has been a topic of scientific debate. 鯨頭鸛亞目內部的分類一直是科學辯論的話題。

meaning: 露脊鯨科的；露脊鯨科動物。
sentences: The balaenid whales are characterized by a lack of dorsal fins. 露脊鯨科鯨類的特徵是缺乏背鰭。
Conservationists are working to protect endangered balaenid populations. 環保人士正致力於保護瀕危的露脊鯨科族群。

meaning: 露脊鯨科（學名），鬚鯨下目的一個科。
sentences: Balaenidae species are known for their slow swimming speed and high blubber content. 露脊鯨科物種以其緩慢的游泳速度和高脂肪含量著稱。
The evolution of Balaenidae has been tracked through fossil records. 露脊鯨科的演化已通過化石記錄得到追蹤。

meaning: 類鯨的；像鯨魚的（特別是像露脊鯨）。
sentences: The creature had a balaenoid appearance that intrigued the sailors. 那個生物具有類鯨的外貌，引起了水手們的好奇。
Specialized terms are used to describe the balaenoid features of marine fossils. 專門術語被用來描述海洋化石中類鯨的特徵。

meaning: 露脊鯨總科（學名），包括露脊鯨科和小露脊鯨科。
sentences: Balaenoidea is one of the major groups of baleen whales. 露脊鯨總科是鬚鯨類的主要群體之一。
Members of Balaenoidea occupy different ecological niches in the oceans. 露脊鯨總科的成員在海洋中佔據不同的生態位。

meaning: 露脊鯨總科的；露脊鯨總科動物。
sentences: Balaenoidean fossils provided insights into the history of whale evolution. 露脊鯨總科化石為鯨魚演化史提供了見解。
The distinctive jaw structure is a balaenoidean trait. 獨特的下顎結構是露脊鯨總科的一個特徵。

meaning: 鬚鯨屬（學名），鬚鯨科的一個屬，包括藍鯨、長鬚鯨等。
sentences: Balaenoptera is the most diverse genus of extant baleen whales. 鬚鯨屬是現存鬚鯨中多樣性最高的一個屬。
The blue whale belongs to the genus Balaenoptera. 藍鯨屬於鬚鯨屬。

meaning: 鬚鯨科（學名），鬚鯨下目的一個科，俗稱長鬚鯨類。
sentences: Balaenopteridae members are characterized by throat pleats that allow for bulk feeding. 鬚鯨科成員的特徵是擁有喉褶，可以進行大口吞食。
Marine biologists conducted a survey of Balaenopteridae in the North Atlantic. 海洋生物學家對北大西洋的鬚鯨科動物進行了調查。

meaning: 巴拉風，一種產於西非的傳統木琴。
sentences: The balafo player used two wooden mallets to produce a melodic sound. 巴拉風演奏者使用兩個木槌發出悅耳的聲音。
Learning to play the balafo requires a good sense of rhythm. 學習演奏巴拉風需要良好的節奏感。

meaning: 混亂；大雜燴；（俄語/意第緒語）熱鬧喧嘩的場所或情況。
sentences: The party turned into a complete balagan after more people arrived. 隨著更多人到來，派對變成了一團混亂。
Dealing with the bureaucratic paperwork was a real balagan. 處理那些官僚主義的文書工作簡直是亂成一團。

meaning: 巴拉格特，印度中央邦的一個城市及行政區。
sentences: Balaghat is known for its rich deposits of manganese and copper. 巴拉格特以其豐富的錳和銅礦床而聞名。
The dense forests surrounding Balaghat are home to diverse wildlife. 巴拉格特周圍茂密的森林是多樣野生動物的家園。

meaning: （馬來語/印尼語）會堂；辦公廳；公共場所。
sentences: The elders met in the balai to settle a dispute. 長者們在會堂裡商量如何解決爭執。
The town balai served as a public hall on market days. 鎮上的公共場所會在市集日開放使用。

meaning: 帕拉語（巴拉語），一種古代在安那托利亞使用的已滅絕印歐語言。
sentences: Balaic was one of the languages spoken in the Hittite Empire. 帕拉語是西台帝國使用的語言之一。
Researchers analyzed Balaic inscriptions found on ancient clay tablets. 研究人員分析了在古代泥板上發現的帕拉語銘文。

meaning: 巴勒，聖經中摩押地的國王，曾雇請巴蘭咒詛以色列人。
sentences: Balak feared the Israelites and sought spiritual intervention against them. 巴勒懼怕以色列人，並尋求對他們的靈魂介入。
The interaction between Balak and Balaam is a central theme of the biblical narrative. 巴勒與巴蘭之間的互動是聖經敘事的核心主題。

meaning: 巴拉克拉法，克里米亞的一個地區，克里米亞戰爭期間曾發生著名的戰役。
sentences: The Battle of Balaklava is remembered for the Charge of the Light Brigade. 巴拉克拉法戰役因輕騎兵旅的衝鋒而被世人銘記。
Balaklava has a deep natural harbor that was strategically important. 巴拉克拉法有一個具有重要戰略意義的深天然港。

meaning: 巴拉萊卡琴（三角琴），一種俄羅斯傳統弦樂器，琴身呈三角形，通常有三根弦。
sentences: The musician performed a traditional Russian folk song on the balalaika. 音樂家用巴拉萊卡琴演奏了一首俄羅斯傳統民歌。
A balalaika orchestra produces a distinctive and vibrant sound. 巴拉萊卡琴管弦樂團能發出獨特而充滿活力的聲音。

meaning: 巴蘭，（紋章學）指一種特定的符號或名稱；也可能是人名或地名。
sentences: The knight's shield featured the emblem of Balan. 騎士的盾牌上刻有巴蘭的徽章。
Balan is a character that appears in various Arthurian legends. 巴蘭是亞瑟王傳奇中出現的一個角色。
It's important to maintain a healthy balance between work and life. 在工作與生活之間保持健康的平衡很重要。
She struggled to keep her balance on the slippery ice. 她努力在濕滑的冰面上保持平衡。
The heavy load was designed to be balanceable on the truck. 重物被設計成可以在卡車上保持平衡。
Financial experts analyzed whether the budget deficits were balanceable. 財務專家分析了預算赤字是否可以平衡。

meaning: 含有適當比例的元素；所有尺寸均按比例加權，因此不太可能翻倒。
sentences: He believed he rarely got sick because of his balanced diet. 他相信，由於飲食均衡，他很少生病。
The report describes the result as balanced. 報告稱結果是平衡的。
The balancedness of the composition made the painting visually appealing. 構圖的平衡感使這幅畫在視覺上具有吸引力。
Athletes work on their balancedness to improve performance. 運動員致力於提高他們的平衡感以提升表現。

meaning: 雙桅小帆船，地中海地區常用的一種小型兩桅帆船。
sentences: The balancelle glided smoothly over the calm waters of the Mediterranean. 雙桅小帆船在地中海平靜的水面上平穩滑行。
Local fishermen still use the balancelle for their daily work. 當地漁民仍在使用這種雙桅小帆船進行日常工作。

meaning: 負責平衡操作的人員；（鐘錶業）擺輪操作員。
sentences: The balanceman adjusted the heavy machinery to ensure smooth operation. 平衡操作員調整了重型機械以確保運行平穩。
In the factory, the balanceman's role is critical for product quality. 在工廠裡，平衡操作員的角色對產品質量至關重要。

meaning: 平衡；均勻分佈；平衡動作。
sentences: The rhythmic balancement of the dancer was captivating. 舞者節奏感的平衡動作令人著迷。
Engineers calculated the balancement of forces acting on the bridge. 工程師計算了作用在橋樑上的力的平衡。

meaning: 平衡物；平衡裝置；負責平衡的人。
sentences: The technician installed a new balancer to reduce vibrations in the engine. 技術員安裝了新的平衡器以減少引擎的振動。
He acted as a balancer between the two conflicting parties. 他在衝突雙方之間充當平衡者的角色。

meaning: 就平衡而言；在平衡方面。
sentences: Balancewise, the new design is much more stable than the old one. 就平衡而言，新設計比舊設計穩定得多。
The team analyzed the project balancewise before moving forward. 在繼續進行之前，團隊從平衡的角度分析了該項目。
The acrobat performed a delicate balancing act on the tightrope. 雜技演員在走鋼絲時表演了一場精妙的平衡動作。
Balancing work and life is a challenge for many professionals. 對於許多專業人士來說，平衡工作和生活是一項挑戰。

meaning: 一種小型沿海帆船（通常拼作 bilander）。
sentences: The balander was used for transporting goods along the coast. 這種雙桅小帆船被用於沿海運輸貨物。
Historians identified the ship in the painting as a traditional balander. 歷史學家將畫中的船辨認為一艘傳統的雙桅小帆船。

meaning: 單桅帆船；小船（常用於西班牙語地區）。
sentences: The balandra anchored in the quiet cove for the night. 單桅帆船在安靜的小海灣停泊了一夜。
Local merchants used the balandra to ferry supplies between islands. 當地商人使用單桅帆船在島嶼之間運送物資。

meaning: 一種寬大的中世紀披風或大衣，通常有袖子。
sentences: The traveler wore a heavy balandrana to keep warm during his journey. 旅行者穿著一件沉重的披風以在旅途中保暖。
The museum displayed a well-preserved wool balandrana from the 13th century. 博物館展示了一件保存完好的13世紀羊毛披風。

meaning: 洗浴學，研究洗浴及其對健康影響的科學。
sentences: The ancient Greeks were pioneers in the field of balaneutics. 古希臘人是洗浴學領域的先驅。
He published a thesis on the modern applications of balaneutics in therapy. 他發表了一篇關於洗浴學在現代療法中應用的論文。

meaning: 巴朗蓋，菲律賓的一種傳統大型木製船隻，也是菲律賓最小行政單位「村」的起源。
sentences: Archaeologists discovered the remains of an ancient balangay in Butuan. 考古學家在武端發現了古代巴朗蓋船的遺骸。
The balangay represents the seafaring heritage of the Filipino people. 巴朗蓋船代表了菲律賓人的航海遺產。
The physician examined the patient for any signs of balanic inflammation. 醫生檢查了病人是否有任何陰莖頭炎症的跡象。
Scientific papers describe the anatomy of the balanic region in detail. 科學論文詳細描述了陰莖頭區域的解剖結構。
The balanid crustaceans were firmly attached to the rocky shore. 藤壺類甲殼動物牢牢地附著在岩石海岸上。
Researchers studied the growth rates of balanid colonies in the intertidal zone. 研究人員研究了潮間帶藤壺群落的生長速度。

meaning: 藤壺科（學名），甲殼亞門蔓足綱的一個科。
sentences: Balanidae species are common biofouling organisms on ship hulls. 藤壺科物種是船體上常見的生物附著生物。
The classification of Balanidae includes many genera found worldwide. 藤壺科的分類包括許多在全球範圍內發現的屬。
The balaniferous oak trees provided a steady source of food for the wildlife. 結橡實的橡樹為野生動物提供了穩定的食物來源。
Botanists classified the forest as primarily balaniferous woodland. 植物學家將該森林歸類為主要產生橡實的林地。

meaning: （醫學）塞劑療法，指使用栓劑或塞劑的治療方法。
sentences: The historical medical text discussed the effectiveness of balanism for certain ailments. 歷史醫學文獻討論了塞劑療法對某些疾病的有效性。
Early practitioners used various natural substances in balanism. 早期從業者在塞劑療法中使用各種天然物質。

meaning: （醫學）陰莖頭炎（常用拼寫為 balanitis）；（地質）一種化石藤壺。
sentences: The geologist identified the fossil as a primitive balanite. 地質學家將該化石辨認為一種原始的化石藤壺。
Proper hygiene is essential to prevent the development of balanite. 良好的衛生習慣對於預防陰莖頭炎至關重要。

meaning: 沙漠椰子屬（學名），蒺藜科的一個屬，包括一些產於非洲和亞洲的耐旱喬木。
sentences: The oil from Balanites aegyptiaca seeds has many industrial uses. 沙漠椰子種子中的油具有許多工業用途。
Balanites trees are important for desert reforestation projects. 沙漠椰子樹對於沙漠再造林項目非常重要。

meaning: （醫學）陰莖頭炎，指陰莖頭端的炎症。
sentences: Balanitis can be caused by bacterial or fungal infections. 陰莖頭炎可能由細菌或真菌感染引起。
The patient was prescribed an ointment to treat the balanitis. 病人被開了藥膏來治療陰莖頭炎。

meaning: （醫學）淋菌性陰莖頭炎，伴有膿性分泌物的陰莖頭炎症。
sentences: Balanoblennorrhea is a severe complication of certain infections. 淋菌性陰莖頭炎是某些感染的嚴重併發症。
Immediate medical intervention is required for cases of balanoblennorrhea. 淋菌性陰莖頭炎病例需要立即進行醫療干預。
The surgical specialist explained the causes of balanocele to the student. 外科專家向學生解釋了陰莖頭突出的原因。
A balanocele can cause discomfort and require corrective surgery. 陰莖頭突出會引起不適並需要矯正手術。

meaning: （動物學）柱頭蟲目（學名），半索動物門腸鰓綱的一個目。
sentences: Members of Balanoglossida are marine burrowing animals. 柱頭蟲目的成員是海洋穴居動物。
The developmental biology of Balanoglossida provides clues to chordate evolution. 柱頭蟲目的發育生物學為脊索動物的演化提供了線索。

meaning: 柱頭蟲屬（學名），一種生活在沙灘泥沙中的蠕蟲狀海洋動物。
sentences: Balanoglossus is characterized by its three-part body: proboscis, collar, and trunk. 柱頭蟲的特徵是其三部分的身體：吻、領和軀幹。
Students collected Balanoglossus specimens during their field trip to the coast. 學生們在沿海考察期間收集了柱頭蟲標本。

meaning: （解剖學/動物學）像陰莖頭的；像橡子的；像藤壺的。
sentences: The fruit of the plant has a distinctive balanoid shape. 該植物的果實具有獨特的橡子形狀。
The researcher noted the balanoid structure of the marine organism. 研究人員注意到了該海洋生物的類藤壺結構。

meaning: 蛇菰屬（學名），蛇菰科的一個屬，均為寄生草本植物。
sentences: Balanophora species lack chlorophyll and obtain nutrients from host roots. 蛇菰屬物種缺乏葉綠素，從寄主根部獲取養分。
The fleshy inflorescences of Balanophora are often used in traditional medicine. 蛇菰屬肉質的花序常被用於傳統醫學。

meaning: 蛇菰科（學名），檀香目下的一個全寄生植物科。
sentences: Plants in the Balanophoraceae family are found mainly in tropical regions. 蛇菰科植物主要發現於熱帶地區。
The unique morphology of Balanophoraceae makes them interesting for botanical study. 蛇菰科獨特的形態使其在植物學研究中非常有趣。

meaning: 蛇菰科的；屬於蛇菰科植物的。
sentences: Balanophoraceous parasites can significantly impact the health of their host trees. 蛇菰科寄生植物會顯著影響寄主樹木的健康。
The field guide described several balanophoraceous species native to the area. 田野指南描述了幾種原產於該地區的蛇菰科物種。

meaning: （植物）蛇菰科植物的成員；也指產生橡實的部分。
sentences: The balanophore was carefully extracted from the forest floor. 蛇菰科植物被小心地從森林地表採集出來。
Scientific illustrations showed the detailed structure of a typical balanophore. 科學插圖展示了一個典型蛇菰科植物的詳細結構。

meaning: （化學）蛇菰素，從蛇菰科植物中提取的一種蠟狀物質。
sentences: Balanophorin was once used in the production of traditional torches. 蛇菰素曾被用於製作傳統火把。
The chemical properties of balanophorin were analyzed in the laboratory. 蛇菰素的化學性質在實驗室中進行了分析。

meaning: （醫學）陰莖頭成形術，對陰莖頭進行的外科修復或整形手術。
sentences: The urologist performed a successful balanoplasty to correct a congenital defect. 泌尿科醫生成功進行了陰莖頭成形術以糾正先天缺陷。
Recovery from balanoplasty typically takes several weeks. 陰莖頭成形術的恢復通常需要幾週時間。

meaning: （醫學）陰莖頭包皮炎，指陰莖頭和包皮同時發生的炎症。
sentences: Symptoms of balanoposthitis include redness, swelling, and itching. 陰莖頭包皮炎的症狀包括紅腫和瘙癢。
Balanoposthitis is more common in uncircumcised males. 陰莖頭包皮炎在未受割禮的男性中更為常見。
The balanopreputial space can harbor bacteria if not cleaned properly. 如果清潔不當，陰莖頭包皮腔可能會滋生細菌。
Adhesions in the balanopreputial area were treated by the doctor. 陰莖頭包皮區域的粘連由醫生進行了處理。

meaning: 橡實木屬（學名），橡實木科的一個屬，主要產於新喀里多尼亞。
sentences: Balanops is a genus of small trees and shrubs with distinctive drupes. 橡實木屬是一個由小喬木和灌木組成的屬，具有獨特的核果。
Botanists explored the remote islands to find rare Balanops specimens. 植物學家探索偏遠島嶼以尋找稀有的橡實木屬標本。

meaning: 橡實木科（學名），金虎尾目下的一個科（過去曾獨立成目）。
sentences: Balanopsidaceae is a small plant family with limited geographic distribution. 橡實木科是一個地理分佈有限的小科。
The phylogenetic position of Balanopsidaceae has been clarified by DNA analysis. 橡實木科的系統發育位置已通過 DNA 分析得到澄清。

meaning: （植物學）橡實木目（學名），一個曾被使用的植物分類目，現通常歸入金虎尾目。
sentences: Earlier classification systems recognized Balanopsidales as a distinct order. 早期的分類系統將橡實木目視為一個獨立的目。
Study of Balanopsidales provided insights into the flora of the South Pacific. 對橡實木目的研究為南太平洋的植物群提供了見解。

meaning: （醫學）陰莖頭出血；也指從包皮下流出膿液。
sentences: Balanorrhagia is a serious symptom that requires urgent medical attention. 陰莖頭出血是一個嚴重的症狀，需要緊急醫療關注。
The patient presented with balanorrhagia and acute pain. 病人表現出陰莖頭出血和劇烈疼痛。

meaning: 巴蘭塔人，非洲幾內亞比索及其鄰國的一個族群。
sentences: The Balanta people are the largest ethnic group in Guinea-Bissau. 巴蘭塔人是幾內亞比索最大的民族群體。
The social structure of the Balanta is traditionally based on age sets. 巴蘭塔人的社會結構傳統上基於年齡組。

meaning: 巴蘭塔人（Balanta 的變體拼寫）。
sentences: Balante traditional music features unique percussion instruments. 巴蘭塔傳統音樂具有獨特的打擊樂器。
Historical accounts describe the Balante's resistance to colonial rule. 歷史記載描述了巴蘭塔人對殖民統治的反抗。

meaning: （醫學）小袋蟲的；由小袋蟲引起的。
sentences: Balantidial infection is usually contracted from contaminated water. 小袋蟲感染通常是通過受污染的水傳播的。
The lab results confirmed a balantidial presence in the sample. 實驗室結果確認樣本中存在小袋蟲。

meaning: （醫學）小袋蟲病，一種由大腸小袋蟲引起的腸道寄生蟲病。
sentences: Balantidiasis can cause severe dysentery and abdominal pain. 小袋蟲病會引起嚴重的痢疾和腹痛。
Proper sanitation is the best way to prevent balantidiasis. 良好的衛生設施是預防小袋蟲病的最佳方法。

meaning: 小袋蟲病的；與小袋蟲相關的。
sentences: The patient was treated for balantidic dysentery with antibiotics. 病人因小袋蟲性痢疾接受了抗生素治療。
Balantidic organisms were observed under the microscope. 在顯微鏡下觀察到了小袋蟲類生物。
The prevalence of balantidiosis is higher in areas where pigs are raised. 小袋蟲病的流行率在養豬地區較高。
Doctors monitored the outbreak of balantidiosis in the village. 醫生們監測了村莊裡小袋蟲病的爆發情況。

meaning: 小袋蟲屬（學名），一類寄生於人類及其他脊椎動物腸道內的纖毛蟲。
sentences: Balantidium coli is the only member of this genus known to infect humans. 大腸小袋蟲是該屬中唯一已知會感染人類的成員。
The study focused on the life cycle of various Balantidium species. 該研究側重於各種小袋蟲物種的生命週期。

meaning: 藤壺屬（學名），藤壺科的一個屬，包括許多常見的海岸藤壺。
sentences: Balanus improvisus can survive in brackish water environments. 突脊藤壺可以在鹹淡水環境中生存。
The hull of the ship was covered in thousands of tiny Balanus individuals. 船體上覆蓋著數以千計的小藤壺。

meaning: （菲律賓語）一種傳統的小型木船；也指厄瓜多的一個市鎮。
sentences: The fishermen rowed their balao out to the reef at sunrise. 漁民們在日出時划著他們的小船前往珊瑚礁。
Balao is located in the Guayas province of Ecuador. 巴勞地位於厄瓜多的瓜亞斯省。

meaning: 半嘴魚；鱵魚，一種具有長下頜的小型魚類。
sentences: The balao leaped out of the water to escape the predator. 半嘴魚跳出水面以逃避捕食者。
Balao are often used as live bait for larger game fish. 半嘴魚常用作大型游釣魚的活餌。

meaning: 巴拉羅摩，印度教神祇，黑天的兄長，常被描繪為手持犁耙。
sentences: Balarama is considered an avatar of the thousand-headed serpent Shesha. 巴拉羅摩被認為是千頭蛇神舍沙的化身。
The festival celebrated the birth and deeds of Lord Balarama. 節日慶祝了巴拉羅摩神的誕生和事蹟。

meaning: 巴拉斯紅寶石，一種淺紅色的尖晶石，曾被誤認為是真正的紅寶石。
sentences: The crown was adorned with several large balas rubies. 王冠上裝飾著幾顆大型巴拉斯紅寶石（紅尖晶石）。
Balas is softer than true ruby but still a beautiful gemstone. 巴拉斯紅寶石比真正的紅寶石軟，但仍是一種美麗的寶石。

meaning: 巴拉塔樹；巴拉塔膠，從某些熱帶美洲喬木中提取的類似杜仲膠的物質。
sentences: Balata was historically used to make high-quality golf ball covers. 巴拉塔膠在歷史上被用來製造高品質的高爾夫球皮。
Workers harvested the latex from the balata tree in the rainforest. 工人在熱帶雨林中從巴拉塔樹上採集乳膠。
She made a delicious dessert using boiled balatong and coconut milk. 她用煮熟的綠豆和椰奶做了一道美味的甜點。
Balatong is a nutritious and affordable source of protein. 綠豆是一種營養豐富且價格實惠的蛋白質來源。

meaning: （古羅馬）小丑；弄臣；愛說笑的人。
sentences: The balatron entertained the guests at the feast with witty jokes. 弄臣在宴會上用風趣的笑話娛樂賓客。
In ancient literature, a balatron was often depicted as a parasite. 在古代文學中，弄臣常被描繪成寄生者。

meaning: 小丑般的；滑稽的；愛胡鬧的。
sentences: His balatronic antics kept the children laughing all afternoon. 他那小丑般的滑稽動作讓孩子們笑了一整個下午。
The king grew tired of the courtier's balatronic behavior. 國王對那名朝臣滑稽胡鬧的行為感到厭倦。

meaning: （植物）石榴果，石榴的一種多室、多種子、具韌性果皮的果實。
sentences: Botanically, the pomegranate is classified as a balausta. 從植物學上講，石榴被歸類為石榴果。
A balausta is characterized by its numerous seeds surrounded by pulpy tissue. 石榴果的特徵是其眾多的種子被果肉組織包圍。

meaning: 石榴花的；石榴紅色的；也指石榴花。
sentences: She wore a beautiful balaustine dress to the garden party. 她穿著一件漂亮的石榴紅連衣裙參加園遊會。
Balaustine flowers were dried and used in traditional herbal teas. 石榴花被曬乾並用於傳統草本茶中。
The stone balaustre supported the handrail of the grand staircase. 石製欄杆柱支撐著宏偉樓梯的扶手。
Skilled craftsmen carved the intricate designs into each balaustre. 熟練的工匠在每根欄杆柱上雕刻出複雜的圖案。

meaning: 巴拉瓦人，澳洲原住民的一個族群；也指其語言。
sentences: The Balawa people have a deep spiritual connection to their ancestral lands. 巴拉瓦人與他們的祖傳土地有著深厚的精神聯繫。
Linguists are working to document the unique features of the Balawa language. 語言學家正致力於記錄巴拉瓦語言的獨特特徵。

meaning: 巴拉武，指非洲或大洋洲某些地區的族群或相關事物。
sentences: The Balawu community maintains traditional practices in their daily lives. 巴拉武社群在日常生活中保持著傳統做法。
