Local legends of the Balawu have been passed down for generations. 巴拉武的當地傳說已代代相傳。

meaning: 巴波亞，巴拿馬的貨幣單位。
sentences: The balboa is pegged to the US dollar at a one-to-one ratio. 巴波亞與美元掛鉤，匯率為一比一。
Prices in Panama are often displayed in both balboas and dollars. 巴拿馬的價格通常同時以巴波亞和美元顯示。

meaning: 巴爾布里根棉織品，一種常用於製作內衣和長襪的輕質平紋針織棉布。
sentences: The hosiery was made from soft, breathable balbriggan. 長襪是由柔軟透氣的巴爾布里根棉織品製成的。
Balbriggan fabric became popular in the 19th century for its comfort. 巴爾布里根面料因其舒適性在19世紀變得很受歡迎。
He tended to balbutiate whenever he felt nervous or under pressure. 每當他感到緊張或有壓力時，他就容易結結巴巴地說話。
The child began to balbutiate when asked to recite the poem in front of the class. 當被要求在全班面前朗誦詩歌時，孩子開始口吃了。
Her balbutient speech made it difficult for others to understand her. 她結結巴巴的講話讓別人很難聽懂她的意思。
The balbutient boy felt shy about speaking in public. 那個口吃的男孩對在公共場合講話感到害羞。
Balbuties can often be improved with speech therapy and practice. 口吃通常可以通過語言治療和練習得到改善。
The medical report noted a slight case of balbuties in the young patient. 醫療報告指出這名年輕患者有輕微的口吃情況。

meaning: 小陽台；裝飾性的小欄杆，通常位於窗外，但寬度不足以站立。
sentences: The apartment featured a charming balconet with flowering plants. 這間公寓有一個迷人的小陽台，上面擺放著花卉植物。
The wrought-iron balconet added a touch of elegance to the building's facade. 鍛鐵小陽台為建築物的正面增添了一抹優雅。
They stayed in a balconied room overlooking the central square. 他們住在一間有陽台的房間裡，俯瞰著中央廣場。
The historic hotel is famous for its beautiful balconied suites. 這家歷史悠久的酒店以其美麗的有陽台套房而聞名。
We spent the evening sitting on the balcony and watching the sunset. 我們在陽台上坐著觀賞日落度過了傍晚。
The apartment has a small balcony with a view of the park. 這間公寓有一個可以看到公園風景的小陽台。
The old man had a completely bald head and a friendly smile. 那位老人頭全禿了，帶著友善的笑容。
The bald eagle is the national emblem of the United States. 白頭海雕（禿鷹）是美國的國徽。

meaning: 華蓋；天篷，常置於祭壇、王座或床鋪之上。
sentences: The ornate baldachin over the altar was made of carved wood and gold leaf. 祭壇上方華麗的華蓋是由雕刻木材和金箔製成的。
A silk baldachin protected the royal family from the sun during the procession. 遊行期間，絲製華蓋保護皇室成員免受陽光照射。

meaning: 裝有華蓋的；覆有天篷的。
sentences: The baldachined bed looked like it belonged in a palace. 那張裝有華蓋的床看起來像是屬於宮殿的。
A baldachined throne stood at the end of the grand hall. 在大廳盡頭矗立著一個裝有天篷的王座。

meaning: 華蓋（baldachin 的變體或複數形式）。
sentences: The cathedrals in Italy often feature impressive baldachini. 義大利的大教堂通常擁有令人印象深刻的華蓋。
Art historians studied the development of baldachini styles over the centuries. 藝術史學家研究了幾個世紀以來華蓋風格的發展。

meaning: 華蓋（baldachin 的變體，常指義大利風格的華蓋）。
sentences: Bernini's baldachino in St. Peter's Basilica is a masterpiece of Baroque art. 貝爾尼尼在聖彼得大教堂創作的華蓋是巴洛克藝術的傑作。
The baldachino was supported by four massive spiral columns. 華蓋由四根巨大的螺旋柱支撐。

meaning: 一種特定的野生漿果的名稱（地方性俗名）。
sentences: They picked baldberries in the woods to make homemade jam. 他們在森林裡採摘漿果來做手工果醬。
The baldberry plant grows best in damp, shaded areas. 這種漿果植物在潮濕陰涼的地方生長得最好。

meaning: （鳥類學）具有禿頂特徵的鳥類名稱；也指禿頭。
sentences: The baldcrown eagle is a rare sight in this part of the country. 在這個國家的這個地區，禿頂老鷹是罕見的景象。
He jokingly referred to his receding hairline as a baldcrown. 他開玩笑地稱他向後退的髮際線為禿頂。
He noticed his head beginning to balden as he reached his thirties. 他注意到自己在三十多歲時開始變禿了。
Certain medical treatments can cause the scalp to balden temporarily. 某些醫療處置會導致頭皮暫時性變禿。

meaning: 更禿的；巴德爾（北歐神話中的光明之神）。
sentences: He looked much balder in his recent photograph than he did five years ago. 他在最近的照片中看起來比五年前禿得多。
Balder was known as the most beloved of all the Norse gods. 巴德爾被稱為所有北歐神祇中最受喜愛的。

meaning: 胡言亂語；廢話；無稽之談。
sentences: "That's complete balderdash!" he shouted in response to the accusation. “那完全是胡言亂語！”他大聲回應那項指控。
The report was filled with nothing but bureaucratic balderdash. 這份報告裡除了官僚主義的廢話外別無他物。
The children teased the old baldhead as he walked past. 當那位老禿頭走過時，孩子們戲弄他。
He proudly embraced being a baldhead and stopped wearing hats. 他自豪地接受了自己是個禿頭的事實，不再戴帽子了。

meaning: （澳洲）白骨頂，一種額部有白色皮褶的水鳥。
sentences: The baldicoot paddled slowly across the surface of the lake. 白骨頂在湖面上緩慢地划行。
We spotted a baldicoot nesting among the reeds at the water's edge. 我們看見一隻白骨頂在水邊的蘆葦叢中築巢。
His friends affectionately called him Baldie because of his shiny head. 他的朋友們因為他那發亮的頭而親切地稱他為“禿子”。
Baldie decided to shave his remaining hair for a cleaner look. 禿子決定剃掉剩餘的頭髮，讓外表看起來更整潔。
The baldish man adjusted his glasses and continued reading the newspaper. 那位略禿的男子調整了一下眼鏡，繼續讀報紙。
He had a baldish patch on the crown of his head. 他頭頂上有一個略禿的區塊。

meaning: 禿頭的人；剛開始變禿的人。
sentences: The young baldling was looking for treatments to stop hair loss. 那位剛開始變禿的年輕人正在尋找阻止脫髮的治療方法。
In the comic, the baldling character was often the butt of jokes. 在漫畫中，那個禿頭角色經常是笑柄。
He stated the facts baldly, without any attempt to sugarcoat them. 他直截了當地陳述事實，沒有任何美化的企圖。
To put it baldly, the project was a total failure. 直白地說，這個項目完全失敗了。

meaning: （植物）多裂山芹，一種具有強烈香氣的繖形科植物，曾被用於醫學。
sentences: The leaves of baldmoney have a scent similar to fennel. 多裂山芹的葉子有一種與茴香相似的香氣。
Baldmoney was traditionally used to aid digestion and treat fevers. 傳統上，多裂山芹被用於幫助消化和治療發燒。
Male pattern baldness is often influenced by genetics and hormones. 男性型禿頭通常受遺傳和荷爾蒙的影響。
He tried various creams and lotions to cure his baldness. 他嘗試了各種乳霜和洗劑來治療他的禿頭。

meaning: 禿頭的人；美洲赤頸鴨（一種頭頂為白色的鴨子）。
sentences: The hunter identified the bird on the lake as a baldpate. 獵人將湖上的那隻鳥辨認為美洲赤頸鴨。
He was often teased about his baldpate by his younger brothers. 他經常被弟弟們嘲笑他的禿頭。

meaning: （肉類）去骨或修整過的肋骨肉。
sentences: The butcher prepared a large baldrib of pork for the customer. 屠夫為顧客準備了一大塊修整過的豬肋骨肉。
Roasting a baldrib requires slow cooking for the best flavor. 烘烤一塊肋骨肉需要慢火烹調以獲得最佳風味。

meaning: 肩帶；武裝帶，一條斜跨在肩上用於懸掛劍、號角或鼓的帶子。
sentences: The knight's sword hung from a richly decorated leather baldric. 騎士的劍懸掛在一條裝飾華麗的皮革肩帶上。
He tightened his baldric before stepping onto the battlefield. 他在步入戰場前拉緊了武裝帶。

meaning: 佩戴肩帶的；裝有武裝帶的。
sentences: The baldricked herald announced the arrival of the royal embassy. 佩戴著肩帶的使者宣布了皇室代表團的到來。
Several baldricked soldiers stood guard at the palace gates. 幾名佩戴武裝帶的士兵在皇宮大門處守衛。

meaning: 像肩帶一樣地；斜跨肩地。
sentences: He wore the sash baldricwise across his chest. 他斜跨在胸前佩戴著飾帶。
The strap of the bag was slung baldricwise over his shoulder. 包的帶子斜跨在他的肩膀上。

meaning: 一種由凝乳製成的古老甜點；也指平庸、無價值的文學作品。
sentences: The medieval banquet concluded with a serving of sweet balductum. 中世紀宴會以一份甜凝乳點心結束。
The critic dismissed the novel as mere romantic balductum. 評論家將這部小說斥為平庸的浪漫廢話。

meaning: 鮑德溫，常見的人名；也指一種著名的蘋果品種。
sentences: Baldwin was a popular name among several medieval European kings. 鮑德溫是中世紀幾位歐洲國王常用的名字。
The Baldwin apple is known for its firm texture and tart flavor. 鮑德溫蘋果以其堅實的質地和酸甜的味道聞名。

meaning: 禿頭（綽號，常用於非正式場合）。
sentences: Hey baldy, where did you leave your hat? 嘿禿子，你把帽子留在哪兒了？
Despite the nickname, baldy was a very popular member of the group. 儘管有這個綽號，禿子仍是該團體中非常受歡迎的一員。

meaning: 邪惡，尤其被視為破壞或死亡的正面力量。
sentences: The label on the jar said bale. 罐子上的標籤寫著邪惡，尤其被視為破壞或死亡的正面力量。
I saw bale listed in the old book. 我在那本舊書裡看到邪惡，尤其被視為破壞或死亡的正面力量。

meaning: 巴利亞利群島的；巴利亞利群島人。
sentences: Balearian slingers were famous for their skill in ancient warfare. 巴利亞利投石手因其在古代戰爭中的技能而聞名。
He is a Balearian by birth and grew up on the island of Mallorca. 他天生是巴利亞利人，在馬約卡島長大。
The Balearic Islands are a popular tourist destination in the Mediterranean. 巴利亞利群島是地中海熱門的旅遊目的地。
They enjoyed the beautiful Balearic beaches during their summer vacation. 他們在暑假期間享用了美麗的巴利亞利海灘。

meaning: 冠鶴屬（學名），包括灰冠鶴和黑冠鶴等鳥類。
sentences: The genus Balearica consists of two species of crested cranes native to Africa. 冠鶴屬由兩種原產於非洲的冠鶴組成。
Balearica pavonina is the national bird of Nigeria. 黑冠鶴是奈及利亞的國鳥。

meaning: 鯨鬚，鬚鯨口中用於過濾食物的角質片。
sentences: Baleen whales filter small organisms like krill from the water. 鬚鯨從水中過濾磷蝦等小型生物。
In the past, baleen was used in the construction of corsets and umbrellas. 過去，鯨鬚被用於製作束腹和雨傘。

meaning: 大火堆；信號火；篝火（通常用於戶外）。
sentences: A massive balefire was lit on the hilltop to signal the victory. 山頂上燃起了一堆巨大的篝火以示勝利。
The villagers gathered around the balefire to tell stories and sing songs. 村民們聚在篝火旁講故事、唱歌。
The villain gave the hero a baleful glare before disappearing. 惡棍在消失前給了英雄一個凶惡的眼神。
The pollution had a baleful effect on the local ecosystem. 污染對當地的生態系統產生了有害的影響。
He looked balefully at the man who had cheated him. 他惡狠狠地看著那個欺騙他的人。
The storm clouds loomed balefully over the horizon. 暴風雲惡狠狠地在地平線上逼近。
There was a certain balefulness in his voice that made her uneasy. 他的聲音中有一種惡意，讓她感到不安。
The balefulness of the situation was apparent to everyone involved. 情況的危險性對所有相關人員來說都是顯而易見的。

meaning: （斐濟語）房屋；會堂（通常拼作 vale）。
sentences: The balei was the center of social activity in the Fijian village. 會堂是斐濟村莊社交活動的中心。
They were invited into the balei for a traditional ceremony. 他們被邀請進會堂參加傳統儀式。

meaning: 巴萊斯（瑞士法語區的一個地名或相關事物）。
sentences: The traditions of Baleise are distinct from those in the German-speaking cantons. 巴萊斯的傳統與德語區的傳統有所不同。
Local artisans in Baleise are known for their woodworking skills. 巴萊斯的當地工匠以其木工技能聞名。

meaning: 無憂的；沒有災禍的；無惡意的。
sentences: She wished for a baleless existence far from the troubles of the city. 她渴望一種遠離城市煩惱、無憂無慮的生活。
In the fairy tale, the forest was a baleless place where all creatures lived in peace. 在童話故事中，森林是一個沒有災禍的地方，所有生物都和平相處。

meaning: 壓捆機；打包機，用於將乾草或稻草壓成捆的機器。
sentences: The farmer used a modern baler to package the hay for winter storage. 農夫使用現代化的壓捆機將乾草打包以備冬用。
The heavy baler broke down in the middle of the field. 沉重的壓捆機在田地中間壞掉了。

meaning: 巴萊特樹，菲律賓對某些榕屬喬木的稱呼，在當地民俗中常被認為與超自然力量有關。
sentences: People say that spirits live inside the massive balete trees. 人們說靈魂居住在巨大的巴萊特樹裡。
The aerial roots of the balete tree created a mysterious atmosphere in the forest. 巴萊特樹的氣根在森林中營造出一種神祕的氛圍。

meaning: 峇里島，印尼著名的旅遊島嶼，以其獨特的文化和美麗的風景聞名。
sentences: We spent a week in Bali. 我們在峇里島待了一週。
Bali temples glowed at dusk. 峇里島的寺廟在黃昏時發光。
The bali art style is vibrant and highly detailed. 峇里藝術風格鮮豔且細節豐富。
He is a bali native who works as a local tour guide. 他是一位峇里島當地人，擔任當地導遊。

meaning: （菲律賓語）黃槿，一種常見於熱帶海岸的喬木，其纖維可用於製作繩索。
sentences: The flowers of the balibago tree turn from yellow to red as they age. 黃槿花隨著花齡增長由黃變紅。
Coastal communities use the bark of the balibago for making durable ropes. 沿海社區使用黃槿的樹皮來製作耐用的繩索。

meaning: 巴里加（印度南部的商人階級或種姓）
sentences: The Balija community is prominent in parts of Andhra Pradesh. 巴里加群體在安德拉邦的部分地區非常傑出。
He belongs to the Balija caste. 他屬於巴里加種姓。

meaning: 巴利拉（法西斯義大利時期的青少年組織成員）
sentences: The Balilla was a youth organization in Italy. 巴利拉是義大利的一個青少年組織。
Young boys were encouraged to join the Balilla. 年幼的男孩被鼓勵加入巴利拉。
The museum displayed various baline artifacts. 博物館展示了各種鯨鬚人工製品。
Baline plates are used by some whales to filter food. 一些鯨魚使用鯨鬚板來過濾食物。

meaning: 巴里島的；巴里島人；巴里島語
sentences: Balinese dance is known for its intricate movements. 巴里島舞蹈以其複雜的動作而聞名。
She is learning to speak Balinese. 她正在學習說巴里島語。

meaning: 小帆船（中世紀的一種輕便快船）
sentences: The balinger was used for coastal defense. 這種小帆船被用於海岸防禦。
They sailed across the channel in a small balinger. 他們乘坐一艘小帆船橫渡海峽。

meaning: 菲律賓的一種樹木（其木材可用於建築）
sentences: The balinghasay tree is native to the Philippines. 這棵樹原產於菲律賓。
Its wood is highly valued for construction. 它的木材很受建築業重視。

meaning: 印度鼬獾（產於東南亞的一種獾類）
sentences: The balisaur is also known as the hog-badger. 印度鼬獾也被稱為豬獾。
It is found in the forests of Southeast Asia. 它分佈在東南亞的森林中。

meaning: 弩手（古羅馬軍隊中使用弩的人）
sentences: The balistarius manned the heavy siege engines. 弩手負責操作重型攻城器械。
Historical records mention the skill of the balistarius. 歷史記錄提到了弩手的技巧。

meaning: 鱗魨屬（一種熱帶海水魚類）
sentences: Balistes is a genus of triggerfish. 鱗魨屬是鱗魨的一個屬。
The diver spotted a colorful fish of the Balistes genus. 潛水員發現了一條色彩斑斕的鱗魨屬魚類。
Triggerfishes are members of the balistid family. 鱗魨是鱗魨科的成員。
A balistid fish was seen near the reef. 在珊瑚礁附近看見了一條鱗魨科魚類。
Balistidae includes many species of brightly colored fish. 鱗魨科包括許多色彩鮮艷的魚類。
The study focused on the feeding habits of Balistidae. 該研究側重於鱗魨科的攝食習慣。

meaning: 十字弩孔（城牆上射弩用的狹縫）
sentences: The castle walls featured several balistraria. 城堡的牆壁上有幾個十字弩孔。
The archer aimed through the balistraria. 弓箭手通過十字弩孔進行瞄準。

meaning: 菲律賓的一種土地面積單位
sentences: The land was measured in balita. 這片土地是用菲律賓的面積單位來計算的。
One balita was enough for a small rice plot. 一個巴利塔就足夠一小塊稻田。
Several investors balked at the high level of risk in the proposal. 幾位投資人因提案風險過高而裹足不前。
The horse balked at the narrow bridge and refused to move. 那匹馬在狹窄的橋前停住不前，不肯移動。

meaning: 巴爾幹半島的；巴爾幹地區的
sentences: Balkan history is complex and diverse. 巴爾幹歷史複雜而多樣。
They traveled through several Balkan countries. 他們遊歷了幾個巴爾幹國家。

meaning: 巴爾幹的；具有巴爾幹特徵的
sentences: The Balkanic music has a unique rhythm. 巴爾幹音樂具有獨特的節奏。
He studied Balkanic languages at the university. 他在大學學習巴爾幹語言。

meaning: 巴爾幹化（指一個地區分裂成互相敵對的小國）
sentences: The Balkanization of the empire led to instability. 該帝國的巴爾幹化導致了不穩定。
Politicians fear the Balkanization of the internet. 政治家們擔心互聯網的巴爾幹化。

meaning: 使巴爾幹化；使分裂成小且互不相容的國家
sentences: Ethnic conflicts threatened to Balkanize the region. 種族衝突威脅著該地區的巴爾幹化。
The goal was not to Balkanize the territory. 目標並非將領土分裂。

meaning: 巴爾卡爾人（居住在高加索地區的突厥民族）
sentences: The Balkar people have a rich cultural heritage. 巴爾卡爾人擁有豐富的文化遺產。
She is of Balkar descent. 她具有巴爾卡爾血統。

meaning: 阻礙者；畏縮者；（在漁業中）觀察魚群並指示方向的人
sentences: The balker directed the fishing boat to the school of herring. 觀察員指引漁船前往鯡魚群。
He was known as a balker who always hesitated at the last moment. 他被公認為一個總是在最後一刻畏縮的人。
He proceeded balkingly toward the edge of the cliff. 他猶豫地走向懸崖邊緣。
The machine started balkingly. 機器啟動得不順暢。

meaning: 示巴女王的名字（伊斯蘭傳統中對示巴女王的稱呼）
sentences: Balkis appeared in the old tale as the queen of Sheba. 巴爾基斯在古老故事中就是示巴女王。
The poet called her Balkis, the wise queen. 詩人稱她為巴爾基斯，這位賢明的女王。

meaning: （人或機器）不聽使喚的；愛彆扭的；頑固的
sentences: The balky engine refused to start in the cold. 這台彆扭的引擎在寒冷中拒絕啟動。
He had to deal with a balky mule. 他不得不應付一頭頑固的騾子。
The children were playing with a colorful ball in the yard. 孩子們正在院子裡玩一顆彩色的球。
He kicked the ball high into the air. 他把球踢到了高空中。

meaning: 一種敘事詩，適合朗誦或歌唱；尤其是一首感傷或浪漫的短詩。
sentences: The poet composed a ballad praising the heroic exploits of the fallen commander. 這位詩人創作了一首歌謠，歌頌陣亡將領的英勇事蹟。
She understood ballad after seeing how it changed the scene. 她看到一種敘事詩，適合朗誦或歌唱如何改變情境後，就理解了這個詞。
Chopin composed many famous ballades for the piano. 蕭邦創作了許多著名的鋼琴敘事曲。
The poet wrote a ballade about the fallen heroes. 詩人寫了一首關於犧牲英雄的敘事詩。

meaning: 民謠歌手；敘事詩歌唱家
sentences: The wandering balladeer told stories through song. 那個流浪的民謠歌手通過歌曲講述故事。
She is a well-known balladeer in the local community. 她是當地社區著名的民謠歌手。
The ballader sang a traditional song. 民謠歌手唱了一首傳統歌曲。
As a ballader, he traveled from town to town. 作為一名民謠歌手，他從一個城鎮旅行到另一個城鎮。

meaning: 皇室歌謠（一種詩歌形式）
sentences: The balladeroyal consists of seven-line stanzas. 皇室歌謠由七行詩節組成。
He experimented with the balladeroyal form in his latest work. 他在最新的作品中嘗試了皇室歌謠的形式。
The song has a balladic quality. 這首歌具有民謠的特質。
His writing style is often described as balladic. 他的寫作風格經常被描述為敘事詩風格的。
She focused on balladical themes in her research. 她在研究中側重於民謠主題。
The balladical structure is quite simple. 民謠結構相當簡單。
The balladier entertained the crowd with old tales. 民謠歌手用古老的故事娛樂大眾。
He was a gifted balladier and musician. 他是一位才華橫溢的民謠歌手和音樂家。
Balladism remains an important part of folk literature. 民謠風格仍然是民間文學的重要組成部分。
The book discusses the origins of balladism. 這本書討論了民謠風格的起源。
The balladist sang a tune about the river. 那位民謠歌手唱了一首關於河流的歌。
An old balladist wrote songs for the fair. 一位老民謠作者為市集寫歌。

meaning: 使民謠化；用民謠形式描述
sentences: The event was soon balladized by local poets. 這一事件很快被當地詩人民謠化了。
It is difficult to balladize such a tragic story. 很難將這樣一個悲慘的故事民謠化。
The tune has a balladlike simplicity. 這首曲子有一種民謠般的簡約。
Her stories often have a balladlike quality. 她的故事通常具有民謠般的特質。
He wrote a sweet balladling for his daughter. 他為女兒寫了一首甜美的小民謠。
The balladling was short and catchy. 這首小民謠既短又好聽。

meaning: 平庸的民謠作者；民謠販子
sentences: The balladmonger sold his lyrics for a few coins. 民謠販子以幾枚硬幣的價格出售他的歌詞。
He was often mocked as a simple balladmonger. 他經常被嘲笑為一個普通的民謠販子。

meaning: 創作或販賣平庸民謠的行為
sentences: His balladmongering earned him a modest living. 他的平庸民謠創作使他勉強維持生計。
The streets were filled with balladmongering in those days. 在那些日子裡，街道上到處都是賣民謠的。
The collection includes examples of 18th-century balladry. 該合集包括18世紀民謠的範例。
He devoted his life to the study of balladry. 他一生致力於民謠研究。
He told the story balladwise by singing each scene. 他用民謠般的唱法講述每一幕。
The old tale sounds better when it is performed balladwise. 這個老故事用民謠風格表演時更好聽。

meaning: （拼寫變體）雙桅帆船；不適航的小船
sentences: The sailors laughed at the leaky ballahoo. 水手們嘲笑那艘漏水的破船。
A fast ballahoo appeared on the horizon. 海平面上出現了一艘快速的雙桅帆船。

meaning: 獨木舟（產於馬拉巴爾海岸）
sentences: The ballam glided silently through the backwaters. 獨木舟安靜地滑過回流水域。
They built a ballam from a large mahogany log. 他們用一根巨大的桃花心木原木造了一艘獨木舟。
The ballan wrasse lives among the seaweed. 球鰭花魚生活在海藻中。
We spotted several ballan wrasses during the dive. 我們在潛水期間發現了幾條球鰭花魚。
The old woman recited a long ballant. 老婦人背誦了一首長長的民謠。
It was a ballant about ancient kings. 那是一首關於古代國王的民謠。

meaning: 鋪設粗礫石或類似材料，以形成道路或鐵路的基床，或用於製造混凝土；軌道道碴。
sentences: Workers spread ballast under the rails before laying the track. 工人在鋪軌前把道碴鋪在鐵軌下方。
Good ballast helps keep a railway line stable. 良好的道碴有助於維持鐵路穩定。
The ship's owner complained about the high cost of ballastage. 船主抱怨壓艙費太高。
Ballastage operations delayed the ship's departure. 裝卸壓艙物的工作推遲了船隻的啟程。

meaning: 裝壓艙物的人；起穩定作用的東西
sentences: The ballaster was busy loading stones into the hold. 裝壓艙物的人正忙著將石頭裝入貨艙。
He found work as a ballaster in the busy port. 他在繁忙的港口找到了壓艙物工的工作。
The ballasting process ensures the tracks are stable. 鋪道碴的過程確保了軌道的穩定。
They used gravel for the ballasting of the roadbed. 他們使用礫石作為路基的道碴。

meaning: 敘事曲（義大利詩歌和音樂形式）
sentences: The ballata was a popular form of song in medieval Italy. 敘事曲是中世紀義大利流行的一種歌曲形式。
He performed a ballata accompanied by a lute. 他在詩琴的伴奏下表演了一首敘事曲。
Many medieval ballate have survived to this day. 許多中世紀的敘事曲流傳至今。
The singers focused on the expressive power of the ballate. 歌手們專注於敘事曲的表現力。

meaning: 載貨駁船（俄羅斯平底船）
sentences: The ballatoon was heavily laden with lumber. 這艘駁船裝滿了木材。
The ballatoon moved slowly along the canal. 駁船沿著運河緩慢移動。
His name is etched in the history of balldom. 他的名字被刻在棒球界的歷史中。
Balldom mourned the loss of one of its greats. 棒球界為失去一位偉人而哀悼。
The kitten played with a balled piece of wool. 小貓玩著一團毛線球。
He stood there with balled fists. 他站在那裡，雙手握拳。

meaning: 一個擁有炫耀並過著奢侈生活方式的人。
sentences: The baller spoke with visitors after the meeting. 這個人在會後和訪客交談。
The story describes a baller facing a difficult choice. 故事描寫這個人面對艱難選擇。
The prima ballerina performed a stunning solo. 首席芭蕾舞女演員表演了一段令人驚嘆的獨舞。
She dreamed of becoming a professional ballerina. 她夢想成為一名職業芭蕾舞女演員。
She has been learning how to dance ballet since she was five. 她從五歲起就在學習跳芭蕾舞。
They went to see a beautiful performance of the Nutcracker ballet. 他們去看了一場精彩的《胡桃鉗》芭蕾舞劇表演。

meaning: 芭蕾舞的；優雅如芭蕾的
sentences: The athlete moved with balletic grace. 那位運動員以芭蕾般的優雅動作移動。
They attended a balletic performance last night. 他們昨晚參加了一場芭蕾表演。
As a dedicated balletomane, he never missed a premiere. 作為一個忠實的芭蕾舞迷，他從未錯過任何一場首映式。
The balletomane collect posters and autographs of famous dancers. 芭蕾舞迷收集著名舞者的海報和簽名。

meaning: 鮑豪斯廣場（奧地利聯邦總理府所在地）
sentences: Ballhausplatz is often used to refer to the Austrian Chancellery. 這個名稱常用來指代奧地利總理府。
Protesters gathered at Ballhausplatz in Vienna. 維也納的抗議者聚集在鮑豪斯廣場。

meaning: （義大利舞蹈）舞曲；舞蹈（ballo 的複數）
sentences: The court entertained guests with various balli. 宮廷用各種舞曲款待客人。
He studied the historical choreography of the Italian balli. 他研究了義大利舞曲的歷史編舞。
The ballist released the mechanism of the great bow. 弩手釋放了大弩的機械裝置。
He was trained as a ballist in the imperial army. 他在帝國軍隊中接受過弩手訓練。

meaning: 弩砲（古代的一種大型攻城器械）
sentences: The ballista could fire large stones at the enemy. 弩砲可以向敵人射出巨石。
Engineers repaired the damaged ballista. 工程師修理了損壞的弩砲。
The Roman army deployed several ballistae during the siege. 羅馬軍隊在圍攻期間部署了幾台弩砲。
Ballistae were powerful weapons of ancient warfare. 弩砲是古代戰爭中強大的武器。

meaning: 彈道學的或與之相關的。
sentences: The engineer studied the ballistic path of the rocket. 工程師研究火箭的彈道。
They used a ballistic chart to test the shell's range. 他們用彈道圖表測試炮彈的射程。
The trajectory of the rocket was ballistically calculated. 火箭的軌跡是根據彈道學計算的。
The fragment was ballistically stable during flight. 碎片在飛行過程中彈道穩定。
The ballistician analyzed the bullet casing found at the scene. 彈道專家分析了現場發現的彈殼。
As a ballistician, she works on improving missile accuracy. 作為一名彈道專家，她致力於提高導彈的準確性。
The police used ballistics to match the gun to the crime. 警方利用彈道學將槍枝與犯罪聯繫起來。
He is a student of forensic ballistics. 他是一名法醫彈道學的學生。

meaning: 巴里斯特火藥（一種無煙火藥）
sentences: Ballistite was invented in the late 19th century. 巴里斯特火藥發明於19世紀末。
The use of Ballistite improved the power of firearms. 巴里斯特火藥的使用提高了火器的威力。

meaning: 心臟收縮力計；彈道心宮圖儀
sentences: The doctor used a ballistocardiograph to monitor the patient's heart. 醫生使用心臟收縮力計來監測患者的心臟。
Ballistocardiograph readings provide insights into cardiac output. 彈道心宮圖讀數提供了對心輸出的見解。
The knights gathered in the ballium of the fortress. 騎士們聚集在堡壘的外院中。
The inner ballium was the most protected part of the castle. 內院是城堡中受保護程度最高的部分。

meaning: 一種用於開採的球形礦場（或特定術語）
sentences: The workers entered the ballmine early in the morning. 工人們清晨進入球形礦場。
Safety regulations in the ballmine are very strict. 球形礦場的安全法規非常嚴格。
They visited the village of Ballogan. 他們參觀了巴洛根村。
Ballogan is known for its scenic views. 巴洛根以其風景優美而聞名。
The ballonet helps maintain the shape of the airship. 小氣囊有助於維持飛艇的形狀。
They adjusted the pressure in the ballonet. 他們調整了小氣囊內的壓力。
The children were playing with colorful balloons at the birthday party. 孩子們在生日派對上玩彩色氣球。
We took a hot air balloon ride over the beautiful valley. 我們搭乘熱氣球飛越了美麗的山谷。
The balloonation of the material occurred under high heat. 這種材料在高熱下發生了膨脹。
The balloonation process was carefully monitored. 膨脹過程受到了仔細監測。
The experienced ballooner guided the craft over the mountains. 經驗豐富的熱氣球飛行員引導飛船越過大山。
He has been a professional ballooner for ten years. 他當職業熱氣球飛行員已經十年了。
The party was decorated with elaborate balloonery. 派對裝飾著精緻的氣球藝術。
She started a small business specializing in balloonery. 她創辦了一家專門從事氣球裝飾的小公司。
The airship features several balloonets for stability. 該飛艇設有幾個小氣囊以保持穩定。
Each balloonet is filled with air or gas. 每個小氣囊都充滿了空氣或氣體。
The balloonfish puffed itself up when threatened. 氣球魚在受到威脅時會膨脹起來。
We saw a balloonfish swimming near the seabed. 我們看見一條氣球魚在海床附近游泳。
The balloonflower is named for its bud's shape. 桔梗花因其花蕾的形狀而得名。
Beautiful purple balloonflowers bloomed in the garden. 花園裡開出了美麗的紫色桔梗花。
He inhaled a balloonful of helium. 他吸入了一氣球的氦氣。
She carried a balloonful of water for the prank. 她提著一氣球的水準備搞惡作劇。

meaning: 乘坐熱氣球；膨脹；（債務等）激增
sentences: They went ballooning across the countryside. 他們乘坐熱氣球橫越鄉村。
Ballooning costs forced the company to cut staff. 激增的成本迫使公司裁員。
The actor wore a balloonish costume for the parade. 演員為遊行穿了一件氣球般的服裝。
The dough took on a balloonish appearance as it rose. 麵團在發酵時呈現出氣球般的樣子。
The balloonist waved to the crowds below. 氣球駕駛員向下面的人群揮手。
The famous balloonist attempted a solo flight around the world. 那位著名的氣球駕駛員嘗試獨自環球飛行。
The device has a balloonlike structure. 該設備具有氣球般的結構。
She noticed a balloonlike swelling on her arm. 她注意到胳膊上有個氣球般的腫塊。
The results of the secret ballot will be announced tomorrow morning. 秘密投票的結果將於明天早上公佈。
Each employee is entitled to one ballot in the election for the committee. 每位員工在委員會選舉中都有一張選票。
Ballota is a genus of perennial flowering plants. 歐夏至草屬是多年生開花植物的一個屬。
The leaves of the Ballota plant are often hairy. 歐夏至草屬植物的葉子通常長有毛。
The horse performed a perfect ballotade. 這匹馬表演了一個完美的躍起跳動。
Ballotade is a high-level movement in classical dressage. 躍起跳動是古典馬場馬術中的高級動作。
The election went to a ballotage after no candidate won a majority. 在沒有候選人獲得多數票後，選舉進入了決選。
The results of the ballotage were announced this morning. 決選結果於今天上午公佈。
Each balloter was given a paper slip. 每個投票者都拿到了一張紙條。
The balloter carefully marked his choice. 投票者仔細地標記了他的選擇。
The balloting for the new chairman will take place tomorrow. 新主席的投票將於明天進行。
The result was decided by secret balloting. 結果是由無記名投票決定的。

meaning: 主張使用投票法的人；投票研究者
sentences: The ballotist argued for a more transparent voting system. 投票研究者主張建立一個更透明的投票系統。
He is a well-known ballotist in political circles. 他是政治圈內著名的投票研究者。

meaning: （醫學）觸診浮動（常用於檢查胎兒或腫塊）
sentences: The doctor used ballottement to check the position of the fetus. 醫生使用觸診浮動法來檢查胎兒的位置。
Positive ballottement is a sign of pregnancy. 觸診浮動呈陽性是懷孕的跡象。
He carried a heavy ballow for protection. 他帶著一根沉重的棍棒以作保護。
The path led into a ballow forest. 小路通向一片茂密的森林。

meaning: 鮑豪斯廣場（Ballhausplatz 的縮寫，指奧地利政府）
sentences: Decisions from the Ballplatz affected the entire nation. 來自鮑豪斯廣場的決定影響了整個國家。
He reported on the latest news from the Ballplatz. 他報導了來自奧地利政府的最新消息。
The professional ballplayer signed a new contract. 那位職業球員簽署了一份新合同。
He has been a ballplayer since high school. 他從高中起就是一名球員。
The soldiers were equipped with ballproof vests. 士兵們配備了防彈背心。
The windows were made of ballproof glass. 窗戶是由防彈玻璃製成的。

meaning: 用於跳舞和宴會的大房間。
sentences: The crowd moved through the ballroom after the performance ended. 表演結束後，人群穿過用於跳舞和宴會的大房間。
The guide pointed toward the ballroom and explained why it mattered. 導覽員指向用於跳舞和宴會的大房間，並說明它的重要性。

meaning: （可能指特定零件或支架）球座
sentences: The ballstock needs to be lubricated regularly. 球座需要定期潤滑。
He replaced the broken ballstock in the machine. 他更換了機器中損壞的球座。
There was a complete ballup with the scheduling. 日程安排完全搞砸了。
He made a ballup of the whole situation. 他把整個局面都搞混了。
We spotted a ballweed by the stream. 我們在溪邊看見了一個一種野草。
A child pointed at the ballweed in the grass. 一個孩子指著草裡的一種野草。

meaning: （英國俚語，用於強調）該死的；非常的
sentences: It's a bally nuisance! 這真是個該死的麻煩！
I had a bally good time at the party. 我在派對上玩得很開心。

meaning: （俚語）遠方；地獄（通常用於 'go to Ballyhack'）
sentences: He told them all to go to Ballyhack. 他叫他們都滾到九霄雲外去。
It's a long way to Ballyhack. 到那種遙遠的地方還有很長的路。
Don't believe all the ballyhoo about the new product. 不要相信關於新產品的所有大肆宣傳。
The movie was ballyhooed for months before its release. 這部電影在上映前被大肆吹噓了幾個月。
The ballyhooer stood outside the tent attracting crowds. 宣傳員站在帳篷外吸引人群。
He is a natural ballyhooer for any cause he supports. 他天生就是任何他所支持事業的宣傳者。
That's just a load of ballywack. 那簡直是一派胡言。
Stop talking ballywack and tell me the truth. 別胡說八道了，告訴我實情。
He dismissed the rumor as ballywrack. 他將該謠言斥為無稽之談。
I've never heard such ballywrack in my life. 我這輩子從沒聽過這樣的胡言亂語。
The music was like balm to her troubled soul. 音樂就像是她苦惱靈魂的慰藉。
She applied some lip balm to her dry lips. 她在乾燥的嘴唇上抹了一些護唇膏。
He wore a classic tweed balmacaan in the winter. 冬天他穿著一件經典的粗花呢長大衣。
The balmacaan is known for its comfortable fit. 插肩袖長大衣以其舒適的剪裁而聞名。
The catalog listed Balmarcodes in the insect drawer. 目錄把巴爾馬科德斯列在昆蟲抽屜裡。
A Balmarcodes specimen sat under glass. 一件巴爾馬科德斯標本放在玻璃下。

meaning: （文學作品中的人物或地名，如《威佛利》）
sentences: Balmawhapple appears in the novel as a stern name. 巴爾莫沃普爾在小說裡是一個嚴厲的名字。
The teacher underlined Balmawhapple on the reading list. 老師在閱讀清單上把巴爾莫沃普爾劃了線。
The breeze blew balmily from the sea. 微風從海上溫和地吹來。
The herbs smelled balmily in the afternoon sun. 草藥在午後的陽光下散發著芬芳。
We enjoyed the balminess of the spring evening. 我們享受著春天夜晚的溫和。
The air had a pleasant balminess after the rain. 雨後空氣中有一種令人愉悅的芬芳。

meaning: 像香膏般的；能安慰人的
sentences: The words had a balmlike effect on him. 這些話對他起到了安慰的作用。
The night air was soft and balmlike. 夜間的空氣柔和且像香膏般芬芳。
Balmony is sometimes used in traditional medicine. 龜頭花有時被用於傳統醫學。
She recognized the white flowers of the balmony. 她認出了龜頭花的白色花朵。

meaning: 巴爾莫勒爾（蘇格蘭地名；一種鞋子或帽子）
sentences: Balmoral Castle is the Queen's residence in Scotland. 巴爾莫勒爾城堡是女王在蘇格蘭的住所。
He wore a traditional Balmoral bonnet. 他戴著一頂傳統的巴爾莫勒爾帽。

meaning: （氣候）溫和的；芳香的；（俚語）瘋狂的
sentences: It was a balmy summer evening. 那是一個溫和的夏日夜晚。
You'd have to be balmy to go out in this weather. 在這種天氣出門，你一定是瘋了。
The resort offers various balneal treatments. 渡假村提供各種沐浴療法。
He enjoyed the balneal rituals of the ancient world. 他喜歡古代世界的沐浴儀式。
The ancient ruins included a magnificent balneary. 古代遺跡中包括一個宏偉的澡堂。
The private balneary was reserved for the nobility. 私人浴室是專供貴族使用的。
Balneation was considered essential for health. 沐浴被認為對健康至關重要。

The magician's tricks bamboozled the entire audience. 魔術師的把戲迷惑了全場觀眾。

The map marked Bambos near the coast. 地圖上把那個可能是地名或族名的詞標在海岸附近。
Our guide mentioned Bambos during the trip. 旅途中，導遊提到那個可能是地名或族名的詞。

meaning: （非洲的一種）鼓；一種非洲舞蹈
sentences: The rhythmic sound of the bamboula filled the night. 班布拉鼓有節奏的聲音充滿了夜晚。
They performed a energetic bamboula dance. 他們表演了一場充滿活力的班布拉舞。
The Bambuba people live in the forested regions. 巴姆布巴人居住在森林地區。
He documented the language of the Bambuba. 他記錄了巴姆布巴人的語言。
Bambusa is a large genus of clumping bamboos. 箣竹屬是一個大型的叢生竹屬。
Many species of Bambusa are used in construction. 許多箣竹屬物種被用於建築。
Bambuseae includes many diverse types of bamboo. 竹族包括多種多樣的竹子。
The researcher specialized in the taxonomy of Bambuseae. 研究人員專門從事竹族的分類學研究。

meaning: 巴姆布特人（剛果的一個族群）
sentences: The Bambute are known for their deep connection to the forest. 巴姆布特人以其與森林的深厚聯繫而聞名。
Anthropologists studied the music of the Bambute. 人類學家研究了巴姆布特人的音樂。
The prophet spoke against the worship on the bamoth. 先知反對在高地上進行的崇拜。
Ancient bamoth were often used as places of sacrifice. 古代高地常被用作祭祀場所。
The government decided to ban smoking in all public places. 政府決定禁止在所有公共場所吸菸。
There is a permanent ban on the export of rare historical artifacts. 禁止出口稀有歷史文物的禁令是永久性的。
Bana was a thousand-armed Asura king in Hindu mythology. 在印度神話中，巴拿是一位有千手的阿修羅王。
The story of Bana is found in the ancient Puranas. 巴拿的故事見於古代《往世書》。

meaning: 大花紫薇（一種藥用植物）
sentences: Banaba leaves are often used to make herbal tea. 大花紫薇葉子常用於製作草本茶。
The medicinal properties of banaba are well-documented. 大花紫薇的藥用價值有詳盡的記載。

meaning: （植物名）一種產於菲律賓的樹木
sentences: A banago tree lined the path. 小路旁長著一棵菲律賓樹木。
Local carpenters valued banago for its shade. 當地木匠看重這種樹的樹蔭。
The desk was made from banak. 這張桌子是用熱帶美洲木材做的。
Banak is prized for its warm color. 這種熱帶美洲木材因色澤溫暖而受重視。
Volcanic ash covered the banakite ridge. 火山灰覆蓋了那條粗安質岩山脊。
The quarry exposed a slab of banakite. 採石場露出一塊粗安質岩。
The plot of the movie was quite banal. 這部電影的情節相當平庸。
He made a few banal remarks about the weather. 他對天氣說了幾句平淡乏味的話。
She was tired of the banality of her daily routine. 她厭倦了日常工作的平庸乏味。
The book is filled with countless banalities. 這本書充滿了無數陳詞濫調。
The story ended quite banally. 故事結束得很平庸。
He spoke banally about his future plans. 他平淡地談論著他的未來計劃。
Bananas are a great source of potassium and energy. 香蕉是鉀和能量的重要來源。
He peeled a banana and gave it to the monkey. 他剝了一根香蕉並把它給了猴子。

meaning: （澳洲昆士蘭州的別稱）香蕉之地
sentences: He decided to move to Bananaland for the warm climate. 他決定搬到香蕉之地以享受溫暖的氣候。
Bananaland is famous for its tropical fruits. 香蕉之地以其熱帶水果而聞名。
The Bananalander was proud of his home state. 那個昆士蘭州人為自己的家鄉州感到自豪。
As a true Bananalander, she loves the sun. 作為一個真正的昆士蘭州人，她熱愛陽光。

meaning: 巴南德人（剛果的一個族群）
sentences: The Banande people are known for their entrepreneurial spirit. 巴南德人以其創業精神而聞名。
He studied the agricultural techniques of the Banande. 他研究了巴南德人的農業技術。

meaning: 香蕉愛好者；香蕉種植者
sentences: As a dedicated bananist, he grows ten different varieties. 作為一名專注的香蕉種植者，他種植了十個不同的品種。
The bananist advocated for better export conditions. 香蕉種植者主張改善出口條件。
Certain tropical birds are bananivorous. 某些熱帶鳥類是以香蕉為食的。
The bananivorous monkeys were seen in the plantation. 在種植園裡看見了以香蕉為食的猴子。
The banat was governed by a local official. 該行政區由一名當地官員治理。
History records the boundaries of the ancient banat. 歷史記錄了古代行政區的邊界。

meaning: 巴納特（中歐的一個歷史地區）
sentences: The Banate region is shared by Romania, Serbia, and Hungary. 巴納特地區由羅馬尼亞、塞爾維亞和匈牙利共有。
They explored the cultural heritage of the Banate. 他們探索了巴納特的文化遺產。

meaning: （岩石名）一種含石英的火成岩
sentences: The quarry cut banatite from the hill. 採石場從山裡切出含石英的火成岩。
A chip of banatite broke from the slab. 一塊含石英的火成岩碎片從石板上剝落。

meaning: 機械性的；粗鄙的；缺乏文化修養的
sentences: He dismissed the work as mere banausic labor. 他將這項工作斥為純粹的機械勞動。
The philosopher looked down on banausic occupations. 哲學家看不起那些缺乏文化修養的職業。

meaning: 班芭（愛爾蘭的古稱或守護女神名）
sentences: Banba is one of the three goddesses who represent Ireland. 班芭是代表愛爾蘭的三位女神之一。
The poets used Banba as a symbol for their homeland. 詩人們使用班芭作為他們祖國的象徵。

meaning: 班伯里（英國地名；一種蛋糕名）
sentences: Banbury is a market town in Oxfordshire. 班伯里是牛津郡的一個集鎮。
They enjoyed delicious Banbury cakes for tea. 他們下午茶吃了好吃的班伯里蛋糕。
The case was heard by the court en banc. 此案由全體法官共同審理。
The judges took their seats on the banc. 法官們在法官席上就座。

meaning: （菲律賓的）小獨木舟；窄長的小船
sentences: The fisherman rowed his banca across the lagoon. 漁民划著他的小獨木舟橫越潟湖。
A banca is often fitted with outriggers for stability. 小獨木舟通常裝有舷外支架以保持穩定。

meaning: （可能指長凳蓋或特定的家具部件）長凳套
sentences: The antique bench was covered with a velvet bancal. 那張古董長凳上蓋著一塊天鵝絨長凳套。
She repaired the torn bancal with great care. 她小心翼翼地修補了撕裂的長凳套。

meaning: 長凳（義大利語 banco 的複數）
sentences: The row of wooden banchi was empty. 那排木製長凳是空的。
The students sat on the banchi in the courtyard. 學生們坐在院子裡的長凳上。

meaning: 屬於或涉及由法官組成的法院類型，通常是上訴法院。
sentences: The appeal went before the banco court. 這起上訴交由法官合議庭審理。
Her case was heard in banco after the first ruling. 初審後，她的案子由合議庭重新審理。
The judge sat on the bancus during the hearing. 審訊時，法官坐在法官席上。
A worn bancus stood beside the witness chair. 一張磨損的法官席放在證人椅旁。
My brother plays the drums in a local rock band. 我哥哥在當地的一個搖滾樂團裡打鼓。
She tied her hair back with a rubber band. 她用橡皮筋把頭髮紮了起來。
The nurse applied a band-aid to the small cut on his finger. 護理師在他手指的小傷口上貼了一個 OK 繃。
The new policy is just a band-aid and doesn't address the underlying problem. 這項新政策只是一個權宜之計，並未解決根本問題。

meaning: 班達群島（印尼地名）；班達人
sentences: The Banda Islands were famous for nutmeg production. 班達群島以產肉豆蔻而聞名。
He studied the history of the Banda sea trade. 他研究了班達海貿易的歷史。
They stayed in a small banda near the beach. 他們住在海灘附近的一個小棚屋裡。
The local banda played lively music all night. 當地的樂隊整晚演奏著活潑的音樂。
The nurse gently cleaned the wound and applied a clean bandage. 護士輕輕清洗了傷口並敷上了乾淨的繃帶。
He had to wear a bandage on his arm after the minor accident. 事故發生後，他不得不手臂上纏著繃帶。
The skilled bandager wrapped the athlete's ankle. 熟練的包紮者包紮了運動員的腳踝。
He worked as a medical bandager in the hospital. 他在醫院擔任醫務包紮員。
The bandagist provided specialized supports for the patient. 繃帶專家為患者提供了專門的支撐器材。
He visited a local bandagist to get a custom brace. 他拜訪了當地的繃帶專家以獲取客製化的支架。

meaning: （岩石名）一種含石英的粗安岩
sentences: The cliff held streaks of bandaite. 懸崖裡夾著含石英的粗安岩條帶。
A geologist tapped the bandaite with a hammer. 地質學家用錘子敲了敲那種岩石。

meaning: （地名或民族名，可能源自特定地區）
sentences: The atlas marked Bandaka near the river. 地圖把班達卡標在河邊。
Bandaka can name a place or a people. 班達卡可以指一個地名或一個民族名。
The sailmaker cut bandala into straps. 帆匠把馬尼拉麻粗布裁成綁帶。

The children watched the bandalore spin on the string. 孩子們看著那個溜溜球前身在繩上旋轉。
He tied a red bandanna around his neck. 他在脖子上繫了一塊紅頭巾。
The cowboy wore a dusty bandanna. 那個牛仔戴著一塊佈滿灰塵的頭巾。
The bandannaed singer walked onto the stage. 那位戴著大頭巾的歌手走上了舞台。
A group of bandannaed bikers rode past. 一群戴著大頭巾的機車騎士騎車經過。

The fishing boats crowded the bandar at dawn. 清晨時，漁船擠滿了港口。

He compared the chaotic meeting to the bandarlog. 他將那場混亂的會議比作猴群。

meaning: （裝帽子或衣物的）紙盒；精緻的
sentences: She kept her finest hat in a decorated bandbox. 她把她最好的帽子放在一個裝飾精美的紙盒裡。
He looked as if he had just stepped out of a bandbox. 他看起來穿戴得非常整潔精緻。

meaning: 像紙盒一樣的；過於整潔的
sentences: The room had a bandboxical appearance. 這個房間顯得過於整潔。
He disliked the bandboxical style of the new houses. 他不喜歡那些新房子像紙盒一樣的風格。

meaning: 小巧精緻的；（盒子般）狹小的
sentences: They lived in a bandboxy apartment in the city. 他們住在城市裡一個狹小精緻的公寓裡。
The car's interior felt a bit bandboxy. 這輛車的內部感覺有點侷促。
He put his trumpet back into its bandcase. 他把他的小喇叭放回了保護殼裡。
The bandcase was reinforced with metal corners. 這個保護殼的角落用金屬加固了。

meaning: 切帶器；（收割機上的）割繩器
sentences: The bandcutter automatically snips the ties on the sheaves. 切帶器會自動剪斷捆上的繩子。
He replaced the dull blade on the bandcutter. 他更換了切帶器上變鈍的刀片。
A bande of light appeared on the horizon. 海平面上出現了一帶光芒。
He was a member of a notorious bande. 他是一個臭名昭著的幫派成員。
She wore a silk bandeau to keep the hair out of her eyes. 她戴著絲質髮帶以防止頭髮擋住眼睛。
The swimmer wore a colorful bandeau top. 那位游泳者穿了一件色彩鮮艷的抹胸上衣。

meaning: 有條紋的；帶狀的；團結的
sentences: The banded mongoose has distinctive dark stripes. 縞獴有明顯的深色條紋。
The rocks showed a banded structure. 這些岩石顯示出帶狀結構。
A thin bandelet decorated the column. 一條細小的帶飾裝飾著圓柱。

The licensed bander carefully attached the ring to the bird's leg. 持證環志員小心地將環固定在鳥的腿上。
As a bird bander, she contributes to migration research. 作為一名鳥類環志員，她為遷徙研究做出了貢獻。

meaning: 潘德馬（土耳其港口名 Bandırma 的舊稱）
sentences: Ships sailed from Banderma to various Mediterranean ports. 船隻從潘德馬航向地中海的各個港口。

meaning: （桅頂或長矛上的）小旗；（建築或美術）飾帶
sentences: A colorful banderole fluttered from the ship's mast. 一面色彩鮮艷的小旗在船桅上飄揚。
The painter included a banderole with an inscription. 畫家在畫中加入了一條帶有銘文的飾帶。

meaning: 班德斯奈奇（《愛麗絲鏡中奇遇》中虛構的怪獸）
sentences: Beware the frumious Bandersnatch! 當心那隻令人發狂的班德斯奈奇！
The Bandersnatch is a legendary creature created by Lewis Carroll. 班德斯奈奇是路易斯·卡羅創作的一種傳奇生物。

meaning: 赤刀魚（一種身體細長的魚）
sentences: The red bandfish has a very elongated body. 紅赤刀魚的身體非常細長。
They found a bandfish washed up on the beach. 他們在海灘上發現了一條被沖上岸的赤刀魚。
The word bandhava implies a strong bond between people. 這個詞表示人與人之間緊密的親屬或朋友關係。
He treated his close friend like a bandhava. 他把親密朋友當作親屬一樣對待。
The bandhook is used to secure the metal straps. 帶鉤被用來固定金屬帶。
He used a bandhook to pull the heavy cable. 他使用一個帶鉤來拉動沉重的電纜。

meaning: （地名或民族名，可能源自特定文化）
sentences: Our guide pointed to Bandhor on the route. 我們的導遊在路線上指著那個地名或族名。
The bus passed Bandhor before sunset. 巴士在日落前經過那個地名或族名。
A true bandhu is one who helps in times of need. 真正的同伴是那些在需要時提供幫助的人。
He considered his mentors as his bandhus. 他將他的導師視為他的同伴。

meaning: （可能指特定服裝或術語）一種短外衣
sentences: The traditional bandi is often worn over a kurta. 傳統的短外衣通常穿在長衫外面。
He chose a silk bandi for the wedding. 他為婚禮選擇了一件絲質短外衣。

A bandicoot was spotted digging in the garden. 看見一隻袋狸在花園裡挖掘。
The map marked Bandicoy near the coast. 地圖在海岸附近標出了班迪科伊。
A bandicoy hedge bordered the field. 田地邊緣長著一排班迪科伊灌木。
The old sailor was a bandie after years at sea. 那位老水手在海上多年後成了彎腿的人。
A tiny bandie darted through the stream. 一條小刺魚迅速穿過溪流。
We fried bandikai with curry leaves. 我們用咖哩葉炒秋葵。
Bandikai tastes best when it is fresh. 新鮮的秋葵最好吃。
The bandiness of his legs was noticeable when he ran. 他跑步時，腿部的彎曲變得很明顯。
Bandiness can sometimes be a sign of rickets. 弓形腿有時可能是佝僂病的徵兆。
The scan showed banding across the image. 掃描圖上出現了帶狀條紋。
The glass vase has green banding near the rim. 那只玻璃花瓶的口沿附近有綠色帶紋。

meaning: 在無法無天的地區搶劫他人的人，尤其是作為團體的一員。
sentences: The bandit fled into the hills after the robbery. 強盜搶劫後逃進山裡。
Travelers avoided the road because bandits had been seen nearby. 旅人避開那條路，因為附近有人看見強盜出沒。
The region was plagued by rampant banditism. 該地區深受猖獗的強盜行為之苦。
The government took measures to suppress banditism. 政府採取措施鎮壓強盜行為。
Banditry was a major problem along the trade routes. 強盜活動曾是貿易路線上的一個主要問題。
He turned to banditry after losing his land. 他在失去土地後轉向了強盜生涯。
The travelers were attacked by a group of banditti. 旅客們遭到了多名強盜的襲擊。
The banditti hid in the remote mountain caves. 強盜們躲藏在偏遠的山洞裡。

meaning: （愛爾蘭的）長度單位（約兩英尺）
sentences: The ribbon was a bandle long. 那條緞帶長一個愛爾蘭長度單位，約兩英尺。
He measured the plank in bandles. 他用那個長度單位量木板。
The dress had a simple, bandless waist. 這件衣服有一個簡單的、無帶的腰部。
He chose a bandless design for the watch. 他為手錶選擇了無表帶的設計。
The material was woven bandlessly. 這種材料被織成無條紋狀。
The device was attached bandlessly to the surface. 該設備無帶地固定在表面上。
The bandlessness of the design made it look very modern. 該設計的無帶化使其看起來非常現代。
She appreciated the bandlessness of the uniform. 她很欣賞制服沒有條紋的簡潔。
She tied her hair with a narrow bandlet. 她用一根窄窄的小帶子紮著頭髮。
The ceiling was decorated with a gilded bandlet. 天花板上裝飾著一條鍍金的小帶飾。
The bandman practiced his instrument every day. 樂隊隊員每天練習他的樂器。
He has been a bandman for over twenty years. 他當樂隊隊員已經二十多年了。
The bandmaster raised his baton to begin the performance. 樂隊指揮舉起指揮棒開始演出。
He was appointed as the new bandmaster of the city orchestra. 他被任命為城市管弦樂隊的新指揮。
Bando is a traditional martial art from Myanmar. 班多是來自緬甸的一種傳統武術。
He is a master of the Bando style. 他是班多派武術大師。
The fierce bandog guarded the gate of the estate. 兇猛的看門狗守衛著莊園的大門。
Ancient texts mention the use of bandogs for protection. 古代文獻提到了使用猛犬進行保護。

meaning: 彈藥帶；（斜掛在肩上的）帶子
sentences: The soldier wore a leather bandoleer across his chest. 士兵在胸前斜掛著一條皮革彈藥帶。
He filled his bandoleer with extra ammunition. 他在他的彈藥帶裡裝滿了額外的彈藥。
The bandoleered rebels marched through the jungle. 掛著彈藥帶的反叛軍穿過叢林。
He was bandoleered and ready for the expedition. 他掛好了帶子，準備出征。
She used a bit of bandoline to smooth her hair. 她用了點髮膠來抹平頭髮。
Bandoline was common in the Victorian era for hair styling. 在維多利亞時代，髮膠常用於美髮。
The bandonion is essential for authentic tango music. 班多鈕手風琴對於正宗的探戈音樂至關重要。
He played a soulful melody on his bandonion. 他用他的班多鈕手風琴演奏了一段深情的旋律。

meaning: （地名或品牌名，可能源自特定地區）
sentences: Bandor was printed on the package label. 包裝標籤上印著班多爾。
We met in Bandor after the train stopped. 火車停下後，我們在班多爾見面。
The bandore was a popular stringed instrument in the Renaissance. 班多琴在文藝復興時期是流行的弦樂器。
He composed several pieces specifically for the bandore. 他專門為班多琴創作了幾首樂曲。
The knight's spear was decorated with a red bandrol. 騎士的長矛上裝飾著一面紅色小旗。
A bandrol with the family crest was displayed in the hall. 大廳裡展示著一條印有家族徽章的飾帶。
The bandsman adjusted his uniform before the parade. 樂隊成員在遊行前調整了制服。
He served as a bandsman in the military. 他在軍隊中擔任樂隊成員。
The orchestra performed at the bandstand in the park. 管弦樂隊在公園的露天樂壇演出。
Crowds gathered around the bandstand to listen to the music. 人群聚集在露天樂壇周圍聽音樂。

meaning: （俚語）樂隊成員；（尤指）爵士樂隊成員
sentences: The young bandster was eager to join a famous group. 那個年輕的樂隊成員渴望加入一個著名的團體。
He met many talented bandsters at the jazz festival. 他在爵士音樂節上遇到了許多才華橫溢的樂隊成員。
He fastened his collar with a silk bandstring. 他用一根絲質帶子繫好了衣領。
The bandstring was often decorated with tassels. 這種帶子通常裝飾有流蘇。

meaning: 班杜西亞（荷拉斯詩中的泉水名）
sentences: The Fount of Bandusia is immortalized in classical poetry. 班杜西亞泉在古典詩歌中流芳百世。
Horace wrote a famous ode to the spring of Bandusia. 荷拉斯寫了一首著名的頌歌給班杜西亞泉。

meaning: 班杜西亞的；與班杜西亞相關的
sentences: The Bandusian waters were crystal clear. 班杜西亞的泉水清澈見底。
He studied the classical references to Bandusian springs. 他研究了對班杜西亞泉的古典引用。
The embroidery featured beautiful bandwork around the edges. 刺繡的邊緣有美麗的帶狀裝飾。
He specialized in the bandwork of metal structures. 他專攻金屬結構的帶狀連接工作。

meaning: 向外彎曲的；傳來傳去；（一種運動）班迪球
sentences: He is a bit bandy-legged. 他的腿有點向外彎曲。
Don't bandy words with me! 不要跟我爭辯！

meaning: 班迪球（一種在冰上進行的類似曲棍球的運動）
sentences: They played a game of bandyball on the frozen lake. 他們在結冰的湖面上玩了一場班迪球。
Bandyball is popular in some Northern European countries. 班迪球在一些北歐國家很流行。

meaning: （古語）僕人，從僕；受僱從事卑微工作的人。
sentences: The bandyman was responsible for cleaning the stables and carrying water. 這位從僕負責清理馬廄和提水。
He lived a humble life as a bandyman for the local lord. 他作為當地領主的僕人，過著卑微的生活。

meaning: 造成痛苦或毀滅的原因。
sentences: Mosquitoes were the bane of our picnic. 蚊子是我們野餐時的大麻煩。
Late trains can be the bane of a daily commute. 誤點火車常是通勤族的痛點。

meaning: 類葉升麻屬植物；類葉升麻（其漿果有毒）。
sentences: The baneberry plants in the garden are beautiful but poisonous. 花園裡的類葉升麻很漂亮，但有毒。
Be careful not to eat any berries from the baneberry. 小心不要吃到類葉升麻的任何漿果。

meaning: 有害的，有毒的；致死的；有害健康的。
sentences: The baneful influence of the drug ruined his health. 藥物的有害影響毀了他的健康。
Environmental pollution has a baneful effect on all living things. 環境污染對所有生物都有害。
The banefulness of the chemical was not immediately apparent. 這種化學物質的有害性並非立即顯現。
Scientists studied the banefulness of the new toxin. 科學家研究了這種新毒素的致死性。

meaning: 毒參；有害的雜草（尤指對牲畜有害）。
sentences: The field was overgrown with banewort, making it dangerous for cattle. 田裡長滿了毒參，這對牛群來說很危險。
Farmers worked hard to eradicate the banewort from their pastures. 農民努力清除牧場上的有害雜草。

meaning: 班夫（加拿大阿爾伯塔省的一座城鎮，以國家公園聞名）。
sentences: Banff is a popular destination for skiing and hiking in Canada. 班夫是加拿大滑雪和遠足的熱門目的地。
We visited Banff National Park last summer. 我們去年夏天參觀了班夫國家公園。
The rumors spread banefully throughout the small community. 謠言在小社區中惡意地傳播開來。
The waste was banefully disposed of in the river. 這些廢棄物被有害地排放到河流中。
There was a sudden loud bang that startled everyone in the room. 突然傳來一聲巨響，驚嚇了房間裡的每個人。
He accidentally banged his head against the low shelf. 他不小心把頭撞到了低矮的架子上。

meaning: （菲律賓語）一種用於盛水的大型粘土罐。
sentences: In the village, many families still use a banga to store fresh water. 在村子裡，許多家庭仍在使用粘土罐儲存淡水。
The potter carefully crafted a large banga. 陶工精心製作了一個大的粘土罐。

meaning: 邦加拉人；邦加拉語（主要在剛果地區）。
sentences: The Bangala people have a rich cultural heritage in the Congo. 邦加拉人在剛果擁有豐富的文化遺產。
He learned to speak Bangala while living in Africa. 他在非洲生活時學會了說邦加拉語。

meaning: 紅桉；一種原產於澳大利亞的桉樹。
sentences: The bangalay tree provides strong timber for construction. 紅桉樹為建築提供了強韌的木材。
We saw many bangalay trees along the Australian coast. 我們在澳大利亞沿海看到了許多紅桉樹。

meaning: 假檳榔；一種原產於澳大利亞的棕櫚樹。
sentences: The bangalow palm is often used in landscaping for its elegant appearance. 假檳榔因其優雅的外觀常用於園林綠化。
Clusters of bangalow palms grew near the rainforest edge. 假檳榔叢生長在雨林邊緣。

meaning: 班加什（主要居住在巴基斯坦和阿富汗的一個普什圖部落）。
sentences: The Bangash tribe has a long history in the Kohat region. 班加什部落在科哈特地區有著悠久的歷史。
Many Bangash people are known for their bravery. 許多班加什人以英勇著稱。

meaning: （收穫玉米時裝在車廂側面的）擋板。
sentences: The farmer attached a bangboard to the wagon to keep the corn from spilling. 農民在車廂上安裝了擋板以防止玉米溢出。
A bangboard helps in efficient manual corn harvesting. 擋板有助於高效的手工玉米收割。
A light bange started falling just as we left. 我們剛離開，就開始下起細雨。
They spent the afternoon bangeing about the park. 他們整個下午都在公園裡悠閒地遊蕩。

meaning: 汽車或引擎；指汽車引擎的汽缸。從每個汽缸點火時發出的爆炸聲。
sentences: The old banger rattled down the road. 那輛破車哐當哐當地開下公路。
The mechanic listened to each banger as the engine fired. 技師仔細聽著引擎每個汽缸點火的爆響。

meaning: （印度）挑擔（一種用扁擔掛在肩上的運載工具）。
sentences: The porter used a banghy to carry the heavy baskets. 搬運工用挑擔搬運重籃子。
Water was transported in jars hanging from a banghy. 水是裝在掛在挑擔上的罐子裡運輸的。
Bangia is a genus of red algae found in marine and freshwater environments. 紅毛菜屬是在海洋和淡水環境中發現的一種紅藻。
The researcher collected samples of Bangia from the rocky shore. 研究人員從岩石岸邊採集了紅毛菜屬的樣本。
The Bangiaceae family includes several important species of red algae. 紅毛菜科包括幾種重要的紅藻物種。
A study of Bangiaceae revealed insights into algal evolution. 對紅毛菜科的研究揭示了藻類進化的見解。

meaning: 紅毛菜科的；與紅毛菜屬相關的。
sentences: The fabric looked bangiaceous in the sun. 布料在陽光下看起來很紅毛菜科的。
The joke sounded bangiaceous to me. 那個笑話聽起來很紅毛菜科的。
Bangiales represent some of the most primitive forms of red algae. 紅毛菜目代表了紅藻中一些最原始的形式。
The order Bangiales has undergone significant taxonomic revision. 紅毛菜目經歷了重大的分類修訂。

meaning: 物體撞擊的動作或聲音。
sentences: The banging of the hammers could be heard from several streets away. 幾條街外都能聽到鐵鎚敲擊的聲音。
Strange bangings in the old house were ascribed to a poltergeist. 老房子裡的奇怪敲擊聲被認為是惡作劇者所為。

meaning: 曼谷（泰國首都）；一種用於製作草帽的纖維。
sentences: Bangkok is known for its vibrant street life and ornate temples. 曼谷以其充滿活力的街頭生活和裝飾華麗的寺廟而聞名。
He wore a stylish hat made of fine bangkok straw. 他戴著一頂由精緻曼谷草製成的時髦帽子。

meaning: 手鐲；手鍊；腳環（通常為無扣環）。
sentences: She wore several silver bangles on her wrist. 她的手腕上戴著幾個銀手鐲。
The bangles jingled as she walked. 手鐲在她走路時叮噹作響。

meaning: 戴著手鐲的；裝飾有手鐲的。
sentences: The dancer's bangled arms moved gracefully in the air. 舞者戴著手鐲的手臂在空中優雅地移動。
A bangled hand reached out to accept the gift. 一隻戴著手鐲的手伸出來接受禮物。

meaning: （俚語）閒逛；無所事事地混時間。
sentences: They were caught bangling in the hallway after class. 他們課後在走廊閒逛被抓到了。
Stop bangling and get to work immediately. 別再閒混了，立即開始工作。
The local bangster used to intimidate the villagers. 當地的暴徒過去常常恐嚇村民。
He emerged as the bangster of the competition. 他成為了比賽的勝利者。
The bangtail galloped ahead of the other horses. 那匹短尾賽馬跑在其他馬前面。
They placed their bets on the fast bangtail. 他們在那匹快速的短尾馬上下了注。

meaning: 邦瓦凱齊人（波札那的一個主要部族）。
sentences: The Bangwaketsi live primarily in the southern part of Botswana. 邦瓦凱齊人主要居住在波札那南部。
We learned about the traditional customs of the Bangwaketsi. 我們了解了邦瓦凱齊人的傳統習俗。

meaning: 巴尼（羅馬尼亞貨幣列伊的輔幣單位，100巴尼等於1列伊）。
sentences: The bread cost five lei and fifty bani. 這麵包花了五列伊五十巴尼。
I have a few bani coins left in my pocket. 我口袋裡還剩下幾枚巴尼硬幣。

meaning: 孟加拉榕（同 banyan）；印度商人的外袍。
sentences: The weary travelers rested under the shade of a large banian tree. 疲憊的旅行者在巨大的孟加拉榕樹蔭下休息。
The merchant was dressed in a traditional silk banian. 商人穿著傳統的絲綢外袍。

meaning: （菲律賓語）一種用於睡覺或坐臥的手編草蓆。
sentences: The family spread a banig on the floor for the guests to sit on. 這家人在地上鋪了一張草蓆供客人坐。
Skilled weavers make intricate patterns on the banig. 熟練的編織工在草蓆上製作複雜的圖案。
The banilad tree is known for its durable wood. 這種熱帶喬木以其耐用的木材而聞名。
Many banilad trees can be found in the forests of Cebu. 在宿霧的森林中可以找到許多這種樹。

meaning: 送走（某人）並禁止他們回來。
sentences: He was banished from the kingdom for his crimes. 他因犯罪而被逐出王國。
To banish means to send (someone) away and forbid them from returning. 驅逐的意思是將（某人）送走並禁止其返回。
Exercise is a great banisher of stress and anxiety. 運動是壓力和焦慮的絕佳消除者。
The king acted as the banisher of all dissidents. 國王充當了所有異議人士的驅逐者。
The traitor was sentenced to perpetual banishment from the country. 叛徒被判處永久驅逐出境。
Banishment was a common punishment in ancient times. 驅逐是古代常見的一種懲罰。
The child slid down the banister of the grand staircase. 孩子從大樓梯的扶手上滑了下來。
She held onto the banister as she climbed the stairs. 她爬樓梯時握著扶手。

meaning: 巴尼瓦人（居住在委內瑞拉、哥倫比亞和巴西邊境地區的原住民）。
sentences: The Baniva people have lived along the Orinoco river for centuries. 巴尼瓦人幾個世紀以來一直居住在奧里諾科河沿岸。
Anthropologists are studying the linguistic patterns of the Baniva. 人類學家正在研究巴尼瓦人的語言模式。

meaning: 巴尼瓦語（巴尼瓦人使用的語言）。
sentences: Baniwa is an Arawakan language spoken in the Amazon basin. 巴尼瓦語是亞馬遜盆地使用的一種阿拉瓦克語言。
Efforts are being made to preserve the baniwa language. 正在努力保護巴尼瓦語。

meaning: （印度）商人和高利貸者的種姓或成員。
sentences: The baniya managed the local grocery store in the village. 那位商人經營著村子裡的當地雜貨店。
Members of the baniya community are influential in Indian business. 商人階層的成員在印度商業中很有影響力。

meaning: 一種弦樂器（和弦琴），通常具有圓形琴體、膜狀音板和按弦琴頸，透過撥動或掃弦來演奏。
sentences: The field guide listed banjo beside related species. 圖鑑把這個分類列在近緣物種旁。
The specimen label helped researchers identify banjo. 標本標籤幫助研究人員辨認這個分類。
The talented banjoist played a lively bluegrass tune. 那位天才班卓琴手演奏了一首活潑的藍草曲目。
He has been a professional banjoist for over twenty years. 他擔任職業班卓琴手已經超過二十年了。

meaning: （罕用）早期的班卓琴（通常為三弦）。
sentences: The historian found an old banjore in the attic. 歷史學家在閣樓上發現了一把舊班卓琴。
The banjore has a distinct, primitive sound compared to modern versions. 與現代版本相比，早期的班卓琴有一種獨特而原始的聲音。
The banjorine was popular in late 19th-century banjo orchestras. 班卓小琴在 19 世紀末的班卓琴管弦樂團中非常流行。
The lead melody was played on the banjorine. 主旋律是由班卓小琴演奏的。

meaning: 班卓尤克里里（結合了班卓琴的琴身和尤克里里的定弦）。
sentences: He started learning to play the banjuke because it was easier than the guitar. 他開始學習演奏班卓尤克里里，因為它比吉他容易。
The banjuke produces a loud, crisp sound. 班卓尤克里里發出的聲音既響亮又清脆。
I need to go to the bank to withdraw some money. 我需要去銀行領一些錢。
We sat on the river bank and watched the sunset. 我們坐在河岸上觀賞日落。
He paid for the house with a certified bank draft. 他用一份保付銀行匯票支付了房費。
A bank draft is a secure way to transfer large sums of money. 銀行匯票是轉移大筆資金的一種安全方式。
The central bank decided to lower the bank rate to stimulate economic growth. 中央銀行決定降低銀行利率以刺激經濟增長。
Changes in the bank rate can significantly affect mortgage payments. 銀行利率的變化會顯著影響抵押貸款支出。

meaning: 可存入銀行的；可靠的；（電影等）有票房號召力的。
sentences: The movie studio only hires bankable stars for major blockbusters. 電影製片廠只僱傭有票房號召力的明星來出演大片。
The business plan must be bankable to secure a loan. 商業計劃必須是可靠的才能獲得貸款。

meaning: 班卡拉奇人（加利福尼亞州的一個美洲原住民部落）。
sentences: The Bankalachi are a subgroup of the Tubatulabal people. 班卡拉奇人是圖巴圖拉巴爾人的一個子群。
The culture and language of the Bankalachi are nearly extinct. 班卡拉奇人的文化 and 語言幾乎已經絕跡。
She checked her bankbook to see if the salary had been deposited. 她檢查了存摺，看看薪水是否已經入帳。
Keep your bankbook in a safe place. 將你的銀行存摺放在安全的地方。

meaning: 堆積的；（火）覆蓋著灰燼慢燃的；（飛機）傾斜飛行的。
sentences: The plane made a banked turn over the mountains. 飛機在山脈上空做了一個傾斜轉向。
He looked at the banked clouds on the horizon. 他看著地平線上堆積的雲層。
He works as a successful private banker for an international bank. 他在一家大型銀行擔任成功的私人銀行家。
She consulted a professional banker about starting her own business. 她就創立自己的事業諮詢了一位專業銀行家。
I set up a banker's order to pay my monthly insurance premiums automatically. 我設定了銀行定期扣款委託書，每月自動支付保費。
You can cancel the banker's order at any time by contacting your bank. 您可以隨時聯繫銀行取消定期扣款委託。
Bankera is a genus of fungi in the family Bankeraceae. 班克羅菇屬是班克羅菇科中的一個真菌屬。
Mushrooms in the Bankera genus are known for their distinct caps. 班克羅菇屬的蘑菇以其獨特的菌蓋而聞名。

meaning: 銀行界；銀行家的地位或職業。
sentences: He spent his entire career in the world of bankerdom. 他的整個職業生涯都在銀行界度過。
The influence of bankerdom on the national economy is significant. 銀行界對國家經濟的影響是重大的。
The successful bankeress was featured on the cover of a business magazine. 這位成功的女銀行家登上了商業雜誌的封面。
She was the first bankeress to lead the prestigious firm. 她是第一位領導這家著名公司的女銀行家。

meaning: 礫岩；（尤指）南非產金的礫岩層。
sentences: Gold is often found within the banket reefs of South Africa. 黃金通常在南非的礫岩礦脈中發現。
The miners excavated the hard banket to extract the precious metal. 礦工挖掘堅硬的礫岩以提取貴金屬。

meaning: 滿岸的；水位與河岸齊平的。
sentences: After the heavy rain, the river reached bankfull stage. 大雨過後，河水達到了滿岸水位。
Bankfull discharge is an important concept in hydrology. 滿岸流量是水文學中的一個重要概念。
She chose banking after college. 她大學畢業後選擇了銀行業。
Banking kept the town steady after the crash. 那場危機後，銀行業讓小鎮穩了下來。

meaning: （礦井）井口工（負責管理升降機和礦石裝載）。
sentences: The bankman signaled that the elevator was ready to descend. 井口工發信號表示升降機已準備好下降。
A bankman plays a crucial role in the safety of mine operations. 井口工在礦井作業安全中發揮著至關重要的作用。

meaning: （採礦）坑道檢查員；負責檢查礦坑頂板或側壁的人。
sentences: The bankrider inspected the mine shaft for any loose rocks. 坑道檢查員檢查了礦井是否有鬆動的岩石。
Safety in the mine depends on the thoroughness of the bankrider. 礦井的安全取決於坑道檢查員的徹底檢查。
That bankrupt shop closed by noon. 那家破產的店在中午前關門了。
After months of debt, the family was bankrupt. 經過數月負債，那個家庭已經破產。
The firm filed for bankruptcy protection last month. 該公司上個月申請了破產保護。
Facing bankruptcy is a very stressful experience for any entrepreneur. 對任何企業家來說，面臨破產都是一段壓力極大的經歷。

meaning: 破產行為；導致破產的體制或做法。
sentences: Critics argued that the current financial policies were leading to a state of bankruptism. 批評者認為目前的財政政策正導致破產狀態。
Bankruptism among small businesses became a major political issue. 小企業的破產行為成為了一個主要的政治問題。

meaning: 像破產者的；呈現破產特徵的。
sentences: The company's bankruptlike state was evident from its empty offices. 該公司像破產般的狀態從其空蕩蕩的辦公室中清晰可見。
He made a bankruptlike plea for help from his creditors. 他像破產者一樣向債權人請求幫助。

meaning: 破產地；在精神或道德上貧乏地。
sentences: The organization was bankruptly managed for years. 該機構多年來一直管理不善，處於破產狀態。
The argument was bankruptly presented, lacking any logical foundation. 該論點呈現得非常貧乏，缺乏任何邏輯基礎。

meaning: 破產身分；破產者的狀態。
sentences: He struggled to recover from the stigma of bankruptship. 他努力從破產的污名中恢復過來。
Bankruptship can have long-lasting effects on one's credit score. 破產狀態對一個人的信用評分有長期的影響。
The sudden bankrupture of the local factory surprised everyone. 當地工廠的突然倒閉讓每個人都感到意外。
Legal documents were filed following the company's bankrupture. 在公司破產後，相關法律文件被提交。

meaning: （印度，過時）倉庫；辦公室；（尤指）港口官員的辦公處。
sentences: The goods were stored in the bankshall near the docks. 貨物存放在碼頭附近的倉庫裡。
He visited the bankshall to clear his customs paperwork. 他前往辦公處辦理海關清關手續。

meaning: 班克木屬（澳洲特有的一種山龍眼科植物）。
sentences: The Banksia is famous for its large, cylindrical flower spikes. 班克木以其巨大的圓柱狀花穗而聞名。
Many species of Banksia are adapted to survive forest fires. 許多種類的班克木都適應了在森林火災中生存。

meaning: 班克木屬的；與植物學家約瑟夫·班克斯相關的。
sentences: The botanist described a new Banksian species found in Western Australia. 植物學家描述了在西澳發現的一個班克木屬新物種。
He studied the extensive Banksian collection at the museum. 他研究了博物館中大量的班克斯收藏品。
We enjoyed a quiet walk along the bankside in the evening. 我們喜歡傍晚沿著河岸悠閒地散步。
The bankside was dotted with colorful wildflowers. 堤岸上點綴著五彩繽紛的野花。

meaning: 井口工；（負責信號傳遞與裝載的）地面作業人員。
sentences: The banksman ensured that the crane's load was properly secured. 地面作業人員確保起重機的貨物已妥善固定。
He worked as a banksman at the construction site for three years. 他在建築工地擔任了三年的地面作業人員。
The river was choked with bankweed and other aquatic plants. 河流被岸邊雜草和其他水生植物阻塞了。
The gardener cleared the bankweed to improve the view of the lake. 園丁清除了岸邊的雜草以改善湖泊的景觀。
The children loved running around the banky terrain near the park. 孩子們喜歡在公園附近多坡的地形上跑來跑去。
It was difficult to farm the banky land efficiently. 在這片多坡的土地上進行高效耕作很困難。
The protesters carried a large banner demanding better working conditions. 抗議者攜帶著一條要求改善工作條件的大橫幅。
A colorful banner welcoming the guests was hung above the entrance. 入口上方掛著一條歡迎客人的彩色橫幅。
The bannered walls of the castle welcomed the returning knight. 城堡掛滿旗幟的牆壁迎接著歸來的騎士。
A bannered headline announced the peace treaty. 一個帶標題的大字新聞宣布了和平條約。
The bannerer led the parade through the main street. 持旗手帶領遊行隊伍穿過主街。
She was chosen as the bannerer for her school's delegation. 她被選為學校代表團的持旗手。

meaning: （封建時代在戰場上受封的）騎士；小旗幟。
sentences: The king bestowed the title of banneret upon the brave warrior. 國王將騎士爵位授予了那位勇敢的戰士。
The knights carried small bannerets attached to their lances. 騎士們的長矛上掛著小旗幟。

meaning: 馬夫魚；一種背鰭細長的熱帶魚。
sentences: The school of bannerfish swam gracefully among the coral reefs. 一群馬夫魚在珊瑚礁中優雅地游泳。
Divers often spot the black and white bannerfish in tropical waters. 潛水員經常在熱帶海域發現黑白相間的馬夫魚。
The bannerless army retreated in silence. 那支沒有旗幟的軍隊在沉默中撤退。
A bannerless ship was seen drifting in the fog. 一艘沒有旗幟的船被看見在霧中漂流。
The leaves of the plant had a broad, bannerlike shape. 這種植物的葉子呈現出寬闊、像旗幟一樣的形狀。
The clouds formed bannerlike patterns across the sky. 雲層在天空中形成了像旗幟一樣的圖案。

meaning: 旗手；持旗幟者；（清代）八旗子弟。
sentences: The bannerman proudly carried his family's crest into battle. 旗手自豪地帶著家族徽章進入戰場。
History books describe the role of the bannerman in the Qing dynasty. 歷史書描述了清代八旗子弟的角色。
A bannerol displayed the coat of arms of the deceased. 一面小方旗展示了逝者的紋章。
The cathedral was decorated with numerous bannerols for the ceremony. 大教堂為儀式裝飾了許多小方旗。
The laundry hung bannerwise across the narrow alley. 洗好的衣服像旗幟般掛在狹窄的小巷中。
The curtains fluttered bannerwise in the strong breeze. 窗簾在強風中像旗幟般飄動。

meaning: （方言）一種薄餅或燕麥餅（同 bannock）。
sentences: She baked a fresh bannet for breakfast. 她烤了一個新鮮的薄餅當早餐。
Bannets were a staple food for many Scottish families. 薄餅是許多蘇格蘭家庭的主食。
The banning of plastic bags has reduced environmental waste. 禁止使用塑料袋減少了環境垃圾。
Several organizations are protesting the banning of specific books. 幾個組織正在抗議取締特定書籍。
He leaned against the bannister to catch his breath. 他靠在樓梯扶手上喘口氣。
The polished wooden bannister shone in the sunlight. 拋光的木製扶手在陽光下閃閃發光。

meaning: 班諾克人（美洲原住民的一個部落）。
sentences: The Bannock people traditionally lived in the northern Great Basin. 班諾克人傳統上居住在大盆地北部。
Historians study the interaction between the Bannock and early settlers. 歷史學家研究班諾克人與早期定居者之間的互動。

meaning: 燕麥餅；大麥餅；一種蘇格蘭式的圓餅。
sentences: We ate warm bannock with butter and honey. 我們吃著抹了奶油和蜂蜜的熱燕麥餅。
Traditionally, bannocks were cooked on a stone griddle. 傳統上，燕麥餅是在石烤盤上烹飪的。

meaning: 班諾克本（蘇格蘭一村莊，1314年著名的班諾克本戰役所在地）。
sentences: The Battle of Bannockburn was a significant victory for Scotland. 班諾克本戰役是蘇格蘭的一次重大勝利。
Many tourists visit Bannockburn to see the historical monument. 許多遊客參觀班諾克本以觀看歷史紀念碑。
The banns of marriage were read in the village church for three Sundays. 結婚預告在村子裡的教堂連續宣布了三個星期日。
No one raised any objection after the publication of the banns. 在發布結婚預告後，沒有人提出任何反對意見。
The garden had a large bannut tree that provided plenty of shade. 花園裡有一棵大核桃樹，提供了充足的陰涼。
They spent the afternoon gathering bannuts in the orchard. 他們下午在果園裡採集核桃。
The country was divided into several banovinas for administrative purposes. 出於行政目的，該國被劃分為幾個省。
He served as a government official in the Banovina of Croatia. 他在克羅地亞省擔任政府官員。
A magnificent banquet was held in the grand ballroom to celebrate the victory. 宏偉的宴會廳舉行了一場盛大的宴會來慶祝勝利。
The guests enjoyed a delicious five-course banquet at the wedding party. 賓客們在婚禮派對上享用了美味的五道菜盛宴。

meaning: 宴會參加者；喜歡參加宴會的人。
sentences: The local politicians were known as frequent banqueteers. 當地政客以經常參加宴會而聞名。
The city's elite banqueteers gathered for the charity gala. 城市的精英宴會愛好者聚集在一起參加慈善晚會。

meaning: 頻繁參加宴會的行為；宴請。
sentences: His excessive banqueteering began to affect his health. 他過度頻繁地參加宴會開始影響他的健康。
Banqueteering was a key part of their social networking strategy. 宴請是他們社交策略的一個關鍵部分。
Each banqueter was given a personalized souvenir. 每位赴宴者都獲得了一份個性化的紀念品。
The banqueter enjoyed the fine wine and exquisite food. 赴宴者享受著美酒和精緻的美食。

meaning: 長軟椅；（靠牆的）長凳；（射擊用的）步道。
sentences: We sat on a comfortable red velvet banquette in the restaurant. 我們坐在餐廳舒適的紅絲絨長軟椅上。
The soldiers stood on the banquette to fire over the parapet. 士兵們站在步道上朝女兒牆外開火。

meaning: （菲律賓語）一種生產堅硬木材的熱帶樹木。
sentences: The wood of the bansalague is highly valued for its durability. 這種熱帶樹木的木材因其耐用性而備受推崇。
Artisans use bansalague wood to create high-quality carvings. 工匠們使用這種木材製作高品質的雕刻品。

meaning: （愛爾蘭和蘇格蘭傳說中）報喪女妖（預報死亡的尖叫女精靈）。
sentences: According to legend, the wail of a banshee predicts a family member's death. 根據傳說，報喪女妖的哀號預示著家族成員的死亡。
She shrieked like a banshee when she saw the mouse. 當她看到老鼠時，她像報喪女妖一樣尖叫起來。
The children tried to catch banstickles in the shallow stream. 孩子們試圖在淺溪中捉三刺魚。
Banstickles are known for the protective spines on their backs. 三刺魚以其背上的保護性刺而聞名。
He decided to bant after realizing he had gained too much weight. 在意識到自己體重增加太多後，他決定開始節食減肥。
Banting was a popular method of weight loss in the 19th century. 節食減肥是 19 世紀一種流行的減肥方法。

meaning: 萬丹（印尼爪哇島的一地區）；萬丹雞。
sentences: Bantam was once a major trading port in Southeast Asia. 萬丹曾是東南亞的一個主要貿易港口。
He raised a prize-winning Bantam in his backyard. 他在後院養了一隻獲獎的萬丹雞。

meaning: 矮腳雞；（小而好鬥的）小個子。
sentences: The bantam rooster crowed loudly despite its small size. 矮腳公雞儘管體型小，但啼叫聲很響亮。
He was a feisty bantam of a man, never backing down from a challenge. 他是個好鬥的小個子男人，從不在挑戰面前退縮。

meaning: 使縮小；使成為矮腳雞般的大小。
sentences: The new design aims to bantamize the device for easier portability. 新設計旨在縮小裝置的體積以便於攜帶。
Technology continues to bantamize electronic components. 技術繼續使電子元件微型化。

meaning: 最輕量級（拳擊等運動的體重等級，通常介於蠅量級和羽量級之間）。
sentences: The bantamweight champion defended his title yesterday. 最輕量級冠軍昨天衛冕成功。
He competes in the bantamweight division. 他參加最輕量級級別的比賽。

meaning: （菲律賓語）守衛；守望者；監視器。
sentences: The village bantay stood alert at the entrance. 村莊守衛在入口處保持警覺。
We need a reliable bantay to protect the property. 我們需要一個可靠的守衛來保護財產。

meaning: 班塔延（菲律賓的一個島嶼或城鎮）。
sentences: Bantayan Island is famous for its beautiful white sand beaches. 班塔延島以其美麗的白沙灘而聞名。
We spent our vacation exploring the coast of Bantayan. 我們在班塔延海岸度過了我們的假期。

meaning: 爪哇野牛（產於東南亞的一種野牛）。
sentences: The banteng is an endangered species of wild cattle. 爪哇野牛是一種瀕臨滅絕的野牛物種。
We saw a herd of banteng in the wildlife reserve. 我們在野生動物保護區看到了一群爪哇野牛。

meaning: 開玩笑；嘲笑（特質、習慣等）。
sentences: To banter means to joke about; to ridicule (a trait, habit, etc.). 開玩笑的意思是開玩笑；嘲笑（特質、習慣等）。
People may banter in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同情況下開玩笑。
He was known as a good-natured banterer among his friends. 他在朋友中以脾氣好的開玩笑者而聞名。
The banterer kept the atmosphere light during the long meeting. 打趣者在漫長的會議期間保持了輕鬆的氣氛。
She suggested banteringly that he should run for president. 她開玩笑地建議他應該競選總統。
They spoke banteringly about their childhood mistakes. 他們開玩笑地談論著童年時犯的錯。

meaning: 愛打趣的；充滿嘲弄或玩笑的。
sentences: The twins shared a bantery relationship, always teasing each other. 這對雙胞胎有著愛打趣的關係，總是互相取笑。
I enjoyed the bantery conversation at the dinner table. 我喜歡晚餐桌上充滿打趣的對話。

meaning: 班廷式減肥法（一種通過限制碳水化合物來減肥的方法）。
sentences: Bantingism was one of the first popular low-carb diets. 班廷式減肥法是首批流行的低碳飲食法之一。
He strictly followed Bantingism to improve his health. 他嚴格遵循班廷式減肥法以改善健康。

meaning: 使遵循班廷式減肥法；使節食。
sentences: The doctor advised him to bantingize his diet to control his blood sugar. 醫生建議他控制飲食以控制血糖。
She decided to bantingize her lifestyle after the holidays. 她決定在假期後改變生活方式開始節食。
The mother carried her bantling in a colorful sling. 母親用彩色背帶背著她的幼兒。
A group of bantlings played happily in the park. 一群小孩子在公園裡開心地玩耍。

meaning: 類班圖語的；類班圖語支（非洲的一組語言）。
sentences: Linguists are studying the relationship between various Bantoid languages. 語言學家正在研究各種類班圖語言之間的關係。
The Bantoid group forms a large part of the Niger-Congo language family. 類班圖語支是尼日-剛果語系的一個重要組成部分。
The Bantu expansion was a major series of migrations in African history. 班圖大遷徙是非洲歷史上的一次重大遷徙事件。
Swahili is one of the most widely spoken Bantu languages. 斯瓦希里語是使用最廣泛的班圖語言之一。

meaning: 矮小而好鬥的（尤指雞）；矮腳雞的縮寫。
sentences: The banty rooster was the bravest bird on the farm. 那隻矮腳公雞是農場上最勇敢的鳥。
He has a banty build but a very strong personality. 他身材矮小，但個性非常堅強。

meaning: （菲律賓語）一種用於製作家具的優質木材。
sentences: Banuyo wood is used for fine furniture. 這種菲律賓優質木材常用來做家具。
The carpenter chose banuyo for the cabinet. 木匠挑了這種菲律賓木材來做櫥櫃。

meaning: 樹鼩（產於東南亞的一種小動物）。
sentences: The banxring scurried quickly up the tropical tree. 樹鼩迅速爬上了熱帶樹木。
Scientists are researching the evolutionary history of the banxring. 科學家正在研究樹鼩的進化史。
Going to the banya is a popular social tradition in Russia. 去蒸氣浴室是俄羅斯一種受歡迎的社交傳統。
The banya was filled with the scent of birch leaves. 蒸氣浴室裡充滿了樺樹葉的香氣。

meaning: 班亞伊人（居住在辛巴威和莫三比克的一支民族）。
sentences: The Banyai people have a unique musical heritage. 班亞伊人擁有獨特的音樂遺產。
We learned about the traditional farming methods of the Banyai. 我們了解了班亞伊人的傳統耕作方法。

meaning: 孟加拉榕（一種熱帶榕樹，支柱根下垂入地）。
sentences: The huge banyan tree covered almost an acre of ground. 巨大的孟加拉榕樹覆蓋了將近一英畝的土地。
Children loved to climb among the many trunks of the banyan. 孩子們喜歡在孟加拉榕樹的眾多樹幹間攀爬。

meaning: 巴尼奧羅人（烏干達的一個民族）。
sentences: The Banyoro kingdom was once a powerful state in East Africa. 巴尼奧羅王國曾是東非的一個強大國家。
The Banyoro traditional dress is very colorful. 巴尼奧羅人的傳統服飾非常鮮艷。

meaning: 班雲斯（法國產的一種加烈甜紅葡萄酒）。
sentences: A glass of Banyuls is the perfect accompaniment to chocolate dessert. 一杯班雲斯葡萄酒是巧克力甜點的完美搭配。
The Banyuls wine region is located in the south of France. 班雲斯葡萄酒產區位於法國南部。

meaning: 萬歲（日語呼喊）；萬歲呼喊；自殺式的攻擊。
sentences: The crowd shouted 'banzai' as the leader appeared. 當領導人出現時，人群高喊「萬歲」。
The soldiers launched a desperate banzai charge. 士兵們發動了絕望的萬歲衝鋒（自殺式攻擊）。

meaning: 猴麵包樹（產於非洲和澳洲的一種巨大樹木，樹幹極粗）。
sentences: The baobab tree is often called the 'upside-down tree'. 猴麵包樹常被稱為「倒栽樹」。
Baobab fruit is known for its high vitamin C content. 猴麵包樹的果實以維生素 C 含量高而聞名。
He ordered a bacon bap for his breakfast. 他點了一個培根餐包當早餐。
The baker made fresh floury baps every morning. 麵包師每天早上製作新鮮的撒粉軟餐包。

meaning: 小槐花屬（豆科植物的一屬，其中包括一些產染料的樹木）。
sentences: Some species of Baphia are used to produce red dye. 某些小槐花屬植物被用來生產紅色染料。
The timber from Baphia trees is quite durable. 小槐花屬樹木的木材相當耐用。

meaning: 巴風特（一種神秘的羊頭神或惡魔形象）。
sentences: The image of Baphomet is often associated with occult symbolism. 巴風特的形象常與神秘學象徵相關聯。
The origin of Baphomet can be traced back to the trial of the Knights Templar. 巴風特的起源可以追溯到聖殿騎士團的審判。

meaning: 巴風特的；與巴風特相關的；神秘邪惡的。
sentences: The ritual featured several Baphometic symbols. 儀式中有幾個與巴風特相關的符號。
He was fascinated by the Baphometic imagery in ancient texts. 他被古代文獻中關於巴風特的意象所吸引。

meaning: 大眼魚龍屬（一種已滅絕的侏羅紀海洋爬行動物）。
sentences: The Baptanodon had extremely large eyes for hunting in deep water. 大眼魚龍擁有極大的眼睛，便於在深海中狩獵。
Fossils of Baptanodon were discovered in North America. 大眼魚龍的化石在北美被發現。

meaning: 野靛屬（豆科的一屬，常開黃色或藍色花）。
sentences: Baptisia is a popular choice for native plant gardens. 野靛屬植物是原生植物花園的熱門選擇。
The blue flowers of the Baptisia australis are stunning. 澳洲野靛的藍色花朵非常迷人。

meaning: 野靛苷（從野靛屬植物中提取的一種苷類物質）。
sentences: Baptisin has been studied for its potential medicinal properties. 野靛苷因其潛在的藥用價值而受到研究。
The chemist isolated baptisin from the roots of the plant. 化學家從植物的根部提取了野靛苷。

meaning: 一種基督教聖禮，透過這種聖禮，一個人被接納進入教堂，有時會被賦予一個名字，通常涉及候選人被塗油或浸入水中。
sentences: The child’s baptism was held at the old church. 孩子的洗禮是在老教堂舉行的。
The ceremony of baptism symbolizes spiritual rebirth. 洗禮儀式象徵著精神上的重生。
The baby wore a beautiful white baptismal gown. 寶寶穿著一件美麗的白色洗禮服。
He was given his baptismal name during the ceremony. 他在儀式上得到了他的教名。
The child was baptismally initiated into the faith. 孩子通過洗禮加入了該信仰。
Baptismally speaking, the name change occurred early in his life. 從洗禮的角度來看，改名發生在他生命的早期。
The Baptist church held a community event last Saturday. 浸信會教堂上週六舉行了社區活動。
John the Baptist is a central figure in the New Testament. 施洗者約翰是新約聖經中的核心人物。
The ancient cathedral has a separate octagonal baptistery. 這座古老的大教堂有一個獨立的八角形洗禮堂。
The candidate entered the baptistery for the ritual immersion. 候選人進入洗禮池進行浸禮儀式。

meaning: 洗禮的；浸信會的；與洗禮相關的。
sentences: The congregation follows traditional baptistic doctrines. 會眾遵循傳統的浸信會教義。
He studied various baptistic traditions from around the world. 他研究了世界各地不同的洗禮傳統。
The priest discussed who is considered baptizable in the church. 神父討論了教會中誰被認為是可受洗的。
After completing the classes, the converts were deemed baptizable. 在完成課程後，皈依者被認為具備受洗資格。
The minister will baptize the infants this Sunday. 牧師將在本週日為嬰兒施洗。
He was baptized into the Catholic Church at age ten. 他十歲時在天主教會受洗。
The baptizee stood before the congregation to share their testimony. 受洗者站在會眾面前分享他們的見證。
Each baptizee received a certificate of membership. 每位受洗者都收到了會員證書。

meaning: 施洗；受洗的過程或儀式。
sentences: The baptizement was a solemn and moving ceremony. 施洗儀式既莊嚴又感人。
Preparations were made for the mass baptizement at the river. 為河邊的大規模施洗儀式做好了準備。
The baptizer lowered the convert into the water. 施洗者將皈依者浸入水中。
He has served as the official baptizer for the parish for years. 他多年來一直擔任教區的正式施洗者。

meaning: 潛鳥屬（一種已滅絕的白堊紀潛水鳥）。
sentences: Baptornis fossils provide evidence of early avian evolution. 潛鳥屬化石提供了早期鳥類進化的證據。
The Baptornis was well-adapted for swimming and diving. 潛鳥屬非常適應游泳和潛水。
Let's meet for a drink at the hotel bar at 8:00 p.m. 我們晚上八點在飯店酒吧見面喝一杯吧。
He bought a bar of dark chocolate as a snack for the trip. 他買了一塊黑巧克力作為旅行的小吃。
The play treated bara as sacred power. 這齣戲把母性視為神聖力量。
Her bara gave the family warmth. 她的母性讓全家感到溫暖。

meaning: （阿拉斯加或西伯利亞原住民的）半地下式房屋。
sentences: The Aleut people traditionally lived in a barabara to keep warm. 阿留申人傳統上住在半地下式房屋中以保暖。
The archaeological site contained the remains of several barabaras. 考古遺址包含幾座半地下式房屋的遺跡。
The construction of a barabora involved using sod and timber. 建造半地下式房屋涉及使用草皮和木材。
A barabora provided excellent insulation against the cold Arctic winds. 半地下式房屋為抵禦北極寒風提供了極佳的隔熱效果。

meaning: 巴拉布拉人（蘇丹北部和埃及南部的一個族群）。
sentences: The Barabra people have a long history of trading along the Nile. 巴拉布拉人在尼羅河沿岸有著悠久的貿易歷史。
Barabra culture is influenced by both Nubian and Arab traditions. 巴拉布拉文化受到努比亞和阿拉伯傳統的影響。

meaning: 巴拉卡（一種基督教成人主日學運動）。
sentences: The Baraca movement focused on religious education for young men. 巴拉卡運動側重於年輕男性的宗教教育。
He was an active member of the local Baraca class. 他是當地巴拉卡班的活躍成員。

meaning: 巴拉（壓力單位，等於1微巴）。
sentences: The scientist measured the pressure in barads for the experiment. 科學家在實驗中以巴拉為單位測量壓力。
A barad is a very small unit of atmospheric pressure. 巴拉是一個非常小的氣壓單位。

meaning: 重量覺缺失（失去辨別物體重量的能力）。
sentences: The patient suffered from baragnosis after the brain injury. 腦部受傷後，病人患有重量覺缺失症。
Baragnosis can be a symptom of certain neurological disorders. 重量覺缺失可能是某些神經系統疾病的症狀。

meaning: 混雜語言；難懂的方言；胡言亂語。
sentences: To my ears, their conversation was nothing but baragouin. 在我聽來，他們的對話簡直是胡言亂語。
The travelers spoke a strange baragouin that combined several languages. 旅行者說著一種結合了幾種語言的奇怪混雜語言。
His accent was so baragouinish that I could barely understand him. 他的口音如此混雜難懂，我幾乎聽不懂他在說什麼。
They used a baragouinish dialect to keep their talk secret. 他們使用一種難懂的方言來保守談話秘密。

meaning: 巴萊塔（猶太教口傳律法中未包含在《密西拿》中的部分）。
sentences: Scholars study the Baraithas to gain a deeper understanding of Jewish law. 學者們研究巴萊塔以深入了解猶太法律。
The Baraithas contain valuable historical information. 巴萊塔包含寶貴的歷史信息。

meaning: （西班牙語，植物）一種熱帶灌木。
sentences: The barajillo plant is native to Central America. 這種植物原產於中美洲。
Local healers use the leaves of the barajillo for medicinal tea. 當地醫生使用這種灌木的葉子製作藥茶。

meaning: （邏輯學）一種三段論的形式名稱。
sentences: The philosophy class unpacked Baralipton on Tuesday. 哲學課在週二拆解了三段論形式。
Baralipton puzzled the first-year students. 這種三段論形式讓一年級學生很困惑。

meaning: 巴拉米卡（歷史上與哈里發哈倫·拉希德有關的波斯顯赫家族）。
sentences: The Baramika family held great power in the Abbasid court. 巴拉米卡家族在阿拔斯王朝廷中擁有巨大權力。
The story of the Baramika's rise and fall is legendary. 巴拉米卡家族興衰的故事富有傳奇色彩。

meaning: （罕用）一種用於製造某種化學物質的設備或容器。
sentences: The technician cleaned the barandos carefully before the next batch. 技術員在下一批次開始前仔細清洗了容器。
New barandos were installed to increase production capacity. 安裝了新的設備以提高生產能力。

meaning: （菲律賓）村；區（菲律賓最小的行政單位）。
sentences: The barangay captain is responsible for local governance. 村長（區長）負責地方治理。
Every barangay has its own health center. 每個村都有自己的衛生中心。

meaning: 沼鹿（產於印度和尼泊爾的一種鹿）。
sentences: The barasingha is also known as the swamp deer. 沼鹿也被稱為澤鹿。
Conservation efforts have helped the barasingha population recover. 保護工作已幫助沼鹿種群恢復。

meaning: 巴拉西亞呢（一種表面有細顆粒感的耐磨織物，常用於製做西裝或制服）。
sentences: His evening suit was made of fine black barathea. 他的晚禮服是由精緻的黑色巴拉西亞呢製成的。
Barathea is a popular fabric for military uniforms. 巴拉西亞呢是軍裝常用的面料。
The ancient explorers feared the bottomless barathra of the mountains. 古代的探險家害怕山中深不見底的深坑。
The corrupt officials were seen as barathra consuming the state's wealth. 腐敗官員被視為吞噬國家財富的貪婪之徒。

meaning: 深坑；深淵；地獄；貪得無厭的人或物。
sentences: He described the debt crisis as a barathrum from which there was no escape. 他將債務危機描述為一個無法逃脫的深淵。
Ancient Athens used a barathrum as a place of execution. 古雅典曾使用深坑作為處決地點。

meaning: （巴西）破斧木（一種產於巴西的硬木樹，其木材極其堅硬且耐腐）。
sentences: The barauna tree is highly valued for its strong and heavy timber. 破斧木因其堅固且沉重的木材而備受推崇。
Local craftsmen use barauna to make durable fence posts. 當地工匠使用破斧木製作耐用的籬笆柱。
The arrow had a sharp barb that made it difficult to remove. 箭頭上有一個鋒利的倒鉤，這使得它很難被拔出來。
His speech was full of hidden barbs aimed at his political opponents. 他的演講充滿了針對政敵的隱晦尖刻之語。

meaning: 巴爾巴科阿（一種起源於加勒比地區的烹飪方式，通常指慢火烤肉）。
sentences: Barbacoa is traditionally cooked in a pit covered with maguey leaves. 巴爾巴科阿傳統上是在覆蓋著龍舌蘭葉的土坑中烹製的。
The restaurant is famous for its tender lamb barbacoa. 這家餐廳以其鮮嫩的羊肉烤肉（巴爾巴科阿）而聞名。

meaning: 巴爾巴科阿語系的；與巴爾巴科阿人相關的。
sentences: Barbacoan languages are spoken in parts of Colombia and Ecuador. 巴爾巴科阿語系在哥倫比亞和厄瓜多爾的部分地區使用。
He studied the cultural history of the Barbacoan peoples. 他研究了巴爾巴科阿民族的文化歷史。

meaning: 噴鴷（一種產於中南美洲的熱帶鳥類）。
sentences: The barbacou sat motionless on a branch, waiting for an insect. 噴鴷靜靜地坐在樹枝上，等待著昆蟲。
We spotted a black-fronted barbacou during our forest hike. 我們在森林遠足時發現了一隻黑額噴鴷。
The Barbadian singer gained international fame. 這位巴貝多歌手獲得了國際聲譽。
She is a proud Barbadian who loves her island home. 她是一個為自己的島國故鄉感到自豪的巴貝多人。

meaning: 巴貝多（加勒比海的一個島國）。
sentences: Barbados is known for its beautiful beaches and rum. 巴貝多以其美麗的海灘和蘭姆酒聞名。
They spent their honeymoon in Barbados. 他們在巴貝多度過了蜜月。
The portrait highlighted the character's barbal features. 這幅畫像突顯了人物的鬍鬚特徵。
He took great care in his barbal grooming. 他非常注重鬍鬚的修整。

meaning: 蘆薈苷（從蘆薈中提取的一種苦味晶體物質，具有瀉藥作用）。
sentences: Barbaloin is the primary active constituent in aloe vera used as a laxative. 蘆薈苷是蘆薈中用作瀉藥的主要活性成分。
The concentration of barbaloin varies depending on the species of aloe. 蘆薈苷的濃度因蘆薈品種而異。
Barbara has been working as a professional translator for over ten years. 芭芭拉擔任專業翻譯已超過十年。
I met Barbara at the university alumni meeting last week. 我在上週的大學校友會上遇見了芭芭拉。

meaning: 外語口音；說話帶外國腔調。
sentences: Her speech was characterized by a slight barbaralalia. 她的講話帶有輕微的外國口音。
The actor practiced hard to eliminate his natural barbaralalia for the role. 演員為了角色努力練習，以消除他天生的外國腔調。

meaning: 山芥屬（十字花科的一屬植物）。
sentences: Barbarea vulgaris, commonly known as winter cress, is a member of this genus. 山芥，俗稱冬芥，是該屬的一員。
The yellow flowers of Barbarea brighten the fields in early spring. 山芥屬的黃色花朵在早春照亮了田野。
The building's architecture had a certain barbaresque charm. 這座建築的風格有一種粗獷野蠻的魅力。
The costume design was inspired by barbaresque elements from ancient legends. 服裝設計靈感來自古代傳說中的粗野元素。
The ancient empire was eventually destroyed by invading barbarian tribes. 這個古代帝國最終被入侵的野蠻部落摧毀。
Don't be such a barbarian; please use a knife and fork while eating. 別這麼粗魯（像個野蠻人）；吃飯時請使用刀叉。

meaning: 野蠻狀態；粗野行為；未開化。
sentences: The destruction of the library was an act of pure barbarianism. 摧毀圖書館是純粹的野蠻行為。
Historians debated whether the collapse of the empire led to barbarianism. 歷史學家辯論帝國的崩溃是否導致了野蠻狀態。
Some critics feared that mass media would barbarianize public discourse. 一些批評者擔心大眾媒體會使公眾討論野蠻化。
Years of war tended to barbarianize the soldiers. 多年的戰爭往往使士兵變得野蠻。

meaning: 屬於野蠻人的或與野蠻人有關的；不文明的、不文明的或粗魯的。
sentences: a barbaric attack on a doctor in a hospital 醫院裡對醫生的野蠻攻擊
Something described as barbaric is of or relating to a barbarian; uncivilized, uncultured or uncouth. 被描述為野蠻的事物屬於野蠻人或與野蠻人有關；不文明的、不文明的或粗魯的。

meaning: 野蠻的；殘暴的；粗野的（同 barbaric）。
sentences: They protested against the barbarical treatment of prisoners. 他們抗議對囚犯的殘暴對待。
The ancient ritual seemed barbarical to modern observers. 對現代觀察者來說，古代儀式顯得非常野蠻。
The town was barbarically attacked during the night. 小鎮在夜間遭到了殘暴的襲擊。
He behaved barbarically toward his competitors. 他對待競爭對手的行為非常粗野。

meaning: 野蠻的；未開化的；殘酷的。
sentences: The barbarious customs of the tribe were documented by explorers. 探險家記錄了該部落野蠻的習俗。
It was a barbarious punishment for such a minor offense. 對於如此輕微的罪行，這是一種殘酷的處罰。
The sheer barbariousness of the crime shocked the nation. 罪行的極度殘暴震驚了全國。
Civilization is often defined in contrast to barbariousness. 文明通常是與野蠻相對應的。
The field guide listed barbarism beside related species. 圖鑑把一種野蠻的行為列在近緣物種旁。
The specimen label helped researchers identify barbarism. 標本標籤幫助研究人員辨認一種野蠻的行為。
The survivors told stories of incredible barbarity. 倖存者講述了令人難以置信的殘暴故事。
Laws were enacted to prevent such barbarity from happening again. 頒布法律是為了防止這種殘暴行為再次發生。
The decline of education led to a gradual barbarization of society. 教育的衰落導致社會逐漸野蠻化。
Scholars discussed the barbarization of the Roman army in its later years. 學者們討論了羅馬軍隊後期的野蠻化現象。
The conquest did not civilize the people but rather tended to barbarize them. 征服並沒有使人們文明化，反而往往使他們變得野蠻。
Without laws, society would quickly barbarize. 如果沒有法律，社會將迅速野蠻化。

meaning: 野蠻的；殘暴的；（語言）不純正的。
sentences: The prisoners were kept in barbarous conditions. 囚犯被關押在野蠻、惡劣的條件下。
He spoke a barbarous form of the local language. 他說著一種不純正的當地語言。
The hostages were treated barbarously by their captors. 人質受到了綁架者的野蠻對待。
The forest was barbarously cleared for agriculture. 森林為了農業而被野蠻地砍伐。
The barbarousness of the attack left everyone speechless. 襲擊的殘暴讓每個人都無言以對。
He was criticized for the barbarousness of his language. 他因言語粗鄙而受到批評。

meaning: 巴巴里（北非沿海地區，舊指摩洛哥至利比亞一帶）。
sentences: The Barbary pirates were a major threat to Mediterranean shipping. 巴巴里海盜曾是地中海航運的主要威脅。
History of the Barbary Coast is filled with tales of adventure. 巴巴里海岸的歷史充滿了冒險故事。

meaning: 巴巴里馬（一種產於北非的強壯馬種）。
sentences: The barbary is known for its endurance and speed. 巴巴里馬以其耐力和速度聞名。
He bought a fine barbary horse for racing. 他買了一匹優質的巴巴里馬用來比賽。
The old man stroked his long white barbas. 老人撫摸著他長長的白鬍鬚。
The plant has extensive barbas that help it absorb nutrients. 這種植物有發達的鬚根，幫助它吸收養分。

meaning: 毒魚藤（一種含魚藤酮的植物，常用於毒魚）。
sentences: Indigenous people use barbasco to stun fish in the river. 原住民使用毒魚藤來震暈河裡的魚。
Barbasco is also a source of natural pesticides. 毒魚藤也是天然殺蟲劑的來源。

meaning: 寬耳蝠（一種具有寬大耳朵的小型蝙蝠）。
sentences: The barbastel is a rare and protected species in Europe. 寬耳蝠在歐洲是一種稀有且受保護的物種。
We observed a barbastel flying near the old barn. 我們觀察到一隻寬耳蝠在舊穀倉附近飛翔。

meaning: 有鬍鬚的；（植物或動物）有長柔毛的。
sentences: The seeds of the plant are barbate, helping them cling to animal fur. 這種植物的種子帶有長柔毛，有助於它們附著在動物皮毛上。
He had a barbate chin that made him look older. 他長有鬍鬚的下巴讓他看起來年紀更大。

meaning: 有倒鉤的；有鬍鬚的（同 barbate）。
sentences: The fish was caught on a barbated hook. 這條魚是被帶倒鉤的魚鉤釣到的。
The barbated leaves were rough to the touch. 帶毛的葉子摸起來很粗糙。

meaning: （巴西）含羞草屬的一種植物（其樹皮富含單寧，常用於收斂藥）。
sentences: The healer boiled barbatimao bark for the rinse. 療癒師把巴爾巴蒂瑪奧樹皮煮來作沖洗液。
Barbatimao grows in Brazil and has a rough bark. 這種巴西含羞草屬植物有粗糙的樹皮。
We decided to have a barbe in the backyard this Sunday. 我們決定這週日後院辦個烤肉（燒烤）。
He is very good at barbe chicken and ribs on the grill. 他非常擅長在烤架上燒烤雞肉和肋排。
We are planning a backyard barbecue for the Fourth of July. 我們正計劃在 7 月 4 日辦一個後院燒烤派對。
The smell of the barbecue made everyone feel very hungry. 燒烤的味道讓每個人都感到很餓。

meaning: 有刺的；有倒鉤的；（言語）刺人的。
sentences: The fence was topped with barbed wire to discourage intruders. 圍欄頂部裝有帶刺鐵絲網以阻止入侵者。
She made a barbed remark about his lack of punctuality. 她對他的不守時發表了刺人的評論。

meaning: （巴西）錐蝽（一種能傳播克氏錐蟲，引起美洲錐蟲病的昆蟲）。
sentences: The barbeiro insect is a vector for Chagas disease. 錐蝽是美洲錐蟲病的媒介。
