sentences: The chef began to bebaste the turkey with its own juices. 廚師開始用火雞自身的汁液在火雞上塗油。
He threatened to bebaste anyone who dared to challenge him. 他威脅要毆打任何敢於挑戰他的人。
The waves continued to bebat the rocky shore. 波浪繼續拍打著岩石海岸。
He bebatted the rug to remove the dust. 他拍打地毯以除去灰塵。
The moonlight seemed to bebathe the garden in silver. 月光似乎將花園沐浴在銀輝之中。
Rain began to bebathe the parched fields. 雨水開始濕透乾涸的田野。
The storm continued to bebatter the coastal town. 暴風雨繼續猛擊著沿海小鎮。
The champion proceeded to bebatter his opponent. 冠軍繼續猛擊他的對手。
The hounds began to bebay the trapped fox. 獵犬開始對著被困的狐狸狂吠。
They were bebayed by the enemy forces. 他們被敵軍圍困了。
Cruelty can bebeast even the most gentle soul. 殘酷可以使最溫柔的靈魂也變得像野獸一樣。
The war threatened to bebeast the entire population. 戰爭威脅要使全體民眾都變得像野獸一樣野蠻。
The dormitory was well bebed for the students. 宿舍為學生們配備了充足的床鋪。
A bebed patient requires constant care. 臥床的病人需要不斷的照顧。

meaning: 貝比林（從貝比魯樹皮中提取的生物鹼）。
sentences: Bebeerine was historically used as an alternative to quinine. 貝比林在歷史上曾被用作金雞納霜的替代品。
The chemist isolated bebeerine from the tropical bark. 化學家從熱帶樹皮中分離出貝比林。

meaning: 貝比魯樹（產於圭亞那，木材堅硬）。
sentences: The wood of the bebeeru tree is highly resistant to decay. 貝比魯樹的木材具有極強的抗腐能力。
Bebeeru bark is the source of the alkaloid bebeerine. 貝比魯樹皮是生物鹼貝比林的來源。

meaning: 繫腰帶的；獲得爵位的（指佩劍男爵）。
sentences: A bebelted knight stood guard at the gate. 一位繫著腰帶（或有爵位）的騎士在門口把守。
The uniform was smartly bebelted. 制服俐落地繫上了腰帶。

meaning: （菲律賓語）一種飾物或邊緣飾件。
sentences: The traditional dress was adorned with intricate bebilya. 傳統服裝裝飾有精緻的邊緣飾件。
She carefully sewed the bebilya onto the hem. 她仔細地將飾件縫在邊緣上。
The sharp frost began to bebite the blossoms. 嚴霜開始凍傷（咬）花朵。
The insects continue to bebite the hikers. 昆蟲繼續叮咬徒步旅行者。
The children practiced bebization on the scale. 孩子們在音階練唱名法。
The choir teacher preferred bebization over letters. 合唱團老師在練唱時偏好唱名法。
The heat began to beblain the skin. 熱氣開始使皮膚長滿水泡。
His hands were beblained from the hard work. 他的手因辛苦工作而長滿了水泡。

meaning: 弄模糊（尤指眼睛因哭泣而模糊）。
sentences: Her eyes were bebleared with constant weeping. 她的眼睛因不斷哭泣而變得模糊。
Mist began to beblear the mountain peak. 薄霧開始弄模糊山峰。
The bebled soldier was carried from the field. 滿身是血的士兵被抬離戰場。
His bebled face showed the intensity of the struggle. 他滿身是血的臉顯示了鬥爭的激烈。
The priest rose to bebless the congregation. 牧師站起來祝福信眾。
May fortune bebless your every endeavor. 願好運祝福你的每一次努力。
The hot oil began to beblister the cook's hand. 熱油開始使廚師的手長出水泡。
The sun's rays will beblister your skin if you are not careful. 如果你不小心，陽光會使你的皮膚長水泡。
The battle will beblood the soil of this land. 戰鬥將使這片土地的土壤沾滿鮮血。
He sought to beblood his sword in the name of justice. 他試圖以正義之名讓他的劍沾滿鮮血。
Spring will bebloom the orchards. 春天將使果園開滿鮮花。
She decided to bebloom the balcony with geraniums. 她決定用天竺葵來裝飾陽台。
The ink began to beblotch the important document. 墨水開始弄髒這份重要的文件並使其佈滿斑點。
Disease began to beblotch the leaves of the tree. 疾病開始使樹葉佈滿斑點。
Her face was beblubbered after hours of crying. 哭了幾個小時後，她的臉都腫了。
The child's beblubbered cheeks were red from the cold. 孩子因哭泣而腫脹的臉頰因寒冷而發紅。
The heavy cart began to bebog in the mud. 重型貨車開始陷入泥沼。
Unexpected problems could bebog the entire project. 意想不到的問題可能會使整個項目陷入泥沼。

meaning: 咆哮樂（一種爵士樂風格）。
sentences: Charlie Parker was a pioneer of bebop. 查利·帕克是咆哮樂的先驅。
Bebop is characterized by fast tempos and complex harmonies. 咆哮樂的特點是快節奏和複雜的和聲。
He likes to beboss his younger siblings around. 他喜歡差遣他的弟弟妹妹。
Don't try to beboss me in my own kitchen. 不要試圖在我自己的廚房裡指揮我。
The plumber managed to bebotch the simple repair. 水管工竟然把簡單的修理給弄壞了。
I don't want to bebotch this opportunity. 我不想搞砸這個機會。
He looked bebothered by the constant noise. 他看起來被不斷的噪音所困擾。
I am too bebothered with work to go out tonight. 我今晚忙於工作，沒法出去。
They struggled to cross the bebouldered stream. 他們艱難地穿過佈滿巨石的小溪。
The bebouldered landscape was difficult to navigate. 充滿巨石的地形難以通行。
The general tried to bebrave his soldiers before the charge. 將軍在衝鋒前試圖鼓勵士兵們勇敢起來。
She had to bebrave the cold to get home. 她不得不冒著嚴寒回家。
It was time to bebreech the young boy as he grew older. 隨著男孩長大，是時候給他穿上褲子了。
The child was smartly bebreeched for the family portrait. 孩子穿著得體的褲子拍家庭合影。

meaning: 浸泡在鹽水中；弄濕（如用淚水）。
sentences: The chef will bebrine the olives for several weeks. 廚師將把橄欖浸泡在鹽水中幾週。
Her cheeks were bebrined with salty tears. 她的臉頰被鹹鹹的淚水弄濕了。
He sought to bebrother his new colleagues. 他試圖待他的新同事如兄弟一般。
The two men were bebrothered by their shared experiences. 這兩個人因共同的經歷而情同手足。
He began to bebrush his coat before leaving. 出門前他開始刷他的大衣。
She bebushed the horse's mane until it shone. 她刷著馬鬃直到它閃閃發亮。
The cart began to bebump along the rough road. 車子開始在崎嶇的道路上顛簸碰撞。
He bebumped his head on the low ceiling. 他的頭撞到了低矮的天花板上。
Preparation for the wedding will bebusy the whole family. 婚禮的準備工作將使全家人都忙碌起來。
She sought to bebusy herself with charity work. 她試圖讓自己忙於慈善工作。

meaning: 扣上鈕扣的；有很多鈕扣的。
sentences: He wore a smartly bebuttoned uniform. 他穿著一件扣得整整齊齊的制服。
The bebuttoned boots were difficult to put on. 帶有很多鈕扣的靴子很難穿上。
The sailors began to becall the passing ships. 水手們開始向經過的船隻大聲呼喚。
He was becalled by his rivals in the press. 他在媒體上受到了對手的咒罵。

meaning: 使平靜；使（船）因無風而停泊。
sentences: The morning air helped to becalm his nerves. 早晨的空氣有助於平息他的緊張情緒。
The sailing ship was becalmed for three days in the Atlantic. 這艘帆船在大西洋因無風而停泊了三天。
The becalmment of the sea was a welcome sight after the storm. 暴風雨後大海的平靜是個令人欣慰的景象。
A period of becalmment delayed the fleet's arrival. 一段時間的停泊延誤了艦隊的到達。
He became a famous actor after starring in the hit movie. 他在主演了那部熱門電影後成為了一名著名演員。
The weather suddenly became cold as the sun went down. 隨著太陽下山，天氣突然變冷了。
The nurse began to becap the patient for the surgery. 護士開始為病人戴上手術帽。
The mountain peak was becapped with snow. 山頂被白雪覆蓋（戴上了雪帽）。

meaning: 傘鳥（一種美洲熱帶鳥類）。
sentences: The rose-throated becard is a beautiful bird found in Mexico. 瑰喉傘鳥是一種在墨西哥發現的美麗鳥類。
Ornithologists observed the nesting habits of the becard. 鳥類學家觀察了傘鳥的築巢習慣。
They decided to becarpet the entire living room. 他們決定給整個客廳鋪上地毯。
Fallen leaves began to becarpet the forest floor. 落葉開始像地毯一樣覆蓋森林地面。
The sculptor began to becarve the marble block. 雕塑家開始雕刻大理石塊。
History is becarved into the walls of the ancient temple. 歷史被雕刻在古廟的牆壁上。
A becassocked priest led the procession. 一位穿著法衣的牧師帶領著隊伍。
The choir members were all becassocked in red. 合唱隊員們都穿著紅色的法衣。

meaning: 提供飲食；迎合（強調用法）。
sentences: The hotel will becater for the large wedding reception. 酒店將為這場大型婚禮招待會提供飲食。
The program was designed to becater to the needs of the elderly. 該計劃旨在迎合老年人的需求。
I was late for work because of the heavy traffic. 因為交通擁堵，我上班遲到了。
She is happy because she passed all her exams. 她很高興，因為她通過了所有考試。

meaning: 食無花果鳥（一種常被捕食的小鳥）。
sentences: The beccafico is considered a delicacy in some Mediterranean countries. 在一些地中海國家，食無花果鳥被認為是美味佳餚。
A beccafico is a small songbird that feeds on figs. 食無花果鳥是一種以無花果為食的小型鳴禽。
The priest rose to becense the altar. 牧師站起來用香薰祭壇。
The sweet smell of incense began to becense the room. 香的甜味開始薰滿房間。
The bechained prisoner waited for his trial. 被鎖鏈鎖住的囚犯等待著審判。
A bechained dog barked at the intruders. 一隻被鎖著的狗向闖入者狂吠。
The children began to bechalk the pavement. 孩子們開始用粉筆在人行道上塗抹。
He used a piece of white stone to bechalk his name on the wall. 他用一塊白石頭在牆上塗抹他的名字。
Whatever may bechance, we must remain united. 無論發生什麼，我們都必須保持團結。
It may bechance that we meet again in the future. 也許我們將來會偶然再次相遇。

meaning: 迷住；施魔法於（強調用法）。
sentences: The beauty of the forest seemed to becharm everyone. 森林的美麗似乎迷住了每一個人。
She used her wit and grace to becharm the audience. 她用她的機智和優雅迷住了觀眾。
The hounds began to bechase the stag. 獵犬開始追逐雄鹿。
The silver cup was bechased with intricate designs. 銀杯上雕刻著精緻的圖案。

meaning: 喋喋不休；使格格作響（強調用法）。
sentences: The monkeys began to bechatter in the trees. 猴子們開始在樹上喋喋不休。
The cold wind made his teeth bechatter. 寒風使他的牙齒格格作響。
He was hired to bechauffeur the wealthy family around the city. 他被雇用為這戶富裕人家在城裡開車。
She enjoyed being bechauffeured in a luxurious limousine. 她喜歡有人開著豪華轎車接送她。
They sought to becheck the enemy's advance. 他們試圖阻止敵人的進攻。
He carefully bechecked all the entries in the ledger. 他仔細檢查了帳簿中的所有條目。
He raised his becher to offer a toast. 他舉起高腳杯敬酒。
The silver becher was an heirloom of the family. 那隻銀杯是家族的傳家寶。
The soldiers began to bechern after the victory. 勝利後士兵們開始痛飲。
They spent the whole night becherning at the tavern. 他們整晚都在酒館裡狂飲。
A bechignoned lady sat elegantly in the front row. 一位梳著髮髻的女士優雅地坐在前排。
Her hair was neatly bechignoned for the ball. 她的頭髮整齊地梳成髮髻去參加舞會。
Birds began to bechirp at the break of dawn. 鳥兒在黎明時分開始啁啾。
The crickets bechirped in the long grass. 蟋蟀在長草叢中吱吱叫。

meaning: 貝希特勒（姓氏，尤指 19 世紀北卡羅來納州的私人鑄幣者）。
sentences: Bechtler gold coins are highly valued by collectors. 貝希特勒金幣深受收藏家珍視。
Christopher Bechtler established a private mint. 克里斯托弗·貝希特勒建立了一個私人鑄幣廠。

meaning: 茨瓦納人（波札那及其鄰近地區的一支民族）。
sentences: The Bechuana people have a rich cultural heritage. 茨瓦納人擁有豐富的文化遺產。
He studied the history and customs of the Bechuana. 他研究了茨瓦納人的歷史和習俗。
The old oak tree was becircled by a low stone wall. 那棵老橡樹被一堵低矮的石牆環繞著。
A becircled target appeared on the screen. 屏幕上出現了一個圈起的目標。
He sought to becivet his clothes with a strong fragrance. 他試圖在衣服上塗上濃郁的麝香香氣。
The air was beciveted with the scent of perfume. 空氣中瀰漫著麝香般的香水味。

meaning: 顯著的點頭，或頭部或手的動作，尤其是作為呼叫或命令。
sentences: He made a beck with his hand. 他用手做了個招手動作。
A small beck brought the dog closer. 一個輕輕的招手動作把狗叫近了。

meaning: 矽鈰鈣礦（一種稀有的礦物）。
sentences: Beckelite is a complex silicate mineral containing rare earth elements. 矽鈰鈣礦是一種含有稀土元素的複雜矽酸鹽礦物。
The researchers found a deposit of beckelite in the region. 研究人員在該地區發現了矽鈰鈣礦床。
The chef grilled a becker with lemon. 主廚用檸檬烤了一條歐洲魚。
We caught a becker near the rocky shore. 我們在岩岸附近捕到一條歐洲魚。
The sailor used a becket to secure the spare line. 水手用索環固定備用繩索。
The handles of the sea chest were made of rope beckets. 海員箱的手柄是由繩索索環製成的。

meaning: 貝琪（女子名，Rebecca 的暱稱）。
sentences: Beckie is going to the park with her friends. 貝琪要和她的朋友們去公園。
We all call her Beckie instead of Rebecca. 我們都叫她貝琪，而不是麗貝卡。
The jeweler used a beckiron to shape the silver ring. 珠寶商用單角砧來塑造銀戒指的形狀。
A beckiron is useful for bending small pieces of metal. 單角砧對於彎曲小塊金屬非常有用。
She beckoned to the waiter for the bill. 她向服務員招手示意要帳單。
The bright future seemed to beckon the young ambitious man. 燦爛的前程似乎在吸引著那個雄心勃勃的年輕人。
He acted as a beckoner, leading the crowd toward the stage. 他充當招手示意者，帶領人群走向舞台。
The distant mountains were a constant beckoner to explorers. 遙遠的山脈對探險家們來說是一個恆久的吸引物。
She saw a beckoning hand in the darkness. 她在黑暗中看到一隻在招手示意的手。
The beckoning lights of the city could be seen from the hills. 從山上可以看到城裡那誘人的燈光。
The open door stood beckoningly in the hallway. 敞開的門誘人地矗立在走廊裡。
She smiled beckoningly at him from across the room. 她在房間另一頭對他露出了誘人的微笑。

meaning: 貝姬（女子名，Rebecca 的暱稱）。
sentences: Becky Sharp is the protagonist of Vanity Fair. 貝姬·夏普是《虛榮市》的主角。
Her sister Becky is visiting from London. 她的妹妹貝姬正從倫敦來訪。

meaning: 穿衣的；覆蓋的（強調用法）。
sentences: The hills were beclad in a mantle of green. 山丘覆蓋著一層綠裝。
A beclad figure appeared at the doorway. 一個穿著衣服的人影出現在門口。

meaning: 大聲喧嚷；叫喊（強調用法）。
sentences: The crowd began to beclamor for justice. 群眾開始大聲要求正義。
Don't beclamor me with your endless complaints. 不要用你沒完沒了的抱怨來對我大聲嚷嚷。
The birds beclamour the morning air with their songs. 鳥兒們的歌聲在晨間的空氣中大聲喧嚷。
Protesters continue to beclamour for reform. 抗議者繼續大聲要求改革。
The armor began to beclang as they marched. 盔甲在他們行軍時開始發出鏗鏘聲。
Iron tools beclanged against the stone walls. 鐵製工具在石牆上發出鏗鏘的撞擊聲。
He managed to beclart his new boots in the garden. 他在花園裡把新靴子弄得滿是泥土。
The children's clothes were beclarted after playing outside. 孩子們在外面玩耍後，衣服都弄髒了。
She sought to beclasp her child in a warm embrace. 她試圖將孩子緊緊抱在懷裡。
The ivy began to beclasp the ancient tower. 常春藤開始緊緊攀附著那座古塔。

meaning: 發出嘩啦聲；吵鬧（強調用法）。
sentences: The falling dishes beclattered across the floor. 摔落的碟子在地上發出嘩啦聲。
The rain beclattered on the tin roof. 雨水在錫屋頂上發出嘩啦嘩啦的響聲。
The angry cat began to beclaw the furniture. 憤怒的貓開始用爪子抓家具。
He was beclawed by the wild animal during the struggle. 他在鬥爭中被野獸抓傷了。

meaning: 遮掩；披上斗篷（強調用法）。
sentences: Fog began to becloak the entire city. 霧氣開始籠罩（遮掩）整個城市。
He sought to becloak his true intentions with lies. 他試圖用謊言來掩蓋他的真實意圖。
Grease can beclog the kitchen drain. 油脂會阻塞廚房排水管。
Too many rules can beclog the progress of the project. 太多的規矩會妨礙項目的進展。
Nature began to beclothe the ruins in green ivy. 大自然開始用綠色的常春藤覆蓋廢墟。
She sought to beclothe her family in the finest silk. 她試圖讓她的家人穿上最上乘的絲綢。
Misinformation can becloud the public's judgment. 誤導性信息會模糊大眾的判斷。
Dark clouds began to becloud the morning sky. 烏雲開始遮蔽清晨的天空。
The grandmother began to beclout the child to keep him warm. 祖母開始用布包裹孩子以保暖。
He threatened to beclout anyone who insulted him. 他威脅要打任何侮辱他的人。
He managed to beclown himself at the party. 他在聚會上使自己看起來像個小丑。
Don't try to beclown the seriousness of the situation. 不要試圖把這種嚴肅的情況當成兒戲（扮小丑）。
Stars began to becluster in the night sky. 星星開始在夜空中成群出現。
Grapes beclustered the vines in the vineyard. 葡萄在葡萄園的藤蔓上成簇生長。
The attic had been allowed to becobweb over the years. 閣樓多年來一直任由其佈滿蜘蛛網。
Old memories began to becobweb his mind. 舊回憶開始在他腦海中佈滿蛛絲。
An elegantly becoiffed woman entered the ballroom. 一位梳著優雅髮型的女性進入了宴會廳。
She remained perfectly becoiffed throughout the long evening. 在漫長的夜晚，她的髮型始終保持得很完美。
The smoke began to becollier the white walls. 煙霧開始弄黑白牆。

sentences: The morning mist began to bedew the garden flowers. 晨霧開始打濕花園裡的花朵。
Tears began to bedew her cheeks as she heard the story. 聽著故事，她的臉頰開始被淚水打濕。
The bedewer of the lawn made sure every blade of grass was wet. 灑水器確保草地的每一根草都被打濕了。
Rain acted as a natural bedewer for the thirsty earth. 雨水是大地的天然濕潤者。

meaning: 為他人祈禱的婦女；領受救濟金的婦女（bedesman 的女性形式）。
sentences: The elderly bedewoman spent her days in the chapel. 那位年邁的祈禱婦女整天待在小教堂裡。
She was known as a pious bedewoman in the community. 她在社區裡是一位知名的虔誠祈禱婦女。
He has been bedfast for several months due to illness. 由於生病，他已經臥床不起好幾個月了。
A bedfast patient requires constant nursing care. 臥床不起的病人需要不斷的護理照顧。
Politics often makes strange bedfellows. 政治常使奇怪的人成為盟友。
The two companies became unlikely bedfellows in the merger. 這兩家公司在合併中成為了意想不到的夥伴。
The shared danger created a strong sense of bedfellowship among the soldiers. 共同的危險在士兵之間建立了一種強烈的夥伴關係。
They maintained a long-term professional bedfellowship. 他們保持著長期的專業夥伴關係。
The room was filled with the scent of bedflowers. 房間裡充滿了床上裝飾花的香味。
She placed a single bedflower on the pillow. 她在枕頭上放了一朵床飾花。
He placed his slippers at the bedfoot every night. 他每天晚上把拖鞋放在床腳。
A heavy trunk sat at the bedfoot of the old wooden bed. 一個沉重的箱子放在那張舊木床的床腳。

meaning: 貝德福德（地名或車型名）。
sentences: They moved to a small cottage in Bedford. 他們搬到了貝德福德的一個小農舍。
The old Bedford truck was still running perfectly. 那輛舊的貝德福德卡車仍在完美地運行。
The metal bedframe was sturdy and easy to assemble. 金屬床架堅固且易於組裝。
He painted the wooden bedframe to match the room's decor. 他給木製床架上了漆，以搭配房間的裝飾。

meaning: 臥具；床鋪（強調用法或方言）。
sentences: The modest room contained only basic bedgery. 這間樸素的房間裡只有基本的臥具。
He was responsible for organizing the bedgery for the camp. 他負責為營地整理臥具。
He is an early bedgoer and usually sleeps by 9 PM. 他是個早睡的人，通常晚上 9 點就睡了。
Late bedgoers often find it hard to wake up early. 晚睡的人通常很難早起。
She put on her silk bedgown before going to sleep. 她睡前穿上了絲綢睡袍。
The child looked adorable in his oversized bedgown. 孩子穿著過大的睡袍，看起來很可愛。

meaning: 床頭板，（剛起床時）凌亂的頭髮
sentences: The wooden bedhead was beautifully carved with intricate patterns. 木製床頭板上刻有精美的複雜圖案。
He tried to fix his bedhead before heading to the kitchen for breakfast. 他試圖在去廚房吃早餐前整理一下凌亂的頭髮（剛起床的亂髮）。
The bediademed princess entered the grand hall. 戴著王冠的公主進入了大廳。
The night sky seemed bediademed with stars. 夜空似乎被繁星點綴得如同戴上了王冠一般。
The queen's bediamonded fingers sparkled in the candlelight. 女王那飾有鑽石的手指在燭光下閃閃發亮。
A bediamonded necklace hung elegantly around her neck. 一條飾有鑽石的項鍊優雅地掛在她的脖子上。

meaning: 飾以菱形圖案；給...換尿布（強調用法）。
sentences: The walls were bediapered with intricate patterns. 牆壁上飾以精緻的菱形圖案。
The mother began to bediaper the baby before his nap. 母親在寶寶午睡前開始給他換尿布。

meaning: 裝飾；穿戴（古語，強調用法）。
sentences: The knight was bedight in shining armor. 騎士穿著閃亮的盔甲。
Flowers bedight the path leading to the garden. 鮮花裝點著通往花園的小路。

meaning: （猶太教）檢查（尤指對儀式潔淨度的檢查）。
sentences: The rabbi performed the bedikah with great care. 拉比非常仔細地進行了檢查。
Bedikah is an important part of maintaining ritual purity. 檢查是保持儀式潔淨的重要部分。

meaning: 使模糊；使暗淡（強調用法）。
sentences: Age began to bedim his eyesight. 年齡使他的視力開始模糊。
Smoke from the fire began to bedim the sunset. 火災產生的煙霧使日落顯得暗淡。

meaning: 使起漣漪；使現酒窩（強調用法）。
sentences: A light breeze began to bedimple the surface of the lake. 微風使湖面泛起漣漪。
A smile began to bedimple her cheeks. 微笑使她的臉頰現出了酒窩。
They followed the leader bedin. 他們相繼跟隨著領導者。
The news spread through the town bedin. 消息立即在鎮上傳開了。
He began to bedip the bread in the soup. 他開始把麵包蘸進湯裡。
The oarsman would bedip the oars into the calm water. 划槳手把槳浸入平靜的水中。

meaning: 弄髒；使沾滿污垢（強調用法）。
sentences: The long journey managed to bedirt his entire coat. 漫長的旅程把他的整件大衣都弄髒了。
Don't bedirt your shoes in the mud. 不要把鞋子弄髒在泥地裡。
The dog acted as the primary bedirter of the clean rug. 那隻狗是乾淨地毯的主要弄髒者。
Smoke is a constant bedirter of the city's buildings. 煙霧是不斷弄髒城市建築的元兇。
He didn't want to bedirty his hands with such work. 他不想讓自己的手因這種工作而弄髒。
The dust began to bedirty the windows. 灰塵開始弄髒窗戶。

meaning: 使憂鬱；使陰沉（強調用法）。
sentences: The constant rain began to bedismal the entire week. 持續的雨天使整個星期都顯得陰沉。
Bad news could bedismal even the most cheerful person. 壞消息會讓最開朗的人也變得憂鬱。
She chose to bedizen herself with cheap, flashy jewelry. 她選擇用廉價且閃亮的珠寶把自己打扮得花裡胡哨。
The hall was bedizened with gaudy decorations for the party. 大廳為了聚會裝飾得非常俗氣。

meaning: 俗氣的打扮；過分的裝飾。
sentences: Her bedizenment was a source of amusement for the guests. 她的俗氣打扮成了客人們的笑料。
The excessive bedizenment of the room made it feel cluttered. 房間過分的裝飾使其顯得雜亂無章。

meaning: 床匙（用於擰緊舊式床架螺栓的工具）。
sentences: He used a bedkey to assemble the antique bedframe. 他用床匙組裝了那件古董床架。
The bedkey was a common tool in 19th-century households. 床匙在 19 世紀的家庭中是一種常見工具。
The classroom turned into bedlam once the teacher left. 老師一離開，教室就陷入了一片混亂。
It was absolute bedlam at the airport during the holiday rush. 假期高峰期，機場簡直是一片混亂。
The bedlamer shouted from the window. 那個瘋子在窗邊大喊。
Doctors watched the bedlamer with care. 醫生小心看護那位瘋人院住民。

meaning: 混亂的；瘋狂的；與瘋人院有關的。
sentences: The scene was Bedlamic, with everyone shouting at once. 場景非常混亂，每個人都在同時大喊大叫。
He described the conditions in the old hospital as Bedlamic. 他將那家舊醫院的情況描述為極其混亂且瘋狂的。
The protest eventually devolved into bedlamism. 抗議活動最終演變成了混亂狀態。
His bedlamism made it difficult for others to work with him. 他的瘋狂行為讓別人很難與他合作。
The man acted like a bedlamite, waving his arms and screaming. 那個人表現得像個瘋子，揮舞著手臂尖叫著。
They were treated as bedlamites by the authorities. 他們被當局當作瘋子對待。
He showed a bedlamitish lack of concern for his own safety. 他表現出一種瘋子般對自身安全的漠視。
The bedlamitish noise from the party kept the neighbors awake. 聚會那瘋狂的噪音讓鄰居們徹夜難眠。
The sudden change in plans threatened to bedlamize the office. 計劃的突然改變威脅到要使整個辦公室陷入混亂。
Continuous stress can bedlamize even the strongest mind. 持續的壓力甚至可以使最強大的意志發瘋。

meaning: （古語）臥床不起的人；拉撒路（受苦者）。
sentences: The poor bedlar relied on the charity of the church. 可憐的臥床者依靠教會的施捨度日。
He spent his final years as a bedlar in a small cottage. 他在一個小農舍裡作為一名臥床不起的人度過了最後的歲月。
The earthquake left many families bedless and homeless. 地震使許多家庭失去了床鋪和家園。
They spent a bedless night in the crowded shelter. 他們在擁擠的避難所裡度過了一個無床可睡的夜晚。

meaning: 床蓋；被蓋（方言或強調用法）。
sentences: She pulled the bedlids up to her chin to stay warm. 她把被蓋拉到下巴處以保暖。
The colorful bedlids brightened up the small bedroom. 五彩繽紛的床蓋照亮了這間小臥室。
The bedmaker arrived early to tidy the students' rooms. 鋪床人很早就到了，來整理學生的房間。
At Oxford, the bedmaker is a traditional role in the colleges. 在牛津大學，鋪床人是學院裡的一個傳統角色。
Correct bedmaking is a skill taught in nursing school. 正確的鋪床方法是護理學校教授的一項技能。
She finished the bedmaking before starting her other chores. 她在開始做其他家務前先整理好了床鋪。
The king's bedman was a trusted confidant. 國王的臥伴（或男僕）是一位值得信賴的心腹。
He served as a bedman for the elderly lord. 他擔任這位老勳爵的男僕。
The dog has become my favorite bedmate during the winter. 冬天時，這隻狗成了我最喜歡的床伴。
Children often prefer a stuffed animal as a bedmate. 孩子們通常更喜歡用毛絨玩具當床伴。

meaning: 行醫；醫治；給...看病（強調用法）。
sentences: They sought to bedoctor the injured animal. 他們試圖醫治那隻受傷的動物。
He was bedoctored by the finest surgeons in the country. 他由國內最好的外科醫生醫治。
The detective began to bedog the suspect through the city. 偵探開始在城裡跟蹤嫌疑人。
Bad luck seemed to bedog his every step. 厄運似乎步步跟隨著他。
Don't let these trivial matters bedolt your mind. 不要讓這些瑣事使你的頭腦變笨。
He felt bedolted by the sheer complexity of the task. 他感到這項任務的極其複雜性讓他變傻了。

meaning: 點綴；使佈滿點（強調用法）。
sentences: Freckles began to bedot her nose after a day in the sun. 在陽光下待了一天後，雀斑開始點綴在她的鼻子上。
Stars bedot the clear desert sky at night. 夜晚，星星點綴著清澈的沙漠天空。

meaning: 溺愛；極度喜愛（強調用法）。
sentences: The grandparents tend to bedote their only grandson. 祖父母傾向於溺愛他們唯一的孫子。
She would bedote her pets with the finest treats. 她會用最上乘的零食來寵愛她的寵物。

meaning: 貝都因人（阿拉伯游牧民族）。
sentences: The Bedouin are known for their hospitality and desert survival skills. 貝都因人以其熱情好客和沙漠生存技能而聞名。
We visited a Bedouin camp during our desert excursion. 我們在沙漠遠足期間參觀了一個貝都因人營地。

meaning: 貝都因人的生活方式或習俗。
sentences: He spent years studying Bedouinism in the Middle East. 他花了數年時間研究中東的貝都因人生活方式。
Bedouinism involves a deep connection to the desert environment. 貝都因人的生活方式涉及與沙漠環境的深刻聯繫。

meaning: 弄濕；浸入水中（強調用法）。
sentences: A sudden wave managed to bedouse the entire boat. 突如其來的浪潮把整艘船都弄濕了。

The weight of the snow will bedown the branches. 雪的重量會壓彎樹枝。
They sought to bedown the obstacles in their path. 他們試圖排除（使倒下）前進道路上的障礙。
The palace dancers performed bedoyo at dusk. 宮廷舞者在黃昏表演爪哇宮廷舞蹈。
Visitors watched a slow bedoyo in the courtyard. 來賓在庭院裡欣賞一段緩慢的爪哇宮廷舞蹈。

Each corner of the old-fashioned bed was supported by a tall bedpost. 這張舊式床的每個角落都由一根高高的床柱支撐著。

Her grandmother hand-stitched a beautiful bedquilt for her. 她的祖母為她手工縫製了一件美麗的床罩。
The thick bedquilt kept them warm during the snowy night. 厚厚的被褥讓他們在雪夜裡保持溫暖。

meaning: 使沾上泥土或水；弄髒（強調用法）。
sentences: The children managed to bedrabble their clothes in the puddles. 孩子們在水窪裡把衣服弄得滿是泥水。
Don't bedrabble your new dress before the party. 聚會前不要弄髒你的新連衣裙。

sentences: The rain began to bedraggle the hem of her long skirt. 雨水開始打濕並弄髒她長裙的邊緣。
He looked tired and bedraggled after the long march. 在長途跋涉後，他看起來疲憊不堪，衣衫襤褸。
The bedragglement of the hikers was evident after the storm. 暴風雨過後，徒步旅行者們的狼狽樣顯而易見。
She laughed at the state of bedragglement she found herself in. 她嘲笑自己那副濕透且狼狽的樣子。
The hospital bed was equipped with adjustable bedrails for safety. 醫院病床配有可調節的護欄以確保安全。
He gripped the bedrail to help himself sit up. 他握住床邊護欄來幫自己坐起來。

meaning: （蘇格蘭語）教堂司事；臥床不起的人。
sentences: The old bedral was responsible for the upkeep of the church. 老司事負責教堂的維護工作。
The village bedral spent his days watching life from his window. 村裡的臥床者整天從窗口觀察生活。

meaning: 用布蓋上；垂掛（強調用法）。
sentences: They began to bedrape the windows with heavy velvet. 他們開始用厚重的絲絨垂掛在窗戶上。
The altar was bedraped with white silk for the ceremony. 祭壇為了儀式蓋上了白色的絲綢。

Unexpected complications can bedravel the simplest plans. 意外的複雜情況會弄亂最簡單的計劃。

meaning: 使濕透；使浸透（強調用法）。

Her clothes were bedrenched with sweat after the workout. 鍛煉後，她的衣服被汗水浸透了。
She began to bedress the doll in a fancy outfit. 她開始給玩偶穿上華麗的服裝。
The shop windows were bedressed for the upcoming holiday. 商店櫥窗為了即將到來的節日裝飾一新。
Water began to bedribble from the leaky pipe. 水從漏水的管子裡滴了下來。
The infant began to bedribble on his bib. 嬰兒開始在圍兜上流口水。

meaning: 臥床不起的（bedridden 的簡寫或古語形式）。
sentences: The bedrid patient needed constant assistance. 臥床不起的病人需要不斷的幫助。
He had been bedrid for years before he passed away. 他在去世前已經臥床多年。
His bedridden grandmother enjoyed listening to the radio. 他那臥床不起的祖母喜歡聽收音機。
Care for bedridden individuals can be physically demanding. 照顧臥床不起的人在體力上可能要求很高。
The patient's bedriddenness led to muscle weakness. 病人的長期臥床導致了肌肉無力。
The complications of bedriddenness must be carefully managed. 必須仔細管理長期臥床所帶來的併發症。

meaning: 使漂流；使隨風飄蕩（強調用法）。
sentences: The snow began to bedrift across the open fields. 雪開始在開闊的田野上隨風飄蕩（堆積）。
They were bedrifted in the middle of the lake. 他們在湖中央漂流。
In historical legal contexts, bedright was a recognized concept. 在歷史法律背景下，同房權是一個被認可的概念。
The contract specified various family and bedrights. 合同規定了各種家庭和婚姻權利。

meaning: 滴下；使沾滿水滴（強調用法）。
sentences: The wet umbrella began to bedrip the floor. 濕雨傘開始往地板上滴水。
Rain managed to bedrip the leaves of every tree. 雨水打濕了每棵樹的葉子，水滴不斷滴下。

meaning: 流口水；胡說八道（強調用法）。
sentences: The drunkard began to bedrivel nonsense. 那個醉漢開始胡言亂語。
Don't bedrivel your time with such useless talk. 不要把時間浪費在這種無意義的胡扯上。
The gray clouds began to bedrizzle the city. 烏雲開始在城市上空下起毛毛雨。
It continued to bedrizzle throughout the afternoon. 整個下午毛毛雨下個不停。

Education became the bedrock of his life. 教育成了他人生的根基。
The hiker tied his bedroll to the top of his backpack. 徒步旅行者將他的鋪蓋卷繫在背包頂部。
Sleeping in a bedroll on the ground was part of the camping experience. 睡在地面上的鋪蓋卷裡是露營體驗的一部分。
Their new house has three large bedrooms upstairs. 他們的新房子樓上有三間大臥室。
I usually read for a while in my bedroom before sleeping. 我通常睡前會在臥室讀一會兒書。

meaning: 滴落於；灑上；用點點裝飾
sentences: The morning dew began to bedrop the petals of the roses. 清晨的露珠開始滴落在玫瑰花瓣上。
Stars bedrop the midnight sky with brilliance. 繁星點點裝飾著午夜燦爛的天空。
The fields were bedrown by the sudden torrential rain. 田野被突如其來的暴雨淹沒了。
He was bedrown in sorrow after the tragic news. 在不幸的消息傳來後，他沉浸在悲痛之中。
The monotonous lecture started to bedrowse the students. 單調的講座開始讓學生們感到昏昏欲睡。
Warm sunshine can bedrowse even the most energetic child. 溫暖的陽光甚至能讓最有活力的孩子感到困倦。
The patient was bedrugged to ease the severe pain. 病人被施以藥物以減輕劇烈的疼痛。
He appeared bedrugged and confused after the operation. 手術後他顯得因藥物影響而神志不清。

meaning: 床用螺絲；固定床架的螺栓
sentences: We need a large bedscrew to fix the old wooden bed frame. 我們需要一個大的床用螺絲來固定這具舊木床架。
Make sure the bedscrew is tight so the bed doesn't wobble. 確保床用螺栓已擰緊，這樣床就不會搖晃。

meaning: 患病臥床的；因病不能下床的
sentences: He has been bedsick for over a week with a heavy cold. 他因重感冒已經臥床不起超過一個星期了。
The bedsick patient required constant care from the nurses. 臥床不起的病人需要護士不斷的照顧。
She kept a glass of water on her bedside table. 她在床頭櫃上放了一杯水。

Binucleated cells were observed in the sample. 在樣本中觀察到了雙核細胞。
The binucleated condition is common in some fungi. 雙核狀態在某些真菌中很常見。

Binucleolate structures were identified in the neuron. 在神經元中識別出具雙核仁的結構。

meaning: 生物化學的或與之相關的。
sentences: Something described as biochemical is of, or relating to biochemistry. 被描述為生物化學的東西屬於生物化學或與生物化學有關。

Each biochore has its own climatic conditions. 每個生物生活區都有其自己的氣候條件。

Climate change is a major topic in bioclimatology. 氣候變化是生物氣候學的一個主要課題。

A friend brought up biod on the bus. 朋友在公車上提起了生物計量單位。

Biodynamic farming avoids the use of artificial chemicals. 生物動力耕作避免使用人工化學品。

Biodynamics explores the energy and forces within living organisms. 生物動力學探索生物體內的能量與力量。
He studied biodynamics to understand plant growth cycles. 他研究生物動力學以了解植物的生長週期。

The bioecological balance of the reef is very delicate. 珊瑚礁的生物生態平衡非常脆弱。

The bioecologist identified several rare plant species in the area. 這位生物生態學家在該地區發現了幾種稀有植物物種。
As a bioecologist, she studies how organisms interact with their environment. 作為一名生物生態學家，她研究生物如何與環境互動。
Bioecology is a branch of biology that deals with the relations of organisms to one another. 生物生態學是生物學的一個分支，處理生物彼此之間的關係。

The biographee smiled at the final chapter. 傳主看到最後一章時笑了。

meaning: 傳記作家；職業傳記作家。
sentences: The biographer spent years on the book. 傳記作家為那本書花了好幾年。

sentences: Certain enzymes have biolytic properties that break down cell walls. 某些酶具有生物分解特性，可以分解細胞壁。

He is an expert in the biomechanics of human flight. 他是人類飛行生物力學方面的專家。

A precise biometer is essential for this laboratory experiment. 對於這個實驗室實驗，精確的生物測量計是必不可少的。
The watch used a biometric to track his pulse. 這只手錶用生物特徵指標追蹤他的脈搏。
The app showed a biometric for breathing rate. 那個應用程式顯示了一項呼吸率的生物指標。
The biometrical analysis revealed significant differences between the two groups. 生物測量分析揭示了兩組之間存在顯著差異。
He used biometrical techniques to track animal growth. 他使用生物測量技術來追蹤動物生長。

meaning: 生物識別技術；生物統計學
sentences: Biometrics includes technologies that recognize people based on physical traits. 生物識別技術包括根據身體特徵識別人的技術。
The field of biometrics is expanding rapidly in the security industry. 生物識別技術領域在安全產業中正在迅速擴張。

meaning: 生物統計學；生物測量學
sentences: Biometry uses statistics to analyze biological observations. 生物統計學使用統計學來分析生物觀察結果。
The course covers the basic principles of medical biometry. 課程涵蓋了醫學生物統計學的基本原理。
Biomicroscopy is used to examine living tissues under high magnification. 生物顯微鏡檢查用於在高倍率下檢查活體組織。
The ophthalmologist used biomicroscopy to inspect the patient's eyes. 眼科醫生使用生物顯微鏡檢查來檢查病人的眼睛。
Each bion in the sample reacted differently. 樣本中的每個生物單元反應都不同。
The scientist traced one bion under the lens. 科學家在鏡頭下追蹤一個生物個體。
Bionergy refers to the vital energy present in living organisms. 生物能是指存在於生物體中的生命能量。
Some alternative therapies claim to balance the body's bionergy. 一些替代療法聲稱可以平衡身體的生物能。

meaning: 生物經濟學的；生態學的
sentences: The bionomic study focused on the cost of resource acquisition for the species. 這項生物經濟學研究側重於該物種獲取資源的成本。
Bionomic factors influence the survival rates of the population. 生物經濟因素影響族群的生存率。
The scientist published a paper on the bionomical characteristics of bees. 科學家發表了一篇關於蜜蜂生態特性的論文。
Bionomical adaptations allow creatures to survive in extreme environments. 生態適應使生物能在極端環境中生存。

meaning: 生態學上；從生活習性上
sentences: The species are bionomically adapted to high-altitude regions. 這些物種在生態上適應了高海拔地區。
Bionomically speaking, this insect plays a vital role in pollination. 從生態學角度來說，這種昆蟲在授粉中起著至關重要的作用。
Bionomics is the branch of biology that deals with the relations of organisms to their environment. 生態學是生物學中處理生物與環境關係的分支。
The bionomics of agricultural pests is a key area of research. 農作物害蟲的生態學是一個關鍵的研究領域。
The bionomist studied the impact of urban sprawl on local wildlife. 這位生態學家研究了城市擴張對當地野生動物的影響。
She works as a bionomist at the national park. 她在國家公園擔任生態學家。
Bionomy explores the laws governing the life and development of organisms. 生態學探索支配生物生命與發展的規律。
The principles of bionomy are essential for understanding biodiversity. 生態學原理對於理解生物多樣性至關重要。
Biophagism refers to organisms that feed on living matter. 食生物性是指以活體物質為食的生物。
The study discussed biophagism in predatory insects. 該研究討論了捕食性昆蟲的食生物性。
Biophagous organisms consume living tissues of other organisms. 食生物的生物消耗其他生物的活組織。
Many parasites are biophagous in nature. 許多寄生蟲在本質上是食生物的。
Biophagy is common among many species in the food chain. 食生物性在食物鏈中的許多物種中都很常見。
The evolution of biophagy has shaped many ecological interactions. 食生物性的演化塑造了許多生態互動。

meaning: 嗜生物的；寄生於活體的
sentences: Biophilous fungi grow on living plants or animals. 嗜生物真菌生長在活的植物或動物身上。
The researcher identified several biophilous species in the sample. 研究人員在樣本中發現了幾種嗜生物物種。
The biophore was hypothesized to be the smallest unit capable of life. 生原體被假設為能維持生命的最小單位。
Early biologists used the term biophore to describe essential life particles. 早期生物學家使用生原體一詞來描述基本的生命微粒。
The biophotophone was an early experimental device combining light and sound. 生物光學電話是一種結合光與聲的早期實驗裝置。
Historical records mention the development of the biophotophone. 歷史記錄提到了生物光學電話的研發。
Biophysical research helps explain how muscles generate force. 生物物理研究有助於解釋肌肉如何產生力量。
They studied the biophysical properties of cell membranes. 他們研究了細胞膜的生物物理特性。
The biophysicochemical processes in the body are highly complex. 體內的生物物理化學過程非常複雜。
This study examines the biophysicochemical interactions in water purification. 這項研究檢查了水淨化中的生物物理化學相互作用。
Biophysics applies the theories and methods of physics to biological systems. 生物物理學將物理學的理論和方法應用於生物系統。
He chose to major in biophysics to study the mechanics of DNA. 他選擇主修生物物理學以研究 DNA 的力學。
Biophysiography provides a detailed description of the physiological traits of a region's life. 生物生理描述詳細說明了一個地區生物的生理特徵。
The biophysiography of the desert flora is fascinating. 沙漠植物的生物生理描述非常引人入勝。
The biophysiological response to stress can vary between individuals. 對壓力的生物生理反應在個體之間可能有所不同。
Biophysiological research is crucial for understanding sleep disorders. 生物生理研究對於理解睡眠障礙至關重要。
As a biophysiologist, he studies the biological and physiological functions of organisms. 作為一名生物生理學家，他研究生物體的生物和生理功能。
The biophysiologist conducted experiments on heart rate variability. 生物生理學家對心率變異性進行了實驗。
Biophysiology combines biology and physiology to study life processes. 生物生理學結合了生物學和生理學來研究生命過程。
Advances in biophysiology have led to new medical treatments. 生物生理學的進步帶來了新的醫療方法。
Mistletoe is a well-known biophyte that grows on trees. 槲寄生是一種生長在樹上的著名寄生植物。
The forest is home to many different types of biophytes. 這片森林是許多不同類型寄生植物的家園。
Bioplasm is the living matter of organisms. 原生質是生物體的活物質。
The scientist observed the movement of bioplasm under a microscope. 科學家在顯微鏡下觀察原生質的移動。
The bioplasmic structure of the cell is essential for its function. 細胞的原生質結構對其功能至關重要。
Bioplasmic energy is a concept used in some alternative healing practices. 原生質能量是一些替代療愈實踐中使用的概念。
A bioplast is a tiny mass of living protoplasm. 原生質體是一小團活的原生質。
Bioplast materials are being developed as sustainable alternatives to traditional plastics. 生物塑料材料正在開發中，作為傳統塑料的永續替代品。
The coffee cup is made from biodegradable bioplastic. 這個咖啡杯是由可生物分解的生物塑料製成的。
Bioplastic films can be used for food packaging to reduce waste. 生物塑料薄膜可用於食品包裝以減少浪費。
Scientists tracked bioprecipitation in the tank. 科學家追蹤了槽裡的生物沉澱。
The report explained bioprecipitation clearly. 報告把生物沉澱解釋得很清楚。
The biopsic sample was sent to the pathology lab for analysis. 活檢樣本被送到病理實驗室進行分析。
Biopsic procedures are common for diagnosing various types of cancer. 活檢程序在診斷各種類型的癌症中很常見。

meaning: 出於診斷目的從活體中取出組織、細胞或體液樣本並進行檢查。
sentences: The field guide listed biopsy beside related species. 圖鑑把這個分類列在近緣物種旁。
The specimen label helped researchers identify biopsy. 標本標籤幫助研究人員辨認這個分類。
Biopsychic research explores the connection between biological processes and mental states. 生物心理研究探索生物過程與心理狀態之間的聯繫。
Human behavior is influenced by both social and biopsychic factors. 人類行為受到社會和生物心理因素的影響。
The biopsychical development of the child was closely monitored. 該兒童的生物心理發展受到了密切監測。
The theory integrates biological and biopsychical aspects of consciousness. 該理論整合了意識的生物和生物心理方面。
The biopsychological model considers the interplay of genetics and environment on mental health. 生物心理學模型考慮了遺傳與環境對心理健康的交互作用。
She is interested in the biopsychological causes of addiction. 她對成癮的生物心理學原因感興趣。
As a biopsychologist, he studies how the brain influences behavior. 作為一名生物心理學家，他研究大腦如何影響行為。
The biopsychologist presented her findings on neuroplasticity. 這位生物心理學家展示了她關於神經塑性的發現。
Biopsychology is the study of the biological basis of psychological processes. 生物心理學是研究心理過程的生物學基礎的學科。
Students in the biopsychology course learn about brain structure and function. 生物心理學課程的學生學習大腦的結構與功能。

meaning: 生焦輝閃石 (地質學術語)
sentences: Biopyribole is a group of minerals with structures intermediate between micas and amphiboles. 生焦輝閃石是一組結構介於雲母與角閃石之間的礦物。
The geologist identified biopyribole in the metamorphic rock sample. 地質學家在變質岩樣本中鑑定出了生焦輝閃石。
Some simple organisms have a bioral structure. 一些簡單的生物具有雙口結構。
The anatomical study described the bioral configuration of the species. 解剖學研究描述了該物種的雙口構造。
The biorbital distance was measured during the facial reconstruction. 在面部重建過程中測量了兩眼眶間的距離。
Modern aircraft can have complex biorbital paths. 現代飛機可以具有複雜的雙軌道路徑。
The biordinal ranking system was used to evaluate the candidates. 雙序排名系統被用於評估候選人。
Biordinal symmetry can be observed in certain geometric patterns. 在某些幾何圖案中可以觀察到雙序對稱。
Fermentation is a well-known bioreaction used in food production. 發酵是用於食品生產的著名生物反應。
The researchers monitored the bioreaction in the laboratory setting. 研究人員在實驗室環境中監測了該生物反應。
The term biorgan is sometimes used to refer to a functional biological unit. 這個詞有時指功能性的生物單元。
He studied the development of biorgans in simple organisms. 他研究簡單生物中這類生物器官的發育。
Bios underpin the whole ecosystem. 生命支撐著整個生態系統。
The lecture linked bios to metabolism. 講座把生命和代謝連在一起。

meaning: 早期電影放映機；生物顯微鏡 (舊稱)
sentences: The old bioscope flickered in the theater. 那台老式放映機在劇院裡閃爍播放。
A museum displayed a bioscope from 1900. 博物館展示了一台 1900 年代的早期放映機。

meaning: 生物顯微鏡的；早期電影的
sentences: Bioscopic examinations were conducted to study cell structure. 進行了生物顯微鏡檢查以研究細胞結構。
The film history museum displays several bioscopic devices. 電影歷史博物館展示了幾台早期電影放映裝置。
Bioscopy is the examination of the body to determine the presence of life. 活體檢查是對身體進行檢查以確定是否存在生命。
Ancient medical texts describe early forms of bioscopy. 古代醫學文獻描述了早期形式的活體檢查。
A biose is a sugar that contains two carbon atoms per molecule. 乙醣是每分子含有兩個碳原子的糖。
Biose is the simplest type of monosaccharide. 乙醣是最簡單的單醣類型。
The scientist studied the biosis of bacteria in extreme heat. 科學家研究了細菌在極熱環境下的生存狀態。
Biosis refers to a specific condition of living. 這個詞指生命或生存的狀態。
The biosocial factors of development are complex. 發展的生物社會因素非常複雜。
Biosocial criminology studies how biological traits and social environment interact. 生物社會犯罪學研究生物特徵與社會環境如何交互作用。
The researcher presented a biosociological analysis of urban life. 研究人員展示了對城市生活的生物社會學分析。
Biosociological theories attempt to bridge the gap between biology and sociology. 生物社會學理論試圖彌合生物學與社會學之間的鴻溝。
The biosphere includes all living organisms and their environments on Earth. 生物圈包括地球上所有的生物及其環境。
Human activities have a significant impact on the health of the biosphere. 人類活動對生物圈的健康有顯著影響。
Biostatic substances inhibit the growth of bacteria without killing them. 抑菌物質抑制細菌生長而不殺死它們。
The laboratory measured the biostatic effect of the new preservative. 實驗室測量了這種新防腐劑的抑菌效果。

meaning: 生物統計的；生物靜力學的
sentences: The biostatical data was used to analyze population trends. 生物統計數據被用於分析族群趨勢。
He performed a biostatical review of the clinical results. 他對臨床結果進行了生物統計審查。
Biostatics studies the forces and equilibrium in organisms at rest. 生物靜力學研究處於靜止狀態的生物體內的力與平衡。
Principles of biostatics are applied in physical therapy. 生物靜力學原理應用於物理治療中。
Biostatistics is essential for designing and analyzing medical research. 生物統計學對於設計與分析醫學研究至關重要。
She is taking a graduate course in biostatistics. 她正在修讀生物統計學的研究生課程。

meaning: 維生素 A 濃縮物 (舊稱)
sentences: Old labels listed biosterin as a vitamin A concentrate. 舊標籤把它列為維生素甲濃縮物。
Pharmacists once sold biosterin in dark bottles. 藥劑師過去把這種維生素甲濃縮物裝在深色瓶裡出售。
Biosterol is a type of sterol found in living organisms. 生物固醇是存在於生物體中的一類固醇。
The synthesis of biosterol occurs in plant and animal cells. 生物固醇的合成發生在動植物細胞中。
Biostratigraphy uses fossils to date and correlate rock layers. 生物地層學利用化石來確定岩層年代並進行對比。
Advances in biostratigraphy have helped geologists map ancient Earth. 生物地層學的進步幫助地質學家繪製了古代地球的地圖。
Biosynthesis is the production of complex molecules within living organisms. 生物合成是生物體內複雜分子的產生過程。
The biosynthesis of proteins happens in the ribosomes. 蛋白質的生物合成發生在核糖體中。
Biosynthetic insulin is used by millions of people with diabetes. 數百萬糖尿病患者使用生物合成胰島素。
Researchers are studying the biosynthetic pathways of secondary metabolites. 研究人員正在研究次級代謝產物的生物合成途徑。
The biosystematic study classified the plants based on genetic markers. 生物系統學研究根據遺傳標記對植物進行分類。
Biosystematic research provides a clear taxonomy for new species. 生物系統學研究為新物種提供了清晰的分類學。
Biosystematics is the study of the diversity and relationships of organisms. 生物系統學是研究生物多樣性及其相互關係的學科。
Modern biosystematics relies heavily on DNA sequencing. 現代生物系統學嚴重依賴 DNA 定序。
A biosystematist works to categorize and name living things. 生物系統學家致力於對生物進行分類和命名。
The biosystematist discovered a new genus of orchids in the jungle. 這位生物系統學家在叢林中發現了一個新的蘭花屬。
Biosystematy involves the integration of various biological data for classification. 生物系統學涉及整合各種生物數據進行分類。
The textbook covers the principles of plant biosystematy. 教科書涵蓋了植物生物系統學的原理。
The Biota of the region includes both rare plants and animals. 該地區的生物群包括稀有動植物。
Scientists are monitoring changes in the coastal Biota. 科學家正在監測沿海生物群的變化。
Every ecosystem has a unique biota adapted to its environment. 每個生態系統都有適應其環境的獨特生物群。
The study documented the biota of the deep ocean floor. 該研究記錄了深海海底的生物群。
Biotaxy is the science of classifying living organisms. 生物分類學是分類生物體的科學。
Linnaeus is considered the father of modern biotaxy. 林奈被認為是現代生物分類學之父。
Biotechnics is used to develop new medical treatments. 生物技術被用於開發新的醫療方法。
The company specializes in agricultural biotechnics. 該公司專攻農業生物技術。
Biotic factors like competition and predation affect ecosystems. 競爭和捕食等生物因素會影響生態系統。
The survey identified several biotic components in the area. 調查在該地區發現了幾種生物組成部分。
The biotical conditions of the lake have changed over time. 湖泊的生物狀況隨著時間而改變。
He researched the biotical processes in soil development. 他研究了土壤發育中的生物過程。
Biotics is the study of the laws of life and living organisms. 生物學是研究生命與生物體規律的學科。
She has a keen interest in the field of marine biotics. 她對海洋生物學領域有濃厚興趣。
Biotin is a B vitamin that is important for hair and skin health. 生物素是一種對頭髮和皮膚健康很重要的維生素 B。
Many people take biotin supplements to improve their nails. 許多人服用生物素補充劑來改善指甲健康。
Biotite is a common silicate mineral found in many types of rocks. 黑雲母是存在於多種岩石中的常見矽酸鹽礦物。
The shiny black flakes in the granite are biotite. 花崗岩中閃亮的黑色薄片是黑雲母。
The biotitic schist displayed a distinct layered structure. 含黑雲母的片岩顯示出明顯的分層結構。
Geologists analyzed the biotitic content of the igneous rocks. 地質學家分析了火成岩中黑雲母的含量。
A biotome is used to cut very thin slices of biological tissue. 生物切片機用於切割極薄的生物組織片。
The lab technician prepared the samples using a precise biotome. 實驗室技術員使用精密生物切片機準備樣本。
Biotomy is the practice of dissecting living organisms for research. 活體解剖是為了研究而對活體生物進行解剖的行為。
Advances in imaging have reduced the need for biotomy in medicine. 影像技術的進步減少了醫學上對活體解剖的需求。
A biotope provides the specific environmental conditions for a community of organisms. 生物棲息地為一個生物群落提供特定的環境條件。
Conservationists work to protect the fragile biotope of the marshland. 保育人士致力於保護沼澤地脆弱的生物棲息地。
A biotype consists of a group of organisms sharing the same genotype. 生物型由一組共享相同基因型的生物組成。
Researchers identified a new biotype of the pest that is resistant to pesticides. 研究人員發現了一種對殺蟲劑具有抗性的新型害蟲生物型。
Biotypic variation can be observed within a species. 在一個物種內可以觀察到生物型的變異。
The biotypic characteristics were analyzed in the laboratory. 在實驗室分析了生物型特徵。

meaning: 雙卵的；來自兩個卵子的
sentences: Biovular twins, also known as fraternal twins, develop from two separate eggs. 雙卵雙胞胎（也稱為異卵雙胞胎）由兩個獨立的卵子發育而成。
The study focused on the genetic differences in biovular siblings. 該研究側重於雙卵兄弟姐妹的遺傳差異。
The biovulate condition is common in many mammal species. 雙卵狀況在許多哺乳動物物種中很常見。
Research examined the frequency of biovulate pregnancies in the population. 研究檢查了該群體中雙卵懷孕的頻率。
Potassium bioxalate is sometimes used in cleaning products. 倍草酸鉀有時用於清潔產品中。
The chemical properties of bioxalate were tested in the experiment. 實驗中測試了倍草酸鹽的化學性質。
Manganese bioxide is used in the manufacturing of dry cell batteries. 二氧化錳用於製造乾電池。
The reaction produced a small amount of bioxide as a byproduct. 該反應產生了少量的二氧化物作為副產品。
The bipack process was an early method used in color cinematography. 雙層膠片工藝是用於彩色電影製作的早期方法。
This camera design utilizes a bipack film magazine. 這種相機設計利用了雙層膠片盒。

meaning: 具二小稃的 (植物學術語)
sentences: The bipaleolate structure of the grass flower is a key identifying feature. 草花的二小稃結構是一個關鍵的識別特徵。
Botanists examined the bipaleolate scales under a magnifying glass. 植物學家在放大鏡下檢查了二小稃鱗片。
Bipaliidae is a family of land planarians, including the hammerhead worm. 廣頭地渦蟲科是一類陸生渦蟲，包括廣頭地渦蟲。

meaning: 黑心，黑心櫻桃（一種植物病害或品種）
sentences: Blackheart in potatoes can be caused by low oxygen levels. 土豆的黑心症可能是由氧氣含量低引起的。
He bought a basket of delicious blackheart cherries. 他買了一籃好吃的黑心櫻桃。
The villain in the story was a blackhearted man. 故事中的反派是一個黑心腸的人。
She was shocked by his blackhearted betrayal. 她對他狠毒的背叛感到震驚。
The blackheartedness of the criminal shocked the public. 罪犯的心狠手辣震驚了公眾。
It is hard to believe such blackheartedness exists in the world. 很難相信世界上存在這樣的黑心腸。

meaning: 小黑（寵物名），黑人（俚語，具爭議性）
sentences: We named our little black dog Blackie. 我們給我們的小黑狗取名叫「小黑」。
Using the word blackie to describe a person is considered offensive. 用「黑人」這個俚語來描述一個人被認為是具有攻擊性的。
He applied blacking to his boots until they shined. 他給他的靴子抹上黑油，直到它們發亮。
The blacking was hard to wash off his hands. 手上的黑油很難洗掉。
The bruised skin turned a blackish color. 受傷的皮膚變成了略帶黑色的顏色。
The bird had blackish feathers with hints of green. 那隻鳥有著略帶黑色且透著綠色的羽毛。
The metal was blackishly coated with oxidation. 金屬表面略帶黑色地覆蓋著氧化層。
The water flowed blackishly from the polluted source. 水從污染源流出，顯得略帶黑色。
The blackishness of the clouds suggested a coming storm. 雲層的微黑暗示著暴風雨即將到來。
The artist captured the blackishness of the twilight shadows. 藝術家捕捉到了暮色陰影中的微黑。
The fireplace was all blackit with soot. 壁爐被煤煙塗得漆黑。
He had blackit hands after working in the coal cellar. 在煤窖工作後，他的雙手變得黑漆漆的。

meaning: 賭場中常見的賭博紙牌遊戲，目標是盡可能接近 21 而不超過。
sentences: She learned blackjack rules before sitting at the table. 她入座前先學會二十一點的規則。
A good blackjack player knows when to stand or draw another card. 熟練的二十一點玩家知道何時停牌或補牌。
The blackland region is ideal for growing cotton. 黑土地區非常適合種植棉花。
Blackland is known for its rich organic content and fertility. 黑土地以其豐富的有機質和肥沃而聞名。

meaning: 工賊（罷工期間照常工作的人），黑腿病
sentences: The strikers shouted at the blackleg as he entered the factory. 罷工者在工賊進入工廠時對他大聲叫喊。
Blackleg is a fatal disease that affects cattle and sheep. 黑腿病是一種感染牛羊的致命疾病。
The union condemned the blackleggery occurring during the strike. 工會譴責了罷工期間發生的工賊行為。
He was accused of blackleggery by his former colleagues. 他被以前的同事指責有工賊行為。
The labor leaders fought against blacklegism in the industry. 工運領袖們與該行業中的工賊習氣作鬥爭。
Blacklegism can undermine the effectiveness of a strike. 工賊制度會削弱罷工的有效性。

meaning: 工賊（複數），黑腿病（疾病名）
sentences: The management hired blacklegs to keep the business running. 管理層僱用工賊來維持業務運行。
Veterinarians are working to prevent blacklegs in local herds. 獸醫正在努力預防當地畜群感染黑腿病。
He glared blackly at the man who insulted him. 他憤怒地盯著那個侮辱他的人。
The situation was blackly portrayed in the news reports. 新聞報導對局勢進行了陰沉的描繪。

meaning: 透過激起對身體傷害以外的傷害的恐懼，例如名譽受損、精神痛苦、誣告等，向（某人）勒索金錢或好處。
sentences: He blackmailed a businesswoman by threatening to expose an alleged fraud. 他威脅要揭露涉嫌詐欺的行為，以此勒索一名女商人。

To blackmail means to extort money or favors from (a person) by exciting fears of injury other than bodily harm, such as injury to reputation, distress of mind, false accusation, etc. 勒索是指透過激起對身體傷害以外的傷害的恐懼，例如名譽受損、精神痛苦、誣告等，向（某人）勒索金錢或好處。
The blackmailer demanded a large sum of money for the documents. 勒索者要求支付一大筆錢以換取文件。
She eventually reported the blackmailer to the police. 她最終向警方舉報了勒索者。

meaning: 黑嘴（某些鳥類的名稱，或對激進分子的舊稱）
sentences: The bird was identified as a blackneb due to its dark beak. 由於其黑色的喙，這隻鳥被鑑定為黑嘴類。
Historically, the term blackneb was applied to political radicals in Scotland. 從歷史上看，黑嘴一詞曾被用於指代蘇格蘭的政治激進分子。
The blackneck swan is a beautiful bird native to South America. 黑頸天鵝是一種原產於南美洲的美麗鳥類。
We saw a pair of blackneck stilts by the marsh. 我們在沼澤邊看到了一對黑頸長腳鷸。
The blackness of outer space comes from the lack of anything to reflect light rather than the absence of light. 外太空的黑暗不是因為沒有光，而是因為缺乏任何可以反射光的東西。
The discussion made the blackness easier to recognize. 那場討論讓黑色的狀態或品質變得更容易辨認。

meaning: 黑旋鈕，黑頭（俚語或方言）
sentences: Adjust the blacknob on the radio to change the station. 調整收音機上的黑色旋鈕來更換電台。
The term blacknob is used locally to describe certain types of hills. 當地使用「黑頭」一詞來描述某些類型的山丘。

meaning: 審查制度的一個例子，尤其是暫時的審查制度。
sentences: The newspaper blackout hid the scandal. 報紙的暫時審查把那樁醜聞壓了下來。
An interview blackout kept the details out of print. 對那場訪談的審查讓細節沒有刊出。
The blackpoll warbler undertakes a long migration every year. 黑頂林鶯每年都會進行長途遷徙。
We spotted a blackpoll in the pine trees during our walk. 我們在散步時於松樹林中發現了一隻黑頂林鶯。
The garden was ruined by a severe case of blackroot. 花園被嚴重的黑根病毀掉了。
Blackroot can be avoided by ensuring proper soil drainage. 確保良好的土壤排水可以避免黑根病。
Blackseed oil is used in traditional medicine for various ailments. 黑種草油在傳統醫學中用於治療多種疾病。
I sprinkled blackseeds on top of the homemade bread. 我在自製的麵包上面撒了一些黑種子。

meaning: 穿黑衫的（通常與法西斯組織有關）
sentences: The blackshirted supporters marched through the streets. 穿黑衫的支持者們在街道上游行。
The image of blackshirted troops remains a powerful historical symbol. 穿黑衫軍隊的形象仍然是一個強大的歷史象徵。
The blacksmith answered questions after the meeting. 這位一個打鐵的人在會後回答問題。
The story describes a blacksmith trying to solve a difficult problem. 故事描寫一位一個打鐵的人試著解決難題。
He took a course to learn the ancient art of blacksmithing. 他參加了一門課程來學習古老的鍛造藝術。
Blacksmithing requires a lot of physical strength and skill. 鐵匠活需要大量的體力和技巧。
He played the blackstick with incredible speed and soul. 他以驚人的速度和靈魂演奏單簧管。
The jazz musician was famous for his skill on the blackstick. 那位爵士樂手以其演奏單簧管的技巧而聞名。
Blackstrap molasses is a rich source of iron and minerals. 黑糖蜜是鐵和礦物質的豐富來源。
She added a spoonful of blackstrap to the gingerbread batter. 她在薑餅麵糊中加入了一勺黑糖蜜。
The blacktail deer is commonly found in the Pacific Northwest. 黑尾鹿在太平洋西北地區很常見。
Fishermen often hope to catch the elusive blacktail. 漁民們通常希望能捕捉到那種難以捉摸的黑尾魚。
The blackthorn bush is covered in sharp spines. 黑刺李灌木叢覆蓋著鋒利的刺。
Sloe gin is made from the bitter berries of the blackthorn. 斯洛琴酒是用黑刺李的苦味果實製成的。

meaning: 黑舌病（多發於狗的缺乏維生素病）
sentences: Blacktongue in dogs is the equivalent of pellagra in humans. 狗的黑舌病相當於人類的糙皮病。
The vet diagnosed the stray dog with blacktongue. 獸醫診斷那隻流浪狗患有黑舌病。
The silhouette of the blacktree stood out against the sunset. 黑樹的剪影在夕陽的映襯下格外醒目。
They rested in the shade of a large blacktree. 他們在一棵大黑樹的樹蔭下休息。
The scandal was an attempt to blackwash the entire organization. 這起醜聞是企圖抹黑整個組織。
The walls were given a thick coat of blackwash. 牆壁被刷上了一層厚厚的黑漆。
The blackwasher was hired to paint the barn. 粉刷匠被雇來給穀倉刷黑漆。
He was known as a political blackwasher who destroyed careers. 他是一個以摧毀職業生涯聞名的政治抹黑者。

meaning: 黑水，污水（指含有糞便的污水）
sentences: The treatmemt plant processes both greywater and blackwater. 處理廠處理灰水和黑水（污水）。
Blackwater fever is a severe complication of malaria. 黑尿熱是瘧疾的一種嚴重併發症。
Australian blackwood is highly prized for furniture making. 澳洲黑木在家具製造中備受推崇。
The cabinet was crafted from solid blackwood. 這個櫃子是由實心黑木手工製成的。
Blackwork was a popular form of embroidery in Tudor England. 黑線刺繡是都鐸王朝時期英格蘭流行的一種刺繡形式。
She spent months completing an intricate blackwork design. 她花了幾個月的時間完成了一個複雜的黑線刺繡設計。

meaning: 聚合草（一種植物，又稱 comfrey）
sentences: Blackwort has been used in herbal medicine for centuries. 聚合草在草藥醫學中已被使用了幾個世紀。
They planted blackwort in the garden for its healing properties. 他們在花園裡種植聚合草，因為它具有療效。
The cat's fur was a soft, blacky texture. 貓的毛皮有一種柔軟、黑漆漆的質地。
Come here, Blacky! Little kids called their pet. 「過來，小黑！」小孩子對他們的寵物喊道。

meaning: 葉片，吹噓的人（蘇格蘭方言）
sentences: A single blad fell from the autumn tree. 一片葉子從秋天的樹上掉落。
He is a muckle blad, according to the local folks. 據當地人說，他是個愛大肆吹噓的人。
The bladder stores urine before it is expelled from the body. 膀胱在尿液排出體外前將其儲存。
A football consists of an outer leather case and an inner bladder. 足球由外層皮殼和內層氣囊組成。
The organism has a tiny bladderet for buoyancy. 該生物有一個用於浮力的小囊。
Biologists observed the function of the bladderet under the microscope. 生物學家在顯微鏡下觀察了小囊的功能。
Some simple aquatic organisms are bladderless. 一些簡單的水生生物是沒有膀胱的。
The evolutionary study focused on bladderless species. 這項演化研究集中在無膀胱的物種上。
The plant has bladderlike structures to trap insects. 這種植物有囊狀構造來誘捕昆蟲。
The disease caused bladderlike swellings on the skin. 這種疾病導致皮膚上出現囊狀腫脹。
The bladdernose seal is named for the inflatable sac on the male's nose. 冠海豹因雄性鼻子上可膨脹的囊而得名。
Bladdernoses are found in the North Atlantic. 冠海豹發現於北大西洋。

meaning: 省沽油（一種灌木及果實）
sentences: The bladdernut tree produces inflated seed capsules. 省沽油樹結出膨大的種實莢。
We found a bladdernut shrub growing by the stream. 我們在溪邊發現了一株省沽油灌木。
Bladderpod is a common plant in dry, sandy soils. 囊果草是乾燥沙質土壤中常見的植物。
The yellow flowers of the bladderpod are easy to identify. 囊果草的黃色花朵很容易辨認。

meaning: 囊種子植物（如某些風信子屬植物）
sentences: The bladderseed is known for its unique seed dispersal mechanism. 囊種子植物以其獨特的種子傳播機制而聞名。
Botanists studied the development of the bladderseed pods. 植物學家研究了囊種子莢的發育。
Bladderweed is often found washed up on the beach after a storm. 暴風雨過後，海灘上經常可以看到被沖上岸的墨角藻。
The air sacs in bladderweed help it float in the ocean. 墨角藻中的氣囊幫助它在海洋中漂浮。
The bladderwort captures tiny aquatic organisms in its traps. 狸藻在它的捕蟲囊中捕捉微小的水生生物。
Bladderwort species can be found in ponds and slow-moving water. 狸藻物種可以在池塘和流動緩慢的水域中找到。
The rock had a bladdery texture due to trapped gas. 由於困住了氣體，這塊岩石具有多孔囊狀的質地。
The infection caused a bladdery rash on his arm. 感染在他手臂上引起了囊狀皮疹。
Be careful with that sharp knife; it has a very thin and dangerous blade. 小心那把尖刀；它的刀刃非常薄且危險。
A single blade of grass managed to push through the concrete road. 一根草葉竟然穿透了混凝土路面。
The doctor examined the injury near his bladebone. 醫生檢查了他肩胛骨附近的傷勢。
In cooking, the bladebone steak is cut from the shoulder. 在烹飪中，肩胛肉排是從肩膀部位切下的。
The windmill has three large bladed fans. 風車有三個大型的葉片風扇。
He carried a bladed weapon for protection. 他帶著一把有刃的武器以求自衛。
Archaeologists found several stone bladelets at the site. 考古學家在遺址發現了幾件石製小刀刃。
The plant has delicate bladelets that sway in the wind. 這種植物有著在風中搖曳的嬌嫩小葉片。
The leaves of the plant are long and bladelike. 這種植物的葉子長而像刀刃。
The crystal had a sharp, bladelike edge. 這種晶體具有鋒利、像刀刃般的邊緣。
The blader performed a series of impressive tricks in the park. 滾軸溜冰者在公園裡表演了一系列令人印象深刻的技巧。
He is an experienced blader who participates in many competitions. 他是一位經驗豐富、參加過許多比賽的滾軸溜冰者。
The bladesmith spent hours forging the perfect sword. 刀匠花了幾個小時鍛造出一把完美的劍。
We visited the workshop of a famous Japanese bladesmith. 我們參觀了一位著名日本刀匠的工作室。

meaning: 刀刃朝前地，像葉片般地
sentences: He held the tool bladewise to ensure a precise cut. 他將工具刀刃朝前拿著，以確保精確切割。
The leaves are arranged bladewise along the stem. 葉子沿著莖像葉片般排列。

meaning: （溜冰、渦輪等的）葉片，滾軸溜冰
sentences: They went blading at the local park on Sunday. 他們週日去當地公園玩滾軸溜冰。
The turbine blading needed to be inspected for damage. 需要檢查渦輪機葉片是否有損壞。
The rock formations had a bladish appearance. 這些岩層具有似刀刃般的外觀。
The new tool has a bladish attachment for cutting. 這個新工具有一個用於切割的似刀刃附件。
The garden was filled with blady weeds. 花園裡長滿了多葉的雜草。
Blady grass is often difficult to clear from the fields. 多葉的草通常很難從田野中清除。
Bladygrass is a resilient weed found in tropical regions. 白茅是發現於熱帶地區的一種韌性極強的雜草。
The field was overgrown with tall bladygrass. 田野裡長滿了高高的白茅。
Her face was blae with cold. 她的臉凍得發青。
The sky turned a blae color just before the storm. 風暴來臨前，天空變成了青紫色。
We gathered blaeberries on the Scottish hillsides. 我們在蘇格蘭山坡上採摘歐洲越橘。
Blaeberry jam has a unique and tart flavor. 歐洲越橘果醬有一種獨特的酸味。
The blaeness of his lips indicated poor circulation. 他嘴唇發青表明血液循環不良。
We noticed the blaeness of the skin around the wound. 我們注意到傷口周圍皮膚發青。
The blaewort added a splash of blue to the field. 矢車菊為田野增添了一抹藍色。
Blaewort is a traditional name for the cornflower in Scotland. 矢車菊是蘇格蘭對矢車菊的傳統稱呼。
We heard the sudden blaff of a shotgun. 我們突然聽到獵槍砰地一響。
The firecracker went off with a loud blaff. 鞭炮砰地一聲炸開了。

meaning: 大銀幣（舊時荷蘭、德國硬幣）
sentences: The museum displayed a collection of ancient blafferts. 博物館展出了一批古代大銀幣。
In the past, the blaffert was used as a standard currency. 過去，大銀幣曾被用作標準貨幣。
His promises turned out to be nothing but a blaflum. 他的承諾結果不過是一場騙局。
Don't listen to his blaflum about making easy money. 不要聽他關於輕鬆賺錢的廢話。

meaning: 精神或健康狀況不佳；下。
sentences: I decided to go exercise rather than sit around all day feeling blah. 我決定去鍛鍊身體，而不是整天坐著無聊。
Something described as blah is low in spirit or health; down. 被描述為“無聊”的事情表示精神或健康狀況不佳；向下。

meaning: 藍色音調（古德語相關術語，極罕見）
sentences: The linguist studied blahlaut in the old poem. 語言學家研究古詩中的藍色音調。
The blahlaut in the lullaby puzzled her. 那首搖籃曲裡的藍色音調讓她困惑。
The medicine helped to heal the painful blain on his hand. 這種藥有助於癒合他手上的疼痛水泡。
A blain can be caused by infection or severe cold. 水泡可能是由感染或嚴寒引起的。
Blaine is a common first name in North America. 布萊恩在北美是一個常見的名字。
The city of Blaine is located in the state of Washington. 布萊恩市位於華盛頓州。

meaning: 布萊爾（人名，如英國前首相）
sentences: Tony Blair served as the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. 東尼·布萊爾曾擔任英國首相。
Blair is a name of Scottish origin. 布萊爾是一個起源於蘇格蘭的名字。
The trumpet began to blair loudly in the hall. 喇叭開始在大廳裡大聲吼叫（齊鳴）。
He had to blair his message over the noise of the crowd. 他不得不對著人群的嘈雜聲吼出他的訊息。

meaning: 布萊爾莫岩（一種罕見的火山岩）
sentences: Blairmorite is characterized by its high analcime content. 布萊爾莫岩的特徵是含有高比例的方沸石。
Geologists found samples of blairmorite in Alberta, Canada. 地質學家在加拿大亞伯達省發現了布萊爾莫岩樣本。
Something described as blake is yellow, as butter or cheese. 被描述為“布萊克”的東西是黃色的，如黃油或起司。
The word blake is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 布萊克這個詞常用來形容人、事或情況。

meaning: 布萊克（人名，如詩人威廉·布萊克）
sentences: William Blake was a famous English poet and artist. 威廉·布萊克是一位著名的英國詩人和藝術家。
Blake's poetry often explores themes of innocence and experience. 布萊克的詩歌經常探討天真與經驗的主題。

meaning: 採黑莓（中古英語，意指虛度光陰）
sentences: They stayed blakeberyed by the hedges instead of working. 他們沿著樹籬採黑莓，結果沒去幹活。
The boys came home blakeberyed and late. 男孩們採黑莓回來，結果回家得很晚。
The company was held blamable for the environmental disaster. 該公司被認為應對這場環境災難負責。
He is not blamable for the mistake as he was not informed. 他對這個錯誤不負責任（不應受責備），因為他沒有得到通知。

He looked blinkingly at the sudden bright light. 他眨著眼看著突然出現的亮光。
The screen flashed blinkingly in the dark room. 螢幕在黑暗的房間裡閃爍著。

The dancer emphasized the bodiliness of the performance. 舞者強調了表演的身體性。

He checked if the check was bounceable. 他檢查支票是否會退票（雙關）。
The ball hit the ground bounceably. 球彈跳著擊中地面。
The child skipped bounceably down the street. 孩子有節奏地在街上跳躍。

meaning: 彈跳的人；一個大而重的人，移動時發出很大的噪音。
sentences: The bouncer answered questions after the meeting. 這位彈跳的人在會後回答問題。
The story describes a bouncer trying to solve a difficult problem. 故事描寫一位彈跳的人試著解決難題。
She gave birth to a bouncing baby boy. 她生下了一個活潑健康的男嬰。
He is a bouncing person full of energy. 他是一個充滿活力、活潑的人。
She walked bouncingly into the room. 她活潑地走進房間。
The children played bouncingly in the park. 孩子們在公園裡活潑地玩耍。
You are bound to succeed if you continue to work hard and stay focused. 如果你繼續努力並保持專注，你注定（必定）會成功。
He felt bound by his promise to help his friend in need. 他感到受自己諾言的約束，要去幫助處於困境的朋友。
The mathematical set is boundable. 這個數學集合是可界定的。
His ambition was not easily boundable. 他的雄心壯志不易受限。
The river forms a natural boundary between the two neighboring countries. 這條河形成了這兩個鄰國之間的自然邊界。
It is important to respect the boundaries of other people's personal space. 尊重他人個人空間的界限（範圍）非常重要。

meaning: 可以將其封閉在有限半徑的球內。
sentences: A compact set must be bounded. 緊集必須是有界的。
The report describes the result as bounded. 該報告將結果描述為有限的。
The variable behaves boundedly. 該變量表現得有限度。
He acted boundedly within the rules. 他在規則範圍內有限地行動。
Researchers explored the boundedness of human knowledge. 研究人員探索了人類知識的侷限性。
The boundedness of resources is a major concern. 資源的有限性是一個主要考量。
It is my bounden duty to help. 幫助是我的責無旁貸的義務。
She felt a bounden responsibility to her family. 她感到對家庭負有不可推卸的責任。
He was known as a bit of a bounder. 他被認為是一個有點無賴的人。
No one trusted that bounder with their money. 沒人信任那個無賴，不敢把錢交給他。
The bounding deer vanished into the woods. 彈跳的鹿消失在樹林中。
The puppy was bounding with joy. 小狗開心地跳來跳去。
The dog ran boundingly across the field. 狗跳躍著跑過田野。
He moved boundingly up the stairs. 他跳著上了樓梯。
Her enthusiasm for the project was boundless. 她對這個項目的熱情是無限的。
They looked out over the boundless ocean. 他們眺望無限廣闊的海洋。
He felt boundlessly happy on his wedding day. 在婚禮那天他感到無限幸福。
The universe is boundlessly vast. 宇宙是無窮無盡地廣闊。
The boundlessness of his imagination amazed everyone. 他想像力的無窮無盡讓每個人都感到驚訝。
She contemplated the boundlessness of time. 她沉思時間的永恆無盡。
Success is boundly to follow hard work. 成功必定會伴隨努力而來。
Boundly is an unusual term meaning certainly. 這是一個表示「必定地」的罕見用詞。
The boundness of the structure was verified. 結構的受限性得到了驗證。
They discussed the boundness of the artistic expression. 他們討論了藝術表達的受限性。
Nature provides a bounteous harvest. 大自然提供了慷慨的收成。
The bounteous king gave gifts to all his subjects. 慷慨的國王向所有臣民贈送禮物。
The sun shone bounteously on the valley. 陽光慷慨地照耀在山谷中。
She distributed the food bounteously to the poor. 她慷慨地向窮人分發食物。
We thanked him for his bounteousness. 我們感謝他的慷慨。
The bounteousness of the land was legendary. 這片土地的豐饒是傳奇性的。
The bountied hunter tracked his prey. 領取賞金的獵人追蹤獵物。
A bountied professional was hired for the task. 僱用了一名有獎金激勵的專業人士來完成這項任務。

meaning: 擁有慷慨或充足的數量或金額；充足。
sentences: They enjoyed a wet summer and a bountiful harvest. 他們度過了一個潮濕的夏天和豐收的一年。
The report describes the result as bountiful. 報告稱成果豐碩。
The rain fell bountifully on the parched earth. 雨水慷慨地落在乾涸的土地上。
They were bountifully rewarded for their efforts. 他們的努力得到了豐厚的回報。
The bountifulness of nature is a true blessing. 大自然的豐饒是真正的祝福。
He expressed gratitude for the bountifulness of the meal. 他對這餐飯的豐盛表示感謝。
The servant received a bountith at the end of the year. 僕人在年底收到了一筆津貼。
Bountith is an old Scottish term for a bounty. 這是蘇格蘭語裡對津貼或獎金的舊稱。
The bountree was covered in white blossoms. 接骨木上開滿了白花。
Bountree is a dialect name for the elder tree. 這是接骨木的方言名稱。

meaning: 慷慨；也是一種慷慨的行為。
sentences: The field guide listed bounty beside related species. 圖鑑把慷慨列在近緣物種旁。
The specimen label helped researchers identify bounty. 標本標籤幫助研究人員辨認慷慨。
The bountyless landscape offered little food. 貧瘠的土地幾乎不提供食物。
He lived a bountyless and miserly life. 他過著不慷慨且吝嗇的生活。
She tied a bouquet of herbs for the table. 她綁了一束裝飾用的香草放在桌上。
The bride carried a bouquet of white lilies. 新娘手裡拿著一束白百合。
A sudden bourasque hit the coastal town. 一場突如其來的暴風雪襲擊了沿海小鎮。
The bourasque caused whiteout conditions on the road. 暴風雪導致道路上出現白矇天。

meaning: 一種在美國用穀物混合物蒸餾而成的威士忌，其中至少 51% 是玉米，在燒焦的新橡木桶中陳釀。
sentences: The field guide listed bourbon beside related species. 圖鑑把這個分類列在近緣物種旁。
The specimen label helped researchers identify bourbon. 標本標籤幫助研究人員辨認這個分類。
Louis XIV was a member of the House of Bourbon. 路易十四是波旁王朝的一員。
The Bourbon dynasty ruled France for centuries. 波旁王朝統治了法國數世紀。
The historian studied Bourbonian politics. 歷史學家研究了波旁王朝的政治。
The palace displayed Bourbonian elegance. 宮殿展現了波旁王朝式的優雅。
Bourbonism refers to the principles of the Bourbon supporters. 波旁派學說是指波旁王朝支持者的原則。
His ideas were rooted in old Bourbonism. 他的思想根植於舊有的波旁派學說。
A Bourbonist sought to restore the monarchy. 波旁分子試圖恢復君主制。
The group of Bourbonists met in secret. 這群波旁分子秘密會面。
They attempted to bourbonize the local administration. 他們試圖使地方行政機構波旁化。
To bourbonize meant to align with Bourbon interests. 波旁化意味著與波旁王朝的利益保持一致。
The remark was meant as a harmless bourd. 這番話原本只是個無傷大雅的玩笑。
Bourd is an archaic term for a jest. 這個古語就是玩笑的意思。
The bourder entertained the guests with stories. 玩笑者用故事逗樂了賓客。
He was known as a clever bourder in the village. 他在村里被認為是一個聰明的愛開玩笑的人。
The organist used the bourdon stop for deep notes. 風琴師使用低音管音栓發出深沉的音符。
The bourdon provided a steady drone in the music. 低音管在音樂中提供了穩定的持續音。
She wore a jacket made of bourette silk. 她穿著一件粗絲綢製成的夾克。
Bourette has a textured and slightly rough surface. 粗絲綢具有紋理且表面略顯粗糙。
The old bourg was surrounded by walls. 這個古老的市鎮被城牆包圍著。
A bourg typically developed around a castle. 市鎮通常圍繞著城堡發展。
They lived a typical bourgeois lifestyle. 他們過著典型的中產階級生活。
He criticized the values of the bourgeois. 他批評中產階級的價值觀。

meaning: 屬於第三階層較富裕成員的一類公民。
sentences: The bourgeoisie gained influence as trade and cities expanded. 隨著貿易與城市擴張，資產階級的影響力逐漸上升。
The historian contrasted the bourgeoisie with the nobility and workers. 歷史學者把資產階級與貴族和工人作對比。
The decor was described as bourgeoisitic by the critic. 評論家形容裝修風格具有資產階級特性。
He rejected the bourgeoisitic lifestyle of his parents. 他拒絕了他父母那種資產階級式的生活方式。
The Bourignian followed the mystical teachings of Antoinette Bourignon. 這位布里尼翁派信徒追隨安托瓦內特·布里尼翁的神祕教義。
Historical records mention a small group of Bourignians in the village. 歷史記錄提到了村子裡的一小群布里尼翁派信徒。
Bourignianism emphasizes direct spiritual communication with God. 布里尼翁教義強調與上帝直接的精神交流。
She spent years studying the tenets of Bourignianism. 她花了多年時間研究布里尼翁教義的信條。
He identified himself as a Bourignianist during the debate. 他在辯論中稱自己為布里尼翁主義者。
The Bourignianist community faced persecution in the 17th century. 布里尼翁主義者社群在17世紀面臨迫害。
Bourignonism spread across parts of Europe in the late 1600s. 布里尼翁派學說在1600年代末期傳遍了歐洲部分地區。
His writings were influenced by Bourignonism. 他的作品受到了布里尼翁派學說的影響。
The Bourignonist held a private meeting in the cellar. 這位布里尼翁教派成員在地下室舉行了一次秘密會議。
As a Bourignonist, he sought inner peace through quietism. 作為一名布里尼翁教派成員，他透過靜止主義尋求內心平靜。
A clear bourn flowed through the meadow. 一條清澈的小河淌過草地。
The cottage was built near a narrow bourn. 小屋建在一條窄窄的溪流附近。
The stars shone in the bournless expanse of space. 星星在無邊無際的太空中閃爍。
He had a bournless curiosity about the natural world. 他對自然界有著無限的好奇心。
Bournonite is a metallic mineral that often forms wheel-like crystals. 車輪礦是一種經常形成輪狀晶體的金屬礦物。
The geologist found a sample of bournonite in the mine. 地質學家在礦井中發現了一個車輪礦樣本。
They sat on a bourock to watch the sunset. 他們坐在一個小山丘上觀看日落。
The children built a bourock using loose stones from the field. 孩子們用田野裡的鬆散石頭築起了一個石堆。

meaning: 布魯特人 (柯爾克孜族舊稱)
sentences: Historical texts refer to certain nomadic tribes as Bourout. 歷史文獻將某些遊牧部落稱為布魯特人。
The Bourout people were known for their skilled horsemanship. 布魯特人以精湛的騎術聞名。
Stock prices fell sharply on the Paris Bourse today. 今天的巴黎證券交易所股價大幅下跌。
He works as a trader on the national bourse. 他在國家證券交易所擔任交易員。
The berries of the bourtree are often used to make wine. 接骨木樹的漿果常用於釀酒。
A large bourtree grew at the corner of the garden. 花園角落裡長著一棵巨大的接骨木樹。
The sailors would bouse all night after returning from the sea. 水手們從海上歸來後會整夜狂飲。
They gathered at the tavern to bouse and sing. 他們聚集在小酒館裡痛飲唱歌。
He was known as a heavy bouser in his youth. 他年輕時是以嗜酒如命的酒鬼聞名。
The old bouser stumbled out of the pub. 那個老酒鬼踉踉蹌蹌地走出了酒吧。
Boussingaultia is a genus of climbing plants native to South America. 落葵薯屬是原產於南美洲的一類攀援植物。
The gardener planted Boussingaultia to cover the fence. 園丁種植了落葵薯屬植物來覆蓋籬笆。
Boussingaultite is a rare mineral formed in volcanic environments. 硫酸鎂銨石是一種在火山環境中形成的罕見礦物。
The mineral collection includes a rare specimen of boussingaultite. 礦物收藏中包括一個罕見的硫酸鎂銨石標本。
Ancient Greek inscriptions were sometimes written in boustrophedon. 古希臘銘文有時是用牛耕式轉行書寫法書寫的。
In boustrophedon, lines alternate from right-to-left and left-to-right. 在牛耕式書寫法中，行文交替從右向左和從左向右。
The boustrophedonic text was difficult for the students to read. 學生們很難閱讀這段牛耕式書寫的文本。
Archaeologists discovered several boustrophedonic inscriptions. 考古學家發現了幾處牛耕式書寫的銘文。
He gave a bousy grin after finishing his third glass. 喝完第三杯後，他露出了醉醺醺的笑容。
The party-goers were loud and bousy by midnight. 參加派對的人到了午夜時分吵鬧且醉態畢露。

meaning: 某事的一段時期，尤其是痛苦或不愉快的時期，例如疾病。
sentences: He had a nasty bout of flu. 他得了一陣很重的流感。
A bout of pain kept her awake. 那陣疼痛讓她睡不著。
His decision to quit his job was just a sudden boutade. 他辭職的決定只是突發奇想。
She is known for her occasional creative boutades. 她以偶爾出現的創意奇想而聞名。
Bouteloua is a genus of grasses common in North American prairies. 旗草屬是北美大草原上常見的一類草本植物。
The cattle grazed on the Bouteloua grass. 牛群在旗草屬的草地上吃草。
The bouto is also known as the pink river dolphin. 亞馬遜河豚也被稱為粉紅河豚。
We saw a bouto swimming in the Amazon River. 我們看到一隻亞馬遜河豚在亞馬遜河中游泳。
The groom wore a white rose as a boutonniere. 新郎戴了一朵白玫瑰作為襟花。
He carefully pinned the boutonniere to his lapel. 他小心地將襟花別在翻領上。
The boutylka rattled in the basket. 那個瓶子在籃子裡叮噹作響。
She filled a boutylka with milk. 她把瓶子裝滿牛奶。
Bouvardia flowers are popular for their sweet fragrance. 寒丁子屬的花朵因其芬芳而受到喜愛。
The florist arranged a bouquet of red Bouvardia. 花店老闆包了一束紅色的寒丁子。
The survey marked each bouw of rice field. 測量圖標出了每一個地積單位的稻田。
He leased two bouw near the canal. 他在運河附近租了兩個地積單位的土地。

meaning: 包法利主義 (脫離現實的幻想)
sentences: Bovarism describes a state of dissatisfaction with one's reality. 包法利主義描述了一種對現實不滿的狀態。
The novel explores the theme of bovarism in its main character. 這部小說探討了主角主角身上的包法利主義主題。
Bovarysm is named after the character Emma Bovary. 包法利主義是以愛瑪·包法利這個角色命名的。
Psychologists discuss bovarysm as a form of romantic escapism. 心理學家將包法利主義視為一種浪漫主義逃避現實的形式。
A bovate was the amount of land an ox could plow in a season. 一牛耕地是一頭牛在一個季節內能耕種的土地面積。
The farmer inherited a bovate of land from his father. 農民從父親那裡繼承了一牛耕地。

meaning: 高地 (南非或荷蘭語區用法)
sentences: The cattle were moved to the bovenland during the wet season. 雨季期間，牛群被移往高地。
He owns a small farm in the bovenland. 他在省內高地擁有一座小農場。
Bovicide was a serious offense in certain ancient cultures. 在某些古代文化中，殺牛是一項重罪。
The act of bovicide was strictly regulated by the authorities. 殺牛行為受到當局的嚴格管制。
Boviculture is a significant part of the regional economy. 養牛業是該地區經濟的重要組成部分。
Advances in boviculture have improved beef quality. 養牛業的進步提高了牛肉品質。
The African buffalo is a large and powerful bovid. 非洲水牛是一種體型巨大且強壯的牛科動物。
Antelopes, cows, and goats are all types of bovids. 羚羊、奶牛和山羊都屬於牛科動物。
Bovidae is a diverse family of cloven-hoofed mammals. 牛科是偶蹄類哺乳動物中多樣性很高的一個科。
Scientists study the evolutionary history of the Bovidae. 科學家研究牛科的演化史。
The ancient statue had a strange, boviform head. 那座古代雕像有一個奇怪的牛形頭部。
Archaeologists found several boviform clay figures. 考古學家發現了幾個牛形的陶俑。

meaning: 牛的、關於牛的或特徵的。
sentences: Something described as bovine is of, relating to, or characteristic of cattle. 被描述为牛的东西属于牛、与牛有关或具有牛的特征。
The word bovine is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 牛這個詞常用來形容人、事物或情況。
He chewed his food bovinely, showing no interest in the conversation. 他像牛一樣遲鈍地咀嚼食物，對談話毫無興趣。
The crowd moved bovinely toward the exit. 人群遲鈍地向出口移動。
The character's bovinity made him a target for jokes. 這個角色的遲鈍使他成為笑話的目標。
There was a sense of calm bovinity in the pastoral landscape. 田園風光中散發著一種寧靜的牛性氣息。
Bovista is a genus of puffball mushrooms. 灰包屬是馬勃菌的一屬。
The walker spotted a Bovista fungus in the field. 步行者在田野裡發現了一個灰包屬真菌。
The room felt bovoid after the rain. 雨後房間裡的感覺很類牛的。
Her answer was short and bovoid. 她的回答簡短而類牛的。
Bovovaccination programs helped eliminate certain diseases in cattle. 牛種疫苗接種計畫有助於消除牛群中的某些疾病。
The veterinarian recommended bovovaccination for the whole herd. 獸醫建議對整個牛群進行牛種疫苗接種。
The newly developed bovovaccine proved highly effective. 新開發的牛種疫苗證明非常有效。
Vials of bovovaccine were transported to the farm. 幾瓶牛種疫苗被運往農場。
He made a deep bow to show his respect. 他深深鞠了一躬以示尊敬。
She tied a beautiful silk bow on the gift box. 她在禮物盒上繫了一個漂亮的絲綢蝴蝶結。
The young thin branch was easily bowable. 這根幼細的樹枝很容易彎曲。
He was not a bowable man and refused to give in. 他不是一個易於順從的人，並拒絕屈服。
The old man had a bowback appearance from years of labor. 那位老人因多年的勞動而呈現駝背的樣子。
She sat in a bowback chair in the library. 她坐在圖書館的一把弓背椅上。

meaning: 鮑鈴 (倫敦鮑教堂的鐘聲)
sentences: Legend says a Cockney must be born within the sound of Bow Bells. 傳說倫敦本地人（Cockney）必須出生在鮑鈴聲能聽到的範圍內。
The ringing of the Bow Bells could be heard across the city. 鮑鈴的鳴響在整座城市都能聽到。
The trees were bowbent under the weight of the heavy snow. 樹木在厚雪的重壓下彎曲如弓。
The path followed a bowbent curve around the lake. 小路繞著湖泊呈弓形彎曲。
Poets often refer to Cupid as the blind bowboy. 詩人常稱丘比特為盲目的弓箭男孩。
Beware the arrows of the mischievous bowboy. 小心淘氣的小丘比特之箭。
Bowdichia is a genus of trees valued for their hard wood. 鮑迪豆屬是一類因其堅硬木材而被看重的樹木。
The wood from Bowdichia is used in construction in some regions. 在某些地區，鮑迪豆屬的木材被用於建築。
Bowdlerism can sometimes lead to the loss of a work's original meaning. 刪改主義有時會導致作品原意的喪失。
Critics often argue against the excessive bowdlerism of classic texts. 評論家經常反對對經典文本進行過度的刪改。
The bowdlerization of Shakespeare's plays was common in the 19th century. 19世紀，對莎士比亞戲劇的刪改是很普遍的。
Modern readers often prefer the original text to any bowdlerization. 現代讀者通常更喜歡原著，而非任何刪改本。

meaning: 刪改 (書中認為不妥的部分)
