Boyd County is located in the northern part of the state. 鮑伊德縣位於該州北部。
He spent his entire boydom exploring the nearby woods. 他整個男孩時期都在探索附近的森林。
The rules of boydom are often mysterious to adults. 男孩世界的規則對成年人來說往往是神祕的。

meaning: 布依爾船（一種荷蘭式小帆船）
sentences: The old boyer sailed gracefully across the shallow bay. 那艘古老的布依爾船優雅地駛過淺水灣。
He studied the design of the traditional boyer for his history project. 他為了歷史作業研究了傳統布依爾船的設計。
She introduced her new boyfriend to her parents. 她把新男朋友介紹給了父母。
They have been going out as boyfriend and girlfriend for two years. 他們作為男女朋友已經交往兩年了。

meaning: 作為男孩的狀態或條件。
sentences: In boyhood, he fished by the river. 在男孩時期，他常到河邊釣魚。
His boyhood shaped the way he spoke. 他的男孩時期塑造了他的說話方式。
He still has a very boyish face even in his thirties. 即使在他三十多歲時，他仍有一張非常有孩子氣的面孔。
She gave a boyish grin when she won the game. 她贏了比賽時露出男孩般的笑容。
He laughed boyishly at the joke. 他聽了那個笑話後孩子氣地笑了起來。
The actor waved boyishly to his fans. 那位演員像男孩般地向粉絲們揮手。
His boyishness is part of his charm. 他的孩子氣是他魅力的一部分。
The boyishness in his voice disappeared as he grew older. 隨著年齡增長，他聲音中的孩子氣消失了。
The teacher had to deal with the various boyisms of her students. 老師不得不應付學生們的各種男孩行為。
His constant boyism sometimes annoyed his older sister. 他不斷的孩子氣行為有時會激怒他的姐姐。
The tribe consulted the boyla before the ceremony. 部落在儀式前諮詢了巫師。
The boyla was respected for his spiritual knowledge. 巫師因其精神知識而受到尊敬。
The fabric looked boylike in the sun. 布料在陽光下看起來很如男孩般的。
The joke sounded boylike to me. 那個笑話聽起來很如男孩般的。

meaning: 男孩學（研究男孩的心理與行為）
sentences: The psychologist specialized in boyology to help troubled youths. 這位心理學家專門研究男孩學，以幫助有困擾的年輕人。
A deep understanding of boyology is helpful for middle school teachers. 對男孩學的深入理解對國中老師很有幫助。
She made a delicious pie using fresh boysenberries. 她用新鮮的博森莓做了一個美味的派。
The boysenberry is a cross between several types of berries. 博森莓是幾種莓果的雜交品種。
He left his boyship behind and became a man. 他告別了男孩身份，成為了一名男子漢。
The responsibilities of adulthood replace the freedom of boyship. 成年的責任取代了男孩時期的自由。

meaning: 波扎（一種發酵穀物飲料）
sentences: Boza is a popular traditional drink in the Balkans. 波扎在巴爾幹地區是一種受歡迎的傳統飲料。
They served chilled boza during the hot summer afternoon. 他們在炎熱的夏日午後供應冰鎮波扎。
Linguists study bozal to understand the history of language contact. 語言學家研究波扎爾語以了解語言接觸的歷史。
Bozal was spoken by enslaved Africans in colonial Latin America. 在殖民時期的拉丁美洲，被奴役的非洲人使用波扎爾語。
Don't be such a bozo and pay attention to what you're doing. 別像個笨蛋一樣，注意你在做什麼。
Some bozo parked his car right in front of the driveway. 某個笨蛋把車停在車道門口。

meaning: 樣張（義大利語 bozza 的複數，用於印刷）
sentences: The editor reviewed the bozze for any last-minute errors. 編輯檢查了樣張是否有任何最後一刻的錯誤。
The printing press produced the initial bozze for approval. 印刷機製作了最初的樣張供批准。
She bought a bra that fit better. 她買了一件更合身的胸罩。
The bra strap slipped off her shoulder. 胸罩肩帶滑下了肩膀。
The local artisans used brab to weave beautiful baskets. 當地工匠使用棕櫚葉編織美麗的籃子。
The tree is known for the quality of its brab fiber. 這種樹因其棕櫚葉纖維的品質而聞名。
The brabagious neighbor was always complaining about something. 那個好吵架的鄰居總是抱怨個不停。
He was in a brabagious mood after the long day at work. 工作了一整天後，他的情緒非常暴躁。

meaning: 布拉班特（歐洲歷史地區）
sentences: The Duchy of Brabant was an important historical territory. 布拉班特公國是歷史上一個重要的領地。
Many famous artists came from the region of Brabant. 許多著名的藝術家來自布拉班特地區。
The Brabanter was proud of his local heritage. 那位布拉班特人為其當地的傳承感到自豪。
He met a Brabanter while traveling through Belgium. 他在比利時旅遊時遇到了一位布拉班特人。
The cathedral features classic Brabantine Gothic architecture. 這座主教座堂展現了經典的布拉班特哥德式建築。
Brabantine lace was highly sought after in the 18th century. 布拉班特蕾絲在18世紀非常受歡迎。
The children started to brabble over who would get the first piece of cake. 孩子們開始為了誰能拿到第一塊蛋糕而爭吵。
It's pointless to brabble about such minor issues. 為了解決這些小問題而爭吵是毫無意義的。
The brabblement in the market made it hard to hear anything. 市場裡的嘈雜爭吵聲讓人很難聽到任何聲音。
He wanted to avoid the constant brabblement of the political debate. 他想避開政治辯論中不斷的紛擾。
The town brabbler was known for starting arguments at the pub. 鎮上的那個愛爭吵的人因在酒館挑起爭論而聞名。
Nobody wanted to sit near the brabbler during the meeting. 會議期間沒人想坐在那個愛爭吵的人旁邊。
They spoke brabblingly, each trying to drown out the other. 他們爭吵地說著話，每個人都試圖壓過對方的聲音。
The crowd responded brabblingly to the unpopular decision. 群眾對這項不受歡迎的決定做出了喧鬧的回應。
Brabejum is a genus of trees native to South Africa. 山龍眼屬是原產於南非的一類樹木。
The Brabejum stellatifolium is known as the wild almond. 星葉山龍眼被稱為野杏仁。

meaning: 褲子（拉丁語，古羅馬時期）
sentences: The legionary tucked his dagger into his braca. 軍團士兵把匕首插進古羅馬長褲裡。
Paintings of Gauls often show braca. 描繪高盧人的畫常畫出古羅馬長褲。
The braccate owl looked fluffy around its feet. 那隻足部有羽毛的貓頭鷹看起來腳邊很蓬鬆。
Bird books sometimes call that species braccate. 鳥類書有時會把那個物種稱為足部有羽毛的。

meaning: 布拉恰（義大利長度單位，複數）
sentences: The cloth was measured in braccia before being sold. 布料在出售前以布拉恰為單位進行測量。
The dimensions of the room were recorded as twenty braccia long. 房間的尺寸被記錄為20布拉恰長。

meaning: 護臂；一種義大利球類遊戲
sentences: The player wore a wooden bracciale to strike the heavy ball. 球員戴著木製護臂來擊打重球。
Bracciale was a popular sport in Renaissance Italy. 護臂球賽是文藝復興時期義大利流行的運動。
Braccianite is a type of volcanic rock found in Italy. 布拉恰諾石是發現於義大利的一種火山岩。
The geologist collected samples of braccianite for analysis. 地質學家收集了布拉恰諾石的樣本進行分析。

meaning: 布拉恰（義大利長度單位，單數）
sentences: A braccio varies in length depending on the city and period. 布拉恰的長度因城市和時期而異。
The statue stood exactly one braccio tall. 這尊雕像恰好一布拉恰高。
We must brace ourselves for the upcoming economic challenges and changes. 我們必須為即將到來的經濟挑戰和變化做好準備（撐緊/加強）。
The metal rods were used to brace the structure of the old building. 金屬桿被用來支撐舊建築的結構。

meaning: 有牙套或類似的支撐物。
sentences: The report describes the result as braced. 報告稱這一結果是樂觀的。
Everyone noticed the braced tone of the message. 每個人都注意到了這則訊息的緊張語氣。
She wore a beautiful gold bracelet that her husband gave to her. 她戴了一隻丈夫送給她的漂亮金手鐲。
The little girl was proudly showing us her new colorful bracelet. 小女孩正自豪地向我們展示她那繽紛的新手鍊。
The dancer's braceleted arms shimmered in the light. 舞者戴著手鐲的手臂在燈光下閃閃發光。
She reached out with a braceleted hand to take the cup. 她伸出戴著手鐲的手去拿杯子。
The archer wore a leather bracer to protect his arm. 弓箭手戴著皮製護腕來保護他的手臂。
A stiff drink was just the bracer he needed after the accident. 事故發生後，一杯烈酒正是他需要的強身劑。
Many braceros came to the US to work in agriculture during the 1940s. 20世紀40年代，許多墨西哥雇農來到美國從事農業工作。
The bracero program provided temporary labor for American farms. 墨西哥雇農計畫為美國農場提供了臨時勞動力。

meaning: 戴在牙齒上以矯正牙齒的裝置。
sentences: She wore braces for two years. 她戴了兩年的牙套。
The dentist tightened the braces today. 牙醫今天把牙套調緊了。
The hunter trained the young brach to follow the scent. 獵人訓練那隻年輕的母獵犬追蹤氣味。
Shakespeare mentions a brach in one of his famous plays. 莎士比亞在他的一部著名劇作中提到了一隻母獵犬。
Brachelytra is a large group of beetles with short wing covers. 隱翅蟲類是一大群具有短鞘翅的甲蟲。
The biologist identified the insect as a member of Brachelytra. 生物學家將這種昆蟲鑑定為隱翅蟲類的一員。
Many species in this family are brachelytrous. 這個科的許多物種都是短鞘翅的。
The brachelytrous nature of the beetle allows it to move easily through soil. 這種甲蟲的短鞘翅特質使其能輕易地在土壤中移動。
The bracherer rode out with six hounds. 那名獵犬狩獵者帶著六條獵犬出發。
Old records describe him as a bracherer. 舊記錄把他寫成一位獵犬狩獵者。
The nobleman spent his weekends brachering in the countryside. 那位貴族週末都在鄉間用獵犬狩獵。
Brachering was a traditional sport for the local gentry. 用獵犬狩獵是當地紳士的一項傳統運動。
The knight was followed by his faithful brachet. 騎士身後跟著他忠實的小獵犬。
The brachet barked loudly when it found the trail. 小獵犬發現蹤跡時大聲吠叫。
The brachial artery provides blood to the arm. 肱動脈為手臂提供血液。
He suffered a brachial injury during the football match. 他在足球比賽中手臂受傷。
The patient complained of chronic brachialgia in his right arm. 患者抱怨他的右臂患有慢性臂部神經痛。
Physical therapy can help alleviate the symptoms of brachialgia. 物理治療可以幫助減輕臂部神經痛的症狀。
The brachialis muscle is located in the upper arm. 肱肌位於上臂。
Strengthening the brachialis helps with elbow flexion. 加強肱肌有助於肘部屈曲。
A Brachiata swung above the river. 一隻長臂猿在河上方盪過。
The Brachiata moved through the canopy in one pull. 長臂猿屬的動物一下就穿過樹冠。

meaning: 有對生枝的；（猿類）臂行的
sentences: The plant has a brachiate stem structure. 這種植物具有對生枝的莖部結構。
Gibbons are known for their ability to brachiate through trees. 長臂猿以其在樹林間臂行的能力而聞名。

meaning: 臂行（猿類用手懸掛移動）
sentences: Brachiation is an efficient way for some primates to travel through the canopy. 對於某些靈長類動物來說，臂行是在林冠中旅行的一種有效方式。
The zoo exhibit allowed visitors to see brachiation in action. 動物園的展覽讓遊客可以看到臂行的實際過程。
The gibbon is the most specialized brachiator among primates. 長臂猿是靈長類動物中最專業的臂行動物。
As a brachiator, the animal has long arms and powerful shoulders. 作為一種臂行動物，這種動物擁有長臂和強大的肩膀。
The marine organism has a brachiferous structure for feeding. 這種海洋生物具有用於進食的臂狀結構。
The specimen was described as brachiferous in the scientific report. 在科學報告中，該標本被描述為具臂狀物的。
Certain invertebrates are brachigerous, using their arms for locomotion. 某些無脊椎動物是具臂的，利用手臂進行移動。
The brachigerous anatomy of the creature was carefully mapped. 該生物的具臂解剖結構被仔細地繪製了出來。
Brachinus beetles can spray a hot chemical mixture at predators. 氣甲蟲屬的甲蟲可以向掠食者噴灑熱的化學混合物。
The researcher collected Brachinus specimens near the river bank. 研究人員在河岸附近收集了氣甲蟲屬的標本。
The brachiocephalic vein carries blood from the head and arms. 頭臂靜脈將血液從頭部和手臂輸送走。
A blockage in the brachiocephalic artery can be serious. 頭臂動脈阻塞可能很嚴重。
The brachiocrural index compares the lengths of the arm and leg. 臂腿指數比較了手臂和腿部的長度。
Physicians examined the patient's brachiocrural reflexes. 醫生檢查了患者的臂腿反射。
The brachiocubital joint is essential for arm movement. 臂肘關節對手臂運動至關重要。
She felt a sharp pain in her brachiocubital region. 她感到臂肘區域一陣劇痛。
Brachiocyllosis is a medical condition involving the curvature of the arm. 臂彎曲是一種涉及手臂彎曲的醫療狀況。
The surgeon corrected the brachiocyllosis through a complex procedure. 外科醫生透過複雜的手術矯正了手臂畸形。
The brachiofacial muscles work together during certain gestures. 在某些手勢中，臂面肌肉會協同工作。
He exhibited brachiofacial weakness following the stroke. 中風後，他表現出臂面無力。
The brachiofaciolingual syndrome affects the arms, face, and tongue. 臂面舌綜合症影響手臂、臉部和舌頭。
Diagnosis of brachiofaciolingual paralysis requires careful observation. 臂面舌癱瘓的診斷需要仔細觀察。
Brachioganoid fishes have a specific type of scale structure. 臂硬鱗魚具有特定類型的鱗片結構。
The fossils showed clear brachioganoid characteristics. 這些化石顯示出明顯的臂硬鱗特徵。
Brachioganoidei is a group of primitive ray-finned fishes. 臂硬鱗目是一群原始的輻鰭魚類。
Scientists study Brachioganoidei to learn about fish evolution. 科學家研究臂硬鱗目以了解魚類的演化。

meaning: 腕幼蟲（海星幼蟲的一個階段）
sentences: The brachiolaria is the final larval stage of many starfish. 腕幼蟲是許多海星最後的幼蟲階段。
During the brachiolaria stage, the larva prepares to settle on the seafloor. 在腕幼蟲階段，幼蟲準備在海底定居。
The brachiolarian larvae use their arms to attach to surfaces. 腕幼蟲利用它們的臂附著在表面上。
Brachiolarian development is a key phase in the starfish life cycle. 腕幼蟲的發育是海星生命週期中的一個關鍵階段。
A brachiopod looks like a clam but belongs to a different group. 腕足動物看起來像蛤蜊，但屬於不同的類群。
The limestone was full of fossilized brachiopods. 石灰岩中到處都是腕足動物的化石。
Brachiopoda is a phylum of marine animals with two shells. 腕足動物門是一類具有兩個殼的海洋動物。
The diversity of Brachiopoda peaked during the Paleozoic era. 腕足動物門的多樣性在古生代達到頂峰。
Each brachiopode has a unique valve structure. 每個腕足類都有獨特的殼瓣結構。
The collection included many rare brachiopode specimens. 該收藏包括許多罕見的腕足類標本。
As a brachiopodist, he spent his life studying ancient shells. 作為一名腕足動物學家，他一生都在研究古代貝殼。
The brachiopodist identified several new species in the rock formation. 腕足動物學家在岩層中鑑定出幾個新物種。
The brachiopodous fauna of the region is very diverse. 該地區的腕足類動物群非常多樣。
He published a paper on the brachiopodous fossils found in the quarry. 他發表了一篇關於在採石場發現的腕足類化石的論文。
The brachioradial muscle helps flex the forearm. 肱橈肌有助於屈曲前臂。
He felt a strain in the brachioradial area. 他感到肱橈區域拉傷。
The brachioradialis is a muscle of the forearm that flexes the elbow. 肱橈肌是前臂的一塊肌肉，負責屈曲肘部。
Bodybuilders perform hammer curls to target the brachioradialis. 健身者進行錘式彎舉來針對肱橈肌進行鍛鍊。
The brachiorrhachidian nerves connect the arm to the spinal cord. 臂脊椎神經將手臂與脊髓連接起來。
The study examined the brachiorrhachidian pathways in primates. 該研究檢查了靈長類動物的臂脊椎路徑。
The elderly woman suffered from brachiorrheuma in cold weather. 那位老婦人在寒冷的天氣裡患有臂部風濕症。
He sought treatment for the recurring brachiorrheuma in his shoulder. 他為肩膀反覆發作的臂部風濕症尋求治療。
The brachiosaur was one of the largest dinosaurs to ever live. 腕龍是史上生存過的最大型恐龍之一。
A life-sized brachiosaur model stood at the museum entrance. 一個等身大小的腕龍模型站在博物館入口處。
Brachiosaurus had longer front legs than back legs. 腕龍屬的前肢比後肢長。
Fossils of Brachiosaurus have been found in North America and Africa. 腕龍屬的化石已在北美洲和非洲被發現。
Brachiostrophosis can occur due to severe physical trauma. 臂扭轉可能因嚴重的身體創傷而發生。
The medical report detailed the case of congenital brachiostrophosis. 醫療報告詳細描述了先天性臂扭轉的案例。
In extreme cases, brachiotomy might be necessary to save a life. 在極端情況下，截臂術可能是為了挽救生命所必需的。
The history of brachiotomy shows how surgical techniques have evolved. 截臂術的歷史顯示了外科技術是如何演進的。
The researchers categorized the subjects as brachistocephali based on their skull measurements. 研究人員根據頭骨測量值將受試者歸類為短頭者。
Studies on brachistocephali were common in early anthropology. 早期人類學中對短頭者的研究很常見。
Certain dog breeds have a brachistocephalic head shape. 某些狗品種具有短頭的頭型。
The brachistocephalic index is used in physical anthropology. 短頭指數被用於體質人類學中。
The brachistocephalous skull is wider than it is long. 短頭頭骨的寬度大於其長度。
Scientists analyzed the brachistocephalous features of the population. 科學家分析了該族群的短頭特徵。
Brachistocephaly can be a natural variation or caused by external factors. 短頭現象可以是自然變異，也可以由外部因素引起。
The child was diagnosed with a mild case of brachistocephaly. 這孩子被診斷出患有輕微的短頭畸形。
The brachistochrone problem was a famous challenge in mathematics. 最速降線問題是數學界一個著名的挑戰。
The brachistochrone is a cycloid curve. 最速降線是一條擺線。
The brachistochronic path ensures the quickest travel time under gravity. 最速降線路徑確保了在重力作用下最短的行進時間。
Physicists studied the brachistochronic properties of the slope. 物理學家研究了斜坡的最速降線特性。

meaning: 無價值的東西, 瑣碎物品
sentences: The drawer was full of old brimborions. 抽屜裡裝滿了沒用的舊瑣碎物品。
He dismissed the idea as a mere brimborion. 他認為這個想法純粹是無價值的。

meaning: 無價值的東西, 廢物
sentences: She threw away all the brimborium accumulated over the years. 她扔掉了多年來積累的所有沒用的廢物。
The store sold all kinds of brimborium to tourists. 這家商店向遊客出售各種沒什麼價值的零碎商品。

meaning: 裝得滿滿的, 盈滿的
sentences: He was brimful of confidence before the match. 比賽前他充滿了信心。
The glass was brimful of orange juice. 玻璃杯裡裝滿了柳橙汁。
The bucket was brimfully loaded with water. 水桶裡裝滿了水。
She looked at him brimfully of hope. 她充滿希望地看著他。
The brimfulness of the river caused concerns about flooding. 河水的盈滿引起了對洪水的擔憂。
He was struck by the brimfulness of her joy. 她的喜悅之情溢於言表，令他深受感動。

meaning: 充滿, 盈滿 (現在分詞)
sentences: The cup is briming with hot coffee. 杯子裡裝滿了熱咖啡。
She felt her heart briming with gratitude. 她感到心中充滿了感激。
He wore a brimless hat known as a beanie. 他戴著一種被稱為小圓帽的無簷帽。
Brimless headwear is common in many cultures. 無簷頭飾在許多文化中都很常見。
She wore a wide-brimmed hat to protect herself from the sun. 她戴著一頂寬簷帽以遮擋陽光。
His eyes brimmed with excitement. 他的眼裡充滿了興奮。
He raised a brimmer to toast the happy couple. 他舉起一杯滿滿的酒為這對幸福的新人乾杯。
The host poured a brimmer for every guest. 主人為每位客人都倒了滿滿的一杯。
a brimming cup of coffee 一杯滿溢的咖啡
The report describes the result as brimming. 報告將結果描述為“滿載而歸”。
The jar was brimmingly full of cookies. 罐子裡裝滿了餅乾。
She spoke brimmingly of her achievements. 她滿懷自豪地談論她的成就。
The smell of brimstone hung in the air near the volcano. 火山附近的空氣中瀰漫著硫磺味。
The preacher spoke of fire and brimstone. 傳道人談到了地獄之火和硫磺。
The herbalist dried brimstonewort for tea. 草藥師把前胡一類的植物曬乾泡茶。
Brimstonewort grew along the damp path. 前胡一類的植物長在潮濕小徑旁。
The hot springs had a brimstony odor. 溫泉有一股硫磺味。
The brimstony smoke obscured the view. 硫磺煙霧遮擋了視線。
The brin of the antique fan was made of ivory. 這把古董扇子的扇骨是用象牙製成的。
One of the brins was broken and needed repair. 其中一根扇骨斷了，需要修理。
The cat had a brindlish coat. 這隻貓有一身斑紋。
The brindlish pattern helped the animal camouflage. 斑紋圖案有助於動物偽裝。

meaning: 鹽水；飽和水或鹽強烈浸漬的水；用於酸洗的鹽水溶液。
sentences: Do you want a can of tuna in oil or in brine? 您想要一罐油浸鮪魚還是鹽水鮪魚？
She understood brine after seeing how it changed the scene. 她看到鹽水如何改變情境後，就理解了這個詞。
The brinehouse was used to process salt from the sea. 鹽水房用於處理來自大海的鹽。
They toured the old brinehouse at the historical salt works. 他們參觀了歷史鹽場裡的舊鹽水房。
They used a brineless method to preserve the fish. 他們使用了一種不含鹽水的方法來保存魚。
The brineless environment was necessary for the experiment. 實驗需要一個無鹽水的環境。
The brineman monitored the salinity of the tanks. 製鹽工監測著水箱的鹽度。
He worked as a brineman for over thirty years. 他做了三十多年的製鹽工。
Place the turkey in the large briner overnight. 將火雞放在大型浸鹽水容器中過夜。
The briner added more salt to the solution. 負責浸鹽的人在溶液中加入了更多的鹽。
Don't forget to bring your umbrella; it's going to rain. 別忘了帶傘，快要下雨了。
Could you please bring me a glass of water? 你可以幫我拿杯水嗎？
The recipe calls for one large bringal. 食譜要求一個大茄子。
Bringal is a common vegetable in Indian cuisine. 茄子是印度料理中常見的蔬菜。
She chopped a bringall into the curry. 她把茄子切塊放進咖哩。
A grilled bringall softened quickly in the pan. 烤茄子在鍋裡很快就變軟。
He was known as the bringer of good tidings. 他被稱為好消息的傳達者。
The rain is the bringer of life to the desert. 雨水是沙漠生命的賦予者。
The brininess of the sea air was refreshing. 海邊空氣中的鹽味令人神清氣爽。
He adjusted the brininess of the soup. 他調整了湯的鹹度。
The water had a slightly brinish taste. 這水有一股淡淡的鹹味。
Brinish tears ran down her face. 鹹鹹的淚水流過她的臉龐。
The brinishness of the ocean is essential for some marine life. 海洋的鹽度對於某些海洋生物來說是必不可少的。
He disliked the brinishness of the well water. 他不喜歡井水的鹹味。
I made a curry with brinjal and potatoes. 我用茄子和馬鈴薯做了一道咖哩。
Brinjal is also known as eggplant or aubergine. 茄子也被稱為 eggplant 或 aubergine。

meaning: 運糧隊, 糧草販子 (印度用語)
sentences: The brinjarry supplied the army with essential grains. 糧草販子為軍隊提供了必需的穀物。
A brinjarry caravan was seen moving across the plain. 一隊運糧車隊被看見正在穿過平原。
The species is currently on the brink of extinction due to habitat loss. 由於棲息地喪失，該物種目前正處於滅絕的邊緣。
The two countries were on the brink of war following the border dispute. 兩國因邊界爭端正處於戰爭邊緣。
The ocean seemed brinkless under the clear sky. 在晴朗的天空下，海洋似乎無邊無際。
They faced a brinkless expanse of desert. 他們面臨著一片無垠的沙漠。

meaning: 鹹的, 海洋的, 海水 (口語)
sentences: Take a dip in the briny. 去海裡游個泳吧。
The air was filled with a briny scent. 空氣中充滿了鹹鹹的海水味。

meaning: 布里歐修 (法國奶油甜麵包)
sentences: I had a fresh brioche for breakfast. 我早餐吃了一個新鮮的布里歐修麵包。
Brioche is known for its high egg and butter content. 布里歐修以其高蛋和高奶油含量而聞名。
The earrings featured beautiful briolette diamonds. 這對耳環配有漂亮的長梨形鑽石。
A briolette cut is often used for pendants. 長梨形切割常用於墜飾。
The walls were painted a deep brique color. 牆壁被刷成了深磚紅色。
Brique is a French word for brick. 這是法語中磚塊的意思。

meaning: 煤磚, 壓製成的塊狀物
sentences: We used charcoal briquettes for the barbecue. 我們用木炭煤磚燒烤。
Sawdust can be compressed into briquettes for fuel. 鋸末可以被壓縮成煤磚作為燃料。

meaning: 充滿生機和活力；以動作或動作的快速為特徵。
sentences: We took a brisk walk yesterday. 昨天我們快步走了。
Something described as brisk is full of liveliness and activity; characterized by quickness of motion or action. 所謂輕快，是指充滿生機和活力；其特點是動作或動作快速。
The cold wind helped brisken his pace. 冷風幫助他加快了腳步。
Music can brisken the atmosphere of a party. 音樂可以活躍派對的氣氛。
I ordered the smoked brisket at the barbecue restaurant. 我在燒烤店點了燻牛胸肉。
Brisket is a popular cut of meat for slow cooking. 牛胸肉是用於慢燉的受歡迎肉塊。

meaning: 頗輕快的, 頗涼爽的
sentences: There was a briskish breeze coming off the lake. 湖面上吹來一陣頗為涼爽的微風。
The pace of the work was briskish but manageable. 工作的節奏頗快，但還可以應付。
She walked briskly to the station. 她輕快地走向車站。
The fire crackled briskly in the hearth. 火在壁爐裡活潑地劈啪作響。
The briskness of the morning air was invigorating. 清晨空氣的清新令人精神振奮。
He moved with a surprising briskness for his age. 考慮到他的年齡，他的動作出奇地敏捷。

meaning: 小西鯡, 一種小鯡魚
sentences: Canned brisling sardines are a common snack. 罐裝小鯡魚沙丁魚是常見的零食。
The fishermen caught a huge school of brisling. 漁民捕獲了一大群小鯡魚。
He won the game by capturing the brisque. 他通過贏得得分牌贏得了比賽。
In some card games, the brisque has a high value. 在某些紙牌遊戲中，得分牌具有很高的價值。
The family celebrated the baby's briss. 全家人慶祝了嬰兒的割禮。
A briss is a significant event in Jewish tradition. 割禮是猶太傳統中的一件大事。

meaning: 布里索派成員 (法國大革命)
sentences: Brissotins were part of the Girondin faction. 布里索派是吉倫特派的一部分。
He studied the political influence of the Brissotins. 他研究了布里索派的政治影響力。
The Brissotine ideology was influential during the Revolution. 布里索派的意識形態在革命期間很有影響力。
They attended a Brissotine political meeting. 他們參加了一個布里索派的政治會議。

meaning: 保持警覺或加強防禦；以恐懼、懷疑或距離來反應。
sentences: The employees bristled at the prospect of working through the holidays. 員工們對假期期間繼續工作的前景感到憤怒。
People often bristle when the situation calls for it. 當情況需要時，人們常常會感到憤怒。
The eastern bristlebird is an endangered species. 東方刺嘴鶯是一種瀕危物種。
We spotted a bristlebird in the dense undergrowth. 我們在茂密的灌木叢中發現了一隻刺嘴鶯。
Bristlecone pines are among the oldest living organisms on Earth. 刺果松是地球上最古老的生物之一。
We hiked to see the ancient bristlecone trees. 我們徒步去參觀古老的刺果松。

meaning: 有硬毛的, 豎起毛的
sentences: The bristled brush was used for scrubbing the floor. 這把硬毛刷是用來刷地板的。
He walked away with a bristled attitude. 他帶著憤怒的態度走開了。
The new model of the device is bristleless. 該設備的新型號是無刷毛的。
This plant species is characterized by being bristleless. 這種植物物種的特點是沒有硬毛。
The insect had bristlelike structures on its legs. 昆蟲的腿上有像硬毛一樣的結構。
The texture of the fabric was rough and bristlelike. 織物的質地粗糙且像硬毛。
The cat is a natural bristler when it feels threatened. 貓在感到威脅時會自然地豎起毛。
He was known as a bristler because he got angry so easily. 他被稱為易怒者，因為他非常容易生氣。
The bristletail is a primitive wingless insect. 石蛃是一種原始的無翅昆蟲。
Bristletails are often found in damp places. 石蛃經常在潮濕的地方被發現。

meaning: 一種植物名 (如某種雜草)
sentences: The field was full of bristlewort. 那片田裡到處都是一種植物名。
She carried a bristlewort home from the market. 她從市場帶回了一個一種植物名。
The bristliness of his beard made it itchy. 他鬍鬚的硬度讓他感到發癢。
She noted the bristliness of the dried leaves. 她注意到了枯葉的粗糙感。
The bristly brush scratched my arm. 那把硬毛刷刮得我手臂發癢。
He gave a bristly answer and walked off. 他語氣很沖地回答後就走了。
Bristol is a major city in South West England. 布里斯托是英格蘭西南部的一個主要城市。
He graduated from the University of Bristol. 他畢業於布里斯托大學。
The brisure in the wall was barely noticeable. 牆上的折裂處幾乎察覺不到。
Engineers designed a brisure to strengthen the fortification. 工程師設計了一個折線以加強防禦工事。
To brit means to break in pieces; divide. 這個字的意思是打碎成碎片，或分割。
People may brit in different situations depending on the context. 不同情境下，這個字可表示分開或切碎。
Great Britain consists of England, Scotland, and Wales. 大不列顛由英格蘭、蘇格蘭和威爾斯組成。
He plans to travel around Britain this summer. 他計劃今年夏天到英國旅行。

meaning: 不列顛 (羅馬時期的稱呼), 不列顛女神
sentences: Britannia is the female personification of Great Britain. 布列塔尼亞是不列顛的大地女神象徵。
The coin featured the image of Britannia. 硬幣上有布列塔尼亞女神的圖像。
He studied Britannian history in depth. 他深入研究了不列顛歷史。
Many Britannians moved to the colonies. 許多不列顛人搬到了殖民地。

meaning: 大不列顛的, 英國的
sentences: The guide pointed to a Britannic flag. 導遊指向一面英國旗幟。
Her Britannic accent sounded formal and clear. 她的英國口音聽起來正式又清楚。
He Britannically raised his teacup. 他以不列顛式的姿態舉起茶杯。
The reporter wrote Britannically about the ceremony. 那名記者用不列顛式的筆調寫那場典禮。
They traveled across the steppe in a britchka. 他們乘著輕便敞篷馬車穿過大草原。
The britchka was pulled by three horses. 這輛輕便馬車由三匹馬拉著。

meaning: 割禮 (猶太教, 同 briss)
sentences: The brith was held on the eighth day after birth. 割禮在出生後的第八天舉行。
Brith Milah is a fundamental Jewish covenant. 割禮是猶太教的一項基本盟約。
He's my brither, and I'll always support him. 他是我的兄弟，我會永遠支持他。
The two brithers worked together on the farm. 兩兄弟一起在農場工作。
Using 'lorry' instead of 'truck' is a common Briticism. 使用 'lorry' 而不是 'truck' 是一種常見的英國習慣用語。
His speech was full of interesting Briticisms. 他的演講充滿了有趣的英國習慣用語。
He enjoys watching British television dramas. 他喜歡看英國電視劇。
The British Museum houses many ancient artifacts. 大英博物館館藏許多古代文物。
She has a British passport. 她持有英國護照。
The British are known for their love of tea. 英國人以熱愛喝茶而聞名。

meaning: 英國人 (常用於美國或英聯邦)
sentences: He is a Britisher living in Australia. 他是一位住在澳大利亞的英國人。
The Britishers were well-received by the locals. 這些英國人受到了當地人的熱烈歡迎。

meaning: 英國身分, 英國特性
sentences: He felt a strong sense of Britishhood. 他感到強烈的英國人認同感。
The concept of Britishhood has evolved over time. 英國特性的概念隨著時間而演變。
The book contains a list of common Britishisms. 這本書包含了一份常見英國習慣用語的清單。
She adopted some Britishisms after living in London. 在倫敦生活後，她學會了一些英國習慣用語。
He behaved very Britishly during the formal dinner. 在正式晚宴上，他的舉止非常像英國紳士。
The garden was Britishly manicured. 花園被修剪得非常有英國風格。

meaning: 英國特性, 英國風格
sentences: The film captures the essence of Britishness. 這部電影捕捉到了英國特性的本質。
They take pride in their Britishness. 他們為自己的英國特性感到自豪。
A Briton ordered tea at the counter. 一位不列顛人在櫃台前點茶。
The Briton smiled at the rainy view. 那位不列顛人看著雨景微笑。
The term Britoness is rarely used in modern English. 這個詞在現代英語中很少用。
She was described as a noble Britoness. 她被描述為一位高貴的英國女性。
They traveled across Europe in a britska. 他們乘坐布里茨卡馬車橫穿歐洲。
The britska was a popular open carriage in the 19th century. 布里茨卡馬車是19世紀流行的一種敞篷馬車。
Brittany is a beautiful region in northwestern France. 布列塔尼是法國西北部一個美麗的地區。
They spent their summer vacation in Brittany. 他們在布列塔尼度過了暑假。
He brittened the cookie into tiny crumbs. 他把餅乾打碎成細屑。
The hammer brittened the shell at one hit. 鐵鎚一下就把外殼敲碎了。

meaning: 不靈活；在壓力、壓力或衝擊下容易破裂、斷裂或破碎。
sentences: Cast iron is much more brittle than forged iron. 鑄鐵比鍛鐵脆得多。
A diamond is hard but brittle. 鑽石堅硬但易碎。
The brittlebush is native to the deserts of North America. 脆菊屬植物原產於北美沙漠。
Yellow flowers bloomed on the brittlebush after the rain. 雨後脆菊屬植物上開出了黃色的花。
The glass shattered brittlely upon impact. 玻璃在衝擊下脆弱地破碎了。
She smiled brittlely, trying to hide her sadness. 她脆弱地微笑著，試圖掩飾她的悲傷。
The brittleness of the material makes it unsuitable for construction. 該材料的脆性使其不適合用於建築。
Low temperatures increase the brittleness of some plastics. 低溫會增加某些塑料的脆性。
A brittlestem mushroom was growing in the damp soil. 一朵脆柄菇生長在潮濕的土壤中。
We found several varieties of brittlestem during our forest walk. 我們在森林散步時發現了幾種脆柄菇。
Brittlewood is a common name for several types of trees. 脆木是幾種樹木的俗名。
The wood from the brittlewood tree is easily broken. 來自脆木樹的木材很容易折斷。
Brittlewort is an aquatic plant often found in ponds. 輪藻是一種常在池塘中發現的水生植物。
The pond was filled with green brittlewort. 池塘裡長滿了綠色的輪藻。
The brittling of the paper was caused by high acidity. 紙張變脆是由高酸度引起的。
Heat treatment can prevent the brittling of certain metals. 熱處理可以防止某些金屬變脆。
Briza is a genus of grasses known for their nodding seed heads. 鈴蘭草屬是一類以其下垂的種子頭而聞名的草本植物。
We planted some Briza in our garden for decorative purposes. 我們在花園裡種了一些鈴蘭草屬植物用於裝飾。
He could brizz the can with one hand. 他一隻手就能把鋁罐壓碎。
The workers brizzed the old box flat. 工人把舊箱子壓扁了。
I didn't know how to broach the subject of a salary increase. 我不知道如何提出加薪的話題。
They decided to broach the cask of wine for the celebration. 他們決定開啟那桶酒來慶祝。
A broacher is a tool used for enlarging holes. 鑽孔器是用於擴大孔洞的工具。
The artisan used a small broacher to refine the jewelry. 工匠使用小型鑽孔器來精修珠寶。
Learning a foreign language is a great way to gain a broad perspective. 學習外語是獲得寬廣視野的好方法。
The street is quite broad, with plenty of room for pedestrians. 街道相當寬闊，有充足的空間供行人行走。
Broadacre farming is common in Western Australia. 大面積農田耕作在西澳大利亞很常見。
They own a large broadacre property for wheat production. 他們擁有一處用於生產小麥的大面積農田物業。
The lumberjack used a broadax to square the logs. 伐木工用寬刃斧將原木削方。
An antique broadax was hanging on the wall of the cabin. 一把古董寬刃斧掛在小屋的牆上。
The colorful broadbill is found in tropical forests. 色彩斑斕的闊嘴鳥分佈在熱帶森林中。
We spotted a rare broadbill during our birdwatching trip. 我們在賞鳥之旅中發現了一隻罕見的闊嘴鳥。
The Quaker wore a distinctive Broadbrim. 那位貴格會教徒戴著一頂寬邊帽。
Broadbrim is a term sometimes used for a Quaker. 這個詞有時也用來指貴格會教徒。
He shielded his eyes with his broadbrim hat. 他用他的寬邊帽遮住眼睛。
The farmer wore a broadbrim to protect himself from the sun. 農民戴著寬邊帽以防日曬。

The curtains were made of heavy silk brocade. 窗簾是由厚重的絲綢織錦製成的。

He sat in a brocaded armchair. 他坐在一把織有錦緞花紋的扶手椅上。
The lawyer cited an ancient brocard to support his case. 律師引用了一條古老的法律原則來支持他的案件。

The altar was made of beautiful brocatello marble. 祭壇是由美麗的織錦大理石製成的。
Brocatello is known for its variegated colors and patterns. 織錦大理石以其斑駁的顏色和圖案而聞名。
Broccoli is a healthy vegetable rich in vitamins. 青花菜是一種富含維生素的健康蔬菜。
She served steamed broccoli with the roast chicken. 她端出了清蒸青花菜配烤雞。

meaning: 一個Brocket，一頭兩到三歲的雄鹿。

The brolga is known for its elaborate dancing displays. 澳洲鶴以其複雜的舞蹈表演而聞名。

Don't forget to take your broll; it's going to rain. 別忘了帶雨傘，快要下雨了。

The market stall sold hot broma at noon. 市集攤位中午賣熱食。

Bromacetanilide is used in some chemical research. 溴代乙醯苯胺用於某些化學研究中。

Bromacetate is a salt of bromacetic acid. 溴乙酸鹽是溴乙酸的鹽。

Bromal is an oily liquid with a sharp odor. 溴醛是一種具有強烈氣味的油狀液體。

Bromalbumin is a compound of bromine and albumin. 溴白蛋白是溴和白蛋白的化合物。
